About SEGULA Technologies

SEGULA Technologies is part of the SEGULA Technologies Group, a global engineering company with more than 15,000 employees across 30 countries. Together, they are involved in a wide range of important projects, leveraging extensive expertise and experience to develop the technologies of tomorrow.

As a consultant at SEGULA Technologies, you will have the opportunity to gain experience across a variety of industries and technical fields. They offer the chance to build valuable professional experience, expand your network, and work in exciting environments with well-known brands.

SEGULA Technologies is always looking for new, brilliant, and bold talent. What are you passionate about? Take on your next challenge with SEGULA!

For more information, visit them at: https://www.segulatechnologies.com/en/

About the role

SEGULA Technologies is looking for an experienced Packaging Engineer to join the Electrical Distribution & Packaging team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of the electrical platform for current and future Volvo Bus products, working with both electrical packaging and wiring harness design.

You will be responsible for designing and reviewing installation solutions, supporting electrical component development, and ensuring that packaging and installation activities align with the overall electrical architecture strategy. From schematic layouts to detailed 3D packaging and bundle drawings, your work will play an important role in supporting the production of wiring harnesses for future bus platforms.

This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who combines technical expertise with attention to detail and enjoys working closely with both engineering teams and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

•    Support electrical component development through packaging and installation design activities.

•    Design, develop, review, and approve technical packaging solutions in alignment with electrical architecture strategies.

•    Secure the interests of electrical packaging and installation across ongoing and future development projects.

•    Develop schematic layouts, bundle drawings, and 3D packaging models for electrical installations.

•    Support suppliers by providing installation data required for wiring harness manufacturing.

•    Take operational responsibility for daily engineering activities within established processes and procedures.

•    Visit the Volvo Buses production facility in Borås when required to support engineering and production activities.

•    Propose technical improvements and make decisions regarding engineering adjustments.

•    Support and collaborate with junior engineers and other team members.

Location: Gothenburg

Employment type: Full-time, Permanent

Employment start date: As agreed with Segula

Profile - who are we looking for?

Qualifications:

    

Experience supporting electrical component development through packaging and installation design.

    

Experience designing, reviewing, and approving technical packaging solutions.

    

High level of expertise in Saber for 2D wiring design.

    

Senior-level experience using CATIA V5 for routing electrical wiring harnesses and power cables.

    

Electrical engineering background.

    

High level of commitment and strong attention to detail.

    

Experience from the Volvo Group is required.

    

Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Desirable:

•    Experience from Volvo Buses.

•    Experience supporting and mentoring junior engineers.

SEGULA Technologies offers

    

Exciting assignments with Sweden’s leading industrial companies

    

Collective agreement

    

Health insurance

    

Childcare benefit (parental benefit)

    

Pension benefits, including flexible pension options

    

Discounts through our benefits platform on gym memberships, fitness equipment, massage, insurance (supplementary insurance or health protection), pension and savings plans (additional contributions or savings products), transportation and travel, as well as lifestyle benefits (discounts on culture, entertainment, and shopping)

    

Training and professional development opportunities through e-learning

    

Computer glasses

Application & Contact

Please note that applications and interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

We are committed to a recruitment process free from discrimination and bias. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, gender identity or expression, age, ethnicity, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation, or background.

To apply, click on “Submit application” and complete our AI-powered interview. It is a quick and easy way for us to get to know you and your experience, while giving you the opportunity to show us who you are.

The recruitment process

When you apply, you will be invited to complete an AI-powered interview with Hubert related to the position. The next step is a digital legal background check conducted through Fortcheck. After this, reference checks will be carried out digitally using Refensa. Following these steps, SEGULA Technologies will take over the recruitment process. Please note that the role may be filled before the application deadline.

jobs.title: PVP-Elementtiasentaja (KOTKA)
jobs.description:
PVP-elementtiasentajia – jatkuva haku tuleviin projekteihin

Haemme PVP-elementtiasentajia asiakasyritystemme projekteihin eri puolille Suomea. Kyseessä on jatkuva haku, ja kartoitamme aktiivisesti ammattitaitoisia tekijöitä tulevia työmaita varten.

Projektit käynnistyvät eri aikatauluilla, eikä kaikille kohteille ole vielä vahvistettuja aloituspäiviä.

------------------------------------------------------------------------


Mitä työ sisältää?

Työ koostuu pääasiassa PVP-elementtien asennuksesta erilaisissa rakennus- ja teollisuuskohteissa. Tehtäviin kuuluu elementtien nostoihin osallistumista, elementtien paikalleen asennusta, kiinnityksiä, saumausta sekä muita elementtirakentamiseen liittyviä työvaiheita.

Työmaat vaihtelevat kooltaan ja kestoltaan, ja niitä sijaitsee eri puolilla Suomea.

------------------------------------------------------------------------


Mitä me odotamme sinulta?

 * Aikaisempaa kokemusta elementtiasennuksista, PVP-elementeistä tai vastaavista rakennusalan asennustöistä
 * Piirustusten ja asennusohjeiden lukutaitoa
 * Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja turvallista työskentelyasennetta
 * Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
 * Oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä
 * Valmiutta matkustaa työmaiden sijainnin mukaan


Eduksi katsomme:

 * Tulityökortin
 * Nostinkortin tai kokemuksen henkilönostimien käytöstä
 * Kokemuksen teollisuus-, halli- tai elementtirakentamisesta
 * Oman auton ja B-ajokortin
 * Suomen kielen taidon
------------------------------------------------------------------------


Tarjoamme

 * Monipuolisia projekteja tunnetuissa rakennusalan kohteissa
 * Mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen tai keikkatöihin
 * Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksesi mukaan
 * Asianmukaiset työvälineet ja perehdytyksen
 * Hyvän työporukan ja turvallisen työympäristön
------------------------------------------------------------------------


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti kokemuksestasi elementtiasennusten parissa sekä toiveistasi työmaan sijainnin suhteen.

Otamme yhteyttä, kun sinulle sopivia projekteja on käynnistymässä.

Yhteydenotot: daniel.petajisto@lisapalvelu.net 

Huom: Tämä on jatkuva haku vuokratyöhön – käsittelemme hakemuksia sitä mukaa, kun uusia projekteja avautuu.

------------------------------------------------------------------------


Tietoa Lisäpalvelusta

Lisäpalvelu on vuonna 2002 perustettu valtakunnallisesti toimiva joustavia henkilöstöratkaisuja tarjoava kotimainen yritys. Lisäpalvelu-konserni on tunnettu luotettavuudesta ja pitkäaikaisista asiakassuhteista niin työnantajien kuin työntekijöiden keskuudessa. Työllistämme vuosittain yli 3 000 työntekijää, ja olemme vahva toimija monella alalla: tarjoamme töitä mm. ravintola-, rakennus-, teollisuus-, kunnossapito-, logistiikka-, toimisto-, siivous- ja kaupan aloilla. Olemme Suomen kymmenen suurimman henkilöstöpalvelualan yrityksen joukossa ja Henkilöstöala Hela ry:n jäsen.

Haluamme tehdä töihin menon sinulle helpoksi: kauttamme voit työllistyä parhaimmillaan jo seuraavana päivänä. Tarjoamme jatkuvasti töitä erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin, ja kauttamme tehty vuokratyö on ollut monelle työntekijällemme reitti vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Hae meille, niin etsitään yhdessä juuri sinulle mielekäs työ!

------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are looking for PVP panel installers for our client companies projects across Finland. This is an ongoing recruitment process, and we are actively building a pool of skilled professionals for upcoming worksites.

Projects will start at different times, and not all locations have confirmed start dates yet.

------------------------------------------------------------------------


What the job includes

The work mainly consists of installing PVP panels in various construction and industrial projects. Tasks include assisting with panel lifting operations, positioning and installing panels, fastening, sealing, and carrying out other duties related to panel construction.

Projects vary in size, duration, and location across Finland.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

We offer

Interested?

jobs.title: Lärare åk 4-6 till Lilla Alby skola i Sundbyberg, vikariat
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta i en stad där idéer snabbt blir verklighet och där du ser resultat av ditt arbete? I Sundbyberg är det nära mellan människor, beslut och möjligheter. Här får du vara med och påverka på riktigt, samtidigt som du utvecklas och växer i din roll.

Du siktar högt. Och har fötterna på jorden. Precis som vi.

Här på Lilla Alby skola, har vi stora visioner om framtiden och vill att du ska ha det likaså. Vi är en F-6 skola med ca 500 elever. Skolan ligger i Lilla Alby i centrala Sundbyberg med närhet till tvärbana, buss, tunnelbana och pendeltåg. Skolan består av två skolbyggnader, det röda huset och det vita huset. Vi har ändamålsenliga salar för bland annat bild, musik, hemkunskap och skolbibliotek. Våra fritidshem har delvis egna lokaler som är inredda för fritidshemmets verksamhet. Vita husets skolgård, F-åk 2 är byggd för att locka till lek och är väl lämpad för de lägre årskurserna. Röda husets skolgård, åk 3-6 samt fritidstid, har en multiplan som lämpar sig för olika bollsporter. Den direkta närheten till Tuvanparken är en stor tillgång för aktiva raster och fritidsverksamhet.

I uppdraget ingår att vara delaktig i skolutvecklingen på skolan. Varje vecka träffas du och dina kollegor, under ledning av förstelärare och skolledning. Skolans prioriterade områden samplanering och sambedömning bidrar till nå Sundbybergs stads mål - ökad måluppfyllelse och ökad likvärdighet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas maximalt gällande kunskaper och socialt samspel. I grunden finns det kommunövergripande arbetet med Tillgängligt lärande samt USiP - undervisningsskicklighet i praktiken där pedagoger får möjlighet att utveckla sin undervisning genom att observera varandras lektioner.

Lilla Alby skola är en rörelseskola med ett hälsoarbete vi kallar PSG - Puls Sprint Go. Vi satsar på ökad fysisk aktivitet under hela skoldagen vilket bland annat innebär att vi har rörelsepauser/raster inlagda i schemat. Vi ser att ökad rörelse inte bara förbättrar elevernas hälsa både för knopp och kropp utan också gynnar elevernas kunskapsinhämtning.

Vi söker nu en grundlärare för ett vikariat för en föräldraledig lärare i åk 5, höstterminen 2026. Tjänsten innebär undervisning i matematik, svenska/sva och SO-ämnena samt mentorskap i en av tre klasser.

Kvalifikationer

    Vi vill att du är legitimerad lärare 4-6 med behörighet för undervising i matematik, svenska/sva och SO-ämnena.
    För att lyckas och trivas hos oss behöver du alltid ha elevernas bästa i fokus och tycka om att samarbeta med kollegor i skola och fritidshem.
    Du är en tydlig ledare i klassrummet.
    Som person reflekterar du över din undervisning i relation till elevernas resultat.
    Du anpassar så att alla elever ges möjlighet till hög måluppfyllelse.
    Du har höga förväntningar på eleverna och har ett inkluderande arbetssätt.
    Ett krav är att du behärskar svenska språket väl i både tal och skrift.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Befattningen är ett vikariat på 100% höstterminen 2026 med start den 7 augusti 2026.

Vi önskar att du i din ansökan bifogar dokument som styrker din Lärarlegitimation och dina utbildningar.

Inför eventuell anställning kommer arbetsgivaren att begära att du visar ett utdrag ur polisens misstanke- och belastningsregister.

Sista ansökningsdag är den 4 augusti 2026. Intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post eller brev. Intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande.

Befattningen är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Övrig information

En stor del av vår verksamhet klassas som samhällsviktig verksamhet. Tjänsten innebär att du kan komma att ingå i Sundbybergs stads krigsorganisation.

Vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Sundbybergs stad Sundbyberg är en levande och växande stad mitt i Stockholmsregionen. Här bor drygt 55 000 invånare på nio kvadratkilometer, vilket gör oss till Sveriges mest tätbefolkade kommun. I Sundbyberg möts stadens puls och stora grönområden, och tack vare vårt centrala läge och välutbyggda kollektivtrafik är det alltid enkelt att ta sig hit. Närheten mellan kollegor, invånare och beslut präglar vårt arbete och skapar en arbetsmiljö där du syns och gör skillnad. Vi vågar prova nytt och satsar stort på innovation och digitalisering. Här får du driva utvecklingen av smarta lösningar som inte bara förenklar vardagen för invånarna, utan också sätter Sundbyberg på kartan som en föregångskommun. Sundbyberg växer med dig!

jobs.title: Test Engineer  Handheld Battery Electric Products - Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
You will join the Battery Product Lab within R&D Handheld Battery Electric Products – a team of experienced and curious test engineers working close to the products and the development projects behind them.

As a team, we support several development projects in parallel, sharing test responsibility, knowledge, and problem-solving. The work is hands-on and varied, combining laboratory testing, field testing, and analysis. Collaboration and technical discussions are a natural part of everyday work, and you will have colleagues who are just as interested in how and why things work as you are.

About the role

In this role, you work with testing and verification of handheld, battery-powered products such as grass trimmers, brushcutters, leaf blowers, hedge trimmers, and chainsaws.

The position is broad and gives you influence across large parts of the product development cycle. You are involved from planning and setting up tests to executing, analyzing, and following up results, making sure the products meet performance, functionality, and quality requirements before they reach the user.

Your work includes:

    Mechanical, functional, and performance testing, as well as developing and improving test methods and measurement techniques
    Verifying and documenting technical performance in different phases of product development
    Close collaboration with design engineers, project teams, and other R&D functions – often acting as a coordinating link between different technical specialists
    Designing fixtures and test rigs, and analyzing and reporting test results

Field testing is a natural part of the job and takes place both in Sweden and, when needed, internationally. If you enjoy seeing how products perform in real-life conditions – not just in the lab – this role offers exactly that.

Overall, the position offers high variation, a strong hands-on element, and good opportunities to grow within testing and verification of modern battery-powered products.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with a technical interest and a broad technical understanding. You enjoy combining practical testing with analysis and documentation, and you feel comfortable collaborating with different functions in a development environment. You work in a structured way but can adapt quickly when priorities change.

You:

    Have a technical education, for example within mechanical engineering, mechatronics, or electrical engineering – or have gained equivalent technical competence through professional experience
    Are fluent in both Swedish and English, spoken and written

Previous experience from testing and verification, laboratory environments, or product development is considered an advantage, but curiosity, technical interest, and a hands-on mindset are just as important.

Location

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:

Hiring Manager: Anders Persmeen, anders.persmeen@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.title: Team Lead, Engineering
jobs.description:
**Team Lead, Engineering, FinVector**

**Are you looking for a new challenge where you can combine people leadership with technical and quality expertise in the biopharmaceutical industry?**

Whether you are looking for your next career step, seeking to expand your leadership responsibilities, or broaden your expertise in the biopharmaceutical industry, this role offers an excellent opportunity to gain new perspectives and further your professional development.

We are looking for a**Team Lead, Qualification**to join our**Qualification Team**in the Engineering department.

The Qualification Team plays a critical role in ensuring that our equipment, facilities, utilities, and associated computerized systems are properly tested, documented ,and approved for their intended use. This helps ensure that our operations meet Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements and are ready to support the production of high-quality gene therapy products.

The team is responsible for planning, coordinating and maintaining qualification activities throughout the lifecycle of facilities, equipment and systems, in accordance with regulatory requirements, company procedures and industry best practices.

As Team Lead, you will lead and develop a team of qualification professionals while providing direction, support and expertise in qualification-related activities. You will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams, contributing to both operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Key responsibilities**

- Lead, coach and develop the Qualification Team, supporting competence development and team performance

- Set priorities and allocate resources to ensure efficient execution of qualification activities and project deliverables

- Provide guidance and decision-making support on qualification-related topics, risks and issues

- Review and approve qualification documentation and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company procedures

- Support audits, inspections, investigations of process or documentation deviations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and change management activities

- Drive continuous improvement and foster effective collaboration across Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality functions


**In order to succeed in this role, you should have:**

- A technical or scientific degree combined with relevant industry experience

- Previous experience in leading people or coordinating technical teams

- Experience in a regulated industry environment, such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, food production or another quality-driven industry

- Understanding of qualification, validation, quality assurance or technical compliance processes

- Knowledge of investigations, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and change management practices

- Strong planning, communication and problem-solving skills

- Fluent English and the ability to collaborate effectively with different stakeholders


Most importantly, you are a supportive leader who enables your team to succeed and is motivated by developing people, improving ways of working and contributing to high-quality GMP operations.

This is a permanent, full-time salaried employee position (37.5 hours per week). Our aim is for the selected candidate to start in the role during September–October, with some flexibility based on availability.

**What FinVector offers you**

Meaningful job in organization where your work truly matters for peoples health and where your work is valued. High competence, quality, teamwork, and transparency are emphasized in everything that is done at Finvector. In international organization you have great opportunities to grow and develop.

In addition to great colleagues and meaningful work, we offer a comprehensive range of employee benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare services, ePassi benefits for sports and cultural activities, a lunch benefit, and participation in our company-wide bonus scheme.

**How to apply**

Please submit your application via the link below by**9 August 2026**and attach your CV and application, including your salary expectation.

**For more information about the position,** please contact **Hiring Manager Lotta Rissanen**(+358 41 317 0975)during office hours in weeks 29-30. **During the Hiring Manager's holiday**weeks 31-32,please contact **Engineering Director Snorri Halldórsson**(+358 44 777 1410).

jobs.description:
Doctors Without Borders Norway (Leger Uten Grenser/MSF) is seeking a CRM Advisor to join our dedicated and collaborative CRM team working at the intersection of tech, data, and fundraising and help ensure sustainable funding for life-saving medical work worldwide.

This is a role for someone who wants to combine technical expertise with meaningful impact.

About the Position

As CRM Advisor, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing our CRM capabilities, driving continuous improvement of workflows, data flows, and system integrations to support effective and scalable fundraising and engagement. The role combines technical tasks with advisory responsibilities. The main focus is to troubleshoot and optimize existing CRM flows and create new processes, while ensuring that donor data is accurate, accessible, and actionable, enabling data-driven insights for the fundraising department.

We are actively working to create an inclusive workplace where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are committed to accessibility and are happy to make reasonable adjustments for candidates who may need them during the recruitment process and throughout employment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Improve and develop workflows in the CRM, including automation and integrations, and document processes.

  • Provide professional advice on process improvement and cost-effective solutions.

  • Collaborate with external suppliers on payment solutions and new integrations (e.g., Vipps and Mastercard).

  • Perform analyses and ensure data quality to support data-driven decisions, act as backup for the CRM Analyst.

  • Contribute to the strategic use of data in collaboration with the CRM Analyst and CRM & Loyalty Manager.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in relevant fields (information technology, informatics and computer science, finance and administration, etc.). Five years of relevant experience may compensate for formal education.

  • At least 2 years of experience with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) at a super user level or higher, including data analysis, and integrations.

  • Proficiency in SQL or a similar data querying/programming language

  • Experience in fundraising, project management, or analytical tools is an advantage.

  • Proficient in English (C1 and higher); Norwegian is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical and technical skills.

  • Structured, strategic, and detail-oriented.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

  • Quality-focused and goal-oriented.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic, international working environment where you’ll collaborate with an engaged and dedicated team.

  • The opportunity to be part of one of the world’s most recognised humanitarian organisations.

  • Real influence on and responsibility for developing CRM activities at Doctors Without Borders.

  • Flexible working hours with core hours from 09:00–15:00, and one day of home office per week.

  • Two additional days of annual leave.

  • Salary according to Doctors Without Borders’ salary principles, salary grade 15: NOK 622,742 - 687,428 per year (based on relevant experience).

  • Workplace: Oslo. Currently based at Hausmanns gate 6; relocating to Mølleparken 2 in early 2027.

At Doctors Without Borders, we value diversity and seek to have an inclusive and accessible work environment. We encourage all individuals who have the required qualifications to apply, independently of their ethnic, national, or cultural background, age, gender, sexual orientation, religious belief, disabilities, or other aspects of their identity.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Leger Uten Grenser er en nøytral og uavhengig medisinsk nødshjelpeorganisasjon som redder liv og lindrer nød. Vi hjelper de som trenger det mest - uansett hvem, uansett hvor, uansett hvorfor. Leger Uten Grenser har prosjekter i flere enn 75 land og sender feltarbeidere fra Norge på rundt 100 oppdrag hvert år. Leger Uten Grenser gir nødhjelp til mennesker i krig, kriser og katastrofer og andre som ikke har tilgang til grunnleggende helsetjenester. Vi varsler om overgrep og glemte kriser - fordi færre dør når flere vet.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer  Handheld R&D Product Design  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
At Handheld R&D Product Design, Landscape and maintenance equipment, we shape the next generation of leaf blowers, trimmers, brush cutters, hedge trimmers, and pole products used by both professional users and consumers worldwide. Our department sits at the heart of Husqvarna’s innovation journey – where ideas become products that perform, inspire, and make a real difference in the hands of users.

We work across the entire product lifecycle: from groundbreaking new development to continuous improvement of our existing portfolio. Collaboration is a key part of who we are – you will join a supportive team that works closely with key functions within R&D, production, and testing to create the best possible solutions.

Our work environment is fast‑paced, creative, and hands‑on. You will have access to modern prototype facilities and labs, working side by side with skilled colleagues who share a passion for engineering and strong product experiences.

Role Description

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will play a key role in transforming needs, requirements, and innovation into robust and manufacturable components and products.

Your responsibilities include:

    Driving design, development, and improvements of mechanical components with a main focus on injection‑molded plastics and die‑cast parts.
    Generating concepts and evaluating concepts.
    Conducting root cause analysis to understand problem areas and ensure effective problem‑solving within design, production, validation, etc.
    Ensuring robust designs through simulation and geometric requirements.

Working in Catia V5 (experience is an advantage) and the PLM system TeamCenter.

Cross‑functional collaboration with lab, design, calculation, production, R&D, and external suppliers.

Your Profile

We are looking for someone who is not only technically skilled but also thrives in a collaborative and open culture. To succeed in this role, we believe you are:

    Experienced in mechanical design – preferably with at least five years of relevant professional experience and a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar.
    Fluent in English and Swedish.

You are a team‑oriented person who enjoys sharing knowledge and solving problems together with others. You bring a humble, driven, creative, and curious approach, always eager to learn and grow. You feel comfortable in a fast‑changing environment where you take ownership of your tasks and deliverables. You work in a structured way and are used to planning your work so that we can reach our goals together.



Location

Our team is based in Huskvarna, where we strongly believe in the value of working closely together. Some flexibility is possible, but we aim for on‑site presence since collaboration is at the core of how we work.

Application

Please apply with CV and Cover letter. We do not accept applications by email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact: Hiring Manager: Jakob Engström, jakob.engstrom@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.  

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.title: Administratör till Arbetsförmedlingen Örebro
jobs.description:
Vill du axla en spännande roll som administratör till vår enhet? Vi söker dig som har talang för att skapa ordning och reda, gillar både eget ansvar och tätt samarbete och trivs med att ha många olika kontaktytor. Tillsammans får vi Sverige i arbete! Vill du bli en av oss?

Vårt uppdrag

På den nationella avdelningen Stöd och matchning ger vi service och stöd på distans till arbetssökande. Vi arbetar med flera viktiga ansvarsområden så som matchning, vägledning och rådgivning samt beslut om insatser för arbetssökande. Vårt huvudsakliga uppdrag är att förkorta tiden i arbetslöshet.



Beskrivning av tjänsten

Som administratör arbetar du med administrativa uppgifter. Arbetet omfattar bland annat diarieföring, mötesförberedelser, intern webb och allmänna kontorsuppgifter. Du utför administrativa uppgifter som mötesanteckningar, beställningar, fakturahantering och bokningar. Du har ett öga för vad som behöver fixas på kontoret och tar gärna tag i detta på egen hand. Arbetet sker för det mesta digitalt och du behöver därför vara bekväm i digitala miljöer och ha mycket god datavana. Som administratör stöttar du både chefer och medarbetare. Ingen dag är den andra lik!

Periodvis är det ett högt arbetstempo. Det ställer krav på framförhållning och strukturerade arbetssätt. Du arbetar självständigt och trivs i ett uppdrag med många sociala kontakter. Du har förmåga att arbeta med olika typer av frågeställningar och sätta dessa i relation till behovet av stöd i det dagliga arbetet. Det är viktigt att du har förmågan och trivs med att ge service och att samarbeta med andra.



Vårt erbjudande

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsorten är Örebro.

Vi erbjuder förmånliga semesteravtal, friskvård på arbetstid samt friskvårdsbidrag. Som medarbetare har du möjlighet att arbeta på distans en del av din arbetstid när verksamheten tillåter det. Ordinarie arbetstid är förlagd mellan 08:00-16:30.

Som anställd på Arbetsförmedlingen har du också tillgång till kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter inom myndigheten. Genom vårt arbete bidrar vi till ett inkluderande och hållbart samhälle, där du får möjlighet att göra en verklig skillnad för individer och för samhället i stort.



Grundläggande krav för tjänsten

    Godkänd gymnasieutbildning
    Minst 2 års aktuell erfarenhet som administratör eller motsvarande roll med liknande arbetsuppgifter
    Du har god förmåga att kommunicera i tal och skrift på svenska
    Mycket goda kunskaper i MS Office



Övriga meriter för tjänsten

    Erfarenhet av arbete med många kontaktytor
    Erfarenhet av inköp och beställningar utifrån befintliga avtal
    Erfarenhet av diarieföring, dokumenthantering, protokollföring och Sharepoint



Den statliga värdegrunden guidar oss i vårt dagliga arbete. Som anställd hos oss förväntas du arbeta rättvist, opartiskt och med hög integritet, samt bidra till att upprätthålla och stärka förtroendet för vår myndighet.  



Som medarbetare på Arbetsförmedlingen förväntas du vara:

Ansvarstagande – ta ansvar för ditt arbete, samarbeta och bidra till en god arbetsmiljö.

Handlingskraftig – ta initiativ, bidra till förbättringar och hantera förändringar.

Resultatfokuserad – planera, följa upp och bidra till verksamhetsnytta och resultat.



Ansökan

Låter det här som en tjänst för dig? Välkommen med din ansökan senast 16 augusti 2026.

Vi planerar att hålla intervjuerna fysiskt i Örebro vecka 36.

Bifoga ditt CV där du specificerar årtal, månad och arbetsuppgifter för varje anställning, samt intyg som styrker kraven om utbildning i din ansökan.

Det är viktigt att du besvarar urvalsfrågorna detaljerat och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din erfarenhet. Om efterfrågad information inte framgår riskerar du bli bortsållad i urvalet. Du behöver inte skicka in ett personligt brev.

Under rekryteringsprocessen kan urvalstester förekomma. Vi kommer att hålla dig informerad genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Mer om vår rekryteringsprocess.

Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontaktar du den rekryteringspartner som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.

Vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en myndighet fri från diskriminering. Det är viktigt för oss att all kompetens tas tillvara och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Vi ser positivt på om du har kunskaper i något av våra nationella minoritetsspråk.

Välkommen till oss – vi jobbar för ett Sverige i arbete! Här arbetar du på regeringens uppdrag för en väl fungerande arbetsmarknad. Målet är att korta tiden i arbetslöshet genom att matcha arbetssökande med arbetsgivare. Våra insatser riktas i första hand till dem som står längst ifrån arbetsmarknaden och till de arbetsgivare som är öppna för att anställa dem med störst behov av stöd. Vi motverkar felaktiga utbetalningar och brott mot välfärdssystemen så att våra skattemedel används effektivt till det de är till för. Vi samarbetar med många andra aktörer och tillsammans hittar vi lösningar som gör skillnad - för ett Sverige i arbete.

jobs.title: KOKKI
jobs.description:
PALKATAAN KOKKI MONIPUOLISIIN TEHTÄVIIN, VAKITUISEEN, KOKOAIKAISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN

Haemme ammattitaidostaan ylpeää kokkia yksityiseen perheyritykseen hotelli Gustavelundiin. Hotellimme sijaitsee Tuusulanjärven rannalla kauniissa puistomaisemissa, noin 15 min Helsinki-Vantaan lentokentältä ja puolen tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingin keskustasta.

Asiakaskuntamme koostuu kokouksissa, koulutuksissa ja erilaisissa yritystapahtumissa kokoontuvista ryhmistä, joille valmistamme kokoustarjoiluja, ryhmäillallisia sekä buffetruokailuja. Toteutamme laadukkaasti ja korkeatasoisesti monipuolisia ja vaihtuvia tuotteita: päivittäin tarjolla on hotelliaamiainen sekä lounas, iltaisin tarjoillaan bankettien lisäksi A la Cartea. Viikonloppuisin tarjoilemme brunsseja, olemme myös suosittu perhejuhlien pitopaikka. Terassillamme kesäkeittiössä valmistetaan grilliruokia ryhmille sekä salaatteja, pizzoja ja hampurilaisia walk-in asiakkaille. Hotellissamme järjestetään festivaalityyppisiä tapahtumia, kuten urheiluautotapaamisia, juhannusjuhla, bändi-iltoja ja varttuneemman väen disco-iltoja. Haluamme tarjota vieraillemme mahdollisimman paljon itse tehtyä ruokaa, leivomme ja valmistamme annoksia tuoreista raaka-aineista.

Työkielenämme on suomi. Toivomme sinulta kausivaihteluiden vuoksi joustavuutta: käytössämme on MaRaTes tasausjärjestelmä. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti kahdessa vuorossa, arkisin kello 6.00 - 20.30, viikonloppuisin alkaen kello 7.00 ja päättyen aina kulloisenkin tilaisuuden mukaan. Työ sisältää ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Palkkauksen pohjana on MaRaTes sekä normaalit ilta-, sunnuntai- yms. lisät, Kokemuksen määrän ja laadun mukaan palkka on myös neuvoteltavissa.

Arvostamme asiakaspalvelutaitoja, vastuullisuutta ja vieraanvaraisuutta sekä innostunutta ja innostavaa asennetta. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä ammattikoulutus ovat työssä onnistumisen edellytyksiä. Hakijoilta edellytämme aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työpaikan, jatkuvan kehityksen ja uudistuksen alla olevat upeat puitteet, mukavat asiakkaat ja huippuluokan työkaverit. Kanssamme olet mukana kehittämässä toimintaa perheyrityksessä, jossa on helppo tuoda esiin omia näkemyksiä ja ideoita ja osallistua toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Työ alkaa heti.

jobs.title: Ung mann på 24 år søker trygge og spontane assistenter😉
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast stilling og tilkallingsvikar
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dag, kveld og helg


Er du på utkikk etter en meningsfull jobb? Jeg er en ung mann på 24 år, som søker etter assistenter til mitt team. Jeg bor i Lillesand sammen med min mamma og lillebror. På fritiden liker jeg å bowle og å dra i butikken for å kikke litt. I tillegg elsker jeg å se på film og fargelegge på nettbrettet mitt, og det kan jeg gjøre til det ikke er mere batteri igjen. Reise er noe jeg også liker å gjøre enten det er en dagstur til Oslo eller Sverige, eller en lengre tur når vi har blitt bedre kjent. Videre håper jeg du kan gå turer, sykle eller fiske sammen med meg.

Jeg har epilepsi som gjør at jeg trenger å ha noen i nærheten av meg i tilfelle jeg får anfall. Jeg har lite språk, men jeg kan gjøre meg forstått ved å bruke kroppsspråk eller peke på bilder.

Jeg ser etter trygge og rolige assistenter som har godt humør, er spontane og har et ønske om å hjelpe meg i hverdagen min. Erfaring fra helsesektoren eller som BPA er ønskelig, men ikke et krav – personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges. Dersom du ønsker en givende og spennende jobb, håper jeg du søker!

Det er viktig at du er fleksibel og komfortabel med varierende arbeidstider, inkludert kvelder, helger og ved behov på kort varsel.

Stilling og arbeidstid:

Jeg søker nå:

2 faste stillinger – 10 timer hver i uka- ofte på ettermiddag 14.15 -23.15

1 tilkallingsvikar

Arbeidstidene kan variere og omfatter dag-, kveld- og helgevakter. Vaktene kan være både korte og lange, og enkelte langvakter kan deles opp i morgen- eller ettermiddagsvakter.

Ved ferieavvikling og andre behov vil det være aktuelt med vakter cirka kl.06.30-15-00 eller kl.15.00-23.30.

Det kan også oppstå behov for vakter på kort varsel. Vi søker derfor fleksible personer som kan arbeide på ulike tidspunkter og som ikke har faste begrensninger når det gjelder arbeidstid

Dette p.g.a. at mor jobber turnus og varierende vakter.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Tilberede mat og lett matlaging

  • Lett husarbeid

  • Tilrettelegging for aktiviteter og fritid

  • Lett personlig stell, som dusj og vask av hår

  • Bistå ved anfall, god opplæring vil bli gitt

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Fremlegge gyldig politiattest

  • Erfaring fra helsesektoren er ønskelig, men ikke et krav

  • Fordel om du har førerkort og egen bil

  • Kjemi vektlegges

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Trygg og selvgående

  • Godt humør

  • Ansvarsbevisst og pålitelig

  • Spontan

  • Ikke være allergisk mot katt

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. jobs.title: Project Manager -  Regulatory Implementation projects  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
Husqvarna Forest & Garden is looking for a project manager to the Product Compliance department.

As a project manager within Product Compliance you will play a critical role in ensuring Husqvarna Forest & Garden compliance with product legislation. Product Compliance is a support function supporting all product types on all markets.

About the role:

As a Project Manager you will:

    Cooperate with the Product Compliance department and the different specialists
    Cooperate with a Preparation Group, which investigates the impact of new legislation
    Communicate and coordinate implementation of new legislation in the different product categories and line functions
    Status reporting to Product Compliance line management and to steering groups
    Drive improvements related to the communication and implementation processes

Your skills and background:

You are someone who enjoys working with others and communicates clearly and effectively. You have a structured way of thinking and a natural ability to break down complex information into clear actions and insights. With a strong sense of self-drive, you take initiative and stay focused on results. You are also someone who sees opportunities to improve how things are done—both within your own team and in collaboration with others. Your approach is both firm and diplomatic, and you thrive in an environment where creative problem-solving and collaboration go hand in hand. You have:

    At least 5 years experience of project management
    Experience from product development and/or product maintenance
    Degree in Engineering and experience within engineering environments
    Fluent in English and Swedish (verbal and written)

Location

This position will be placed in our site in Huskvarna.

With our hybrid working environment, you will have the flexibility to work one day per week remotely, promoting work-life balance for all team members.

Your Application:

Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we apply ongoing selection. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.

For more information about the position please contact Hiring Manager Catrine Köpsén at catrine.kopsen@husqvarnagroup.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process please contact, Talent Acquisition Partner Gorjana Dubovina at gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

At Husqvarna Group, we believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture here: Our Culture | Husqvarna Group

jobs.title: Performance Director & PMO - Supply Management
jobs.description:
At Sodexo, we believe in creating a better everyday for everyone. We are seeking for a highly driven and analytical Performance Director & PMO to join our Continental Europe Supply Management organization.

This is a key leadership role where you will combine strategic performance management, portfolio governance, and executive support to drive value creation across the region. Reporting directly to the Head of Supply Management Continental Europe, you will act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner, helping to shape priorities, ensure execution excellence, and strengthen performance visibility across multiple countries.

You will work at the center of Supply Management, Finance, and Business Leadership, providing the insights, governance, and structure needed to deliver sustainable business results.

The role can be based in one of the Continental Europe regions: Sweden, Spain, Poland, or Belgium.

About the role

As Performance Director & PMO, you will be responsible for driving transparency, accountability, and performance across the Continental Europe Supply Management organization.

You will lead the performance management agenda while establishing a structured PMO approach that ensures strategic initiatives and transformation programs are prioritized, governed, and successfully delivered. The role offers a unique opportunity to influence senior stakeholders across countries and functions while supporting strategic decision-making at both regional and global levels.

Your main responsibilities

Drive performance and value creation

    Own and further develop regional performance reporting, including savings, spend, KPIs, forecasts, and business reviews
    Provide data-driven insights that support strategic and operational decision-making
    Strengthen performance visibility and transparency across Continental Europe
    Challenge assumptions and results through fact-based analysis
    Support budgeting, forecasting, and quarterly business reviews
    Ensure alignment with global performance standards and methodologies
    Translate complex data into clear and actionable business recommendations

Lead the PMO and project portfolio

    Establish and continuously improve the PMO framework for Supply Management
    Coordinate a portfolio of strategic, operational, and transformation initiatives
    Drive prioritization, planning, governance, and risk management
    Monitor delivery against objectives, timelines, budgets, and expected benefits
    Ensure consistent project management standards and ways of working across the region

Partner with senior leadership

    Act as a trusted advisor and strategic right hand to the Head of Supply Management Continental Europe
    Prepare, structure, and follow up on key leadership meetings and strategic reviews
    Track priorities, commitments, and actions across the organization
    Support business cases, strategic projects, and executive decision-making

Build strong stakeholder relationships

    Partner closely with Supply Management and Finance leaders across Continental Europe
    Collaborate with Global Supply Management Finance to ensure alignment with governance frameworks and financial standards
    Support knowledge-sharing and best-practice development across the international Supply Management community
    Communicate effectively with senior leaders and stakeholders in multiple countries

What you'll bring

To succeed in this role, you combine strong business acumen with exceptional analytical capabilities and a structured approach to execution.

We believe you have:

    Extensive experience within Supply Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Consulting, or a related field
    Experience from large international and matrix organizations
    A strong background in performance management, business analytics, PMO, or strategic leadership support roles
    Proven success in leading complex cross-functional and multi-country initiatives
    Strong financial understanding, including savings methodologies, procurement economics, and total cost of ownership concepts
    Advanced Excel capabilities and experience working with complex datasets
    Hands-on experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence tools
    Strong project and portfolio management skills
    Experience creating executive-level presentations and decision material
    Excellent communication skills in English
    Fluency in Swedish, French, German and/or Spanish is considered an asset

Experience from management consulting or consulting-like environments is highly valued.

Who you are

As a person, you are structured, analytical, and proactive. You enjoy working in complex environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity while maintaining focus on results.

You are also:

    A strategic thinker who can connect details with the bigger picture
    A trusted and credible business partner
    Solution-oriented, resilient, and self-driven
    Comfortable challenging perspectives through data and facts
    Skilled at building relationships across cultures and organizational levels
    Passionate about continuous improvement and value creation

Why join Sodexo?

At Sodexo, you'll become part of a global organization where collaboration, development, and innovation are at the core of what we do. You will have the opportunity to work with senior leaders across Continental Europe, influence strategic decisions, and drive initiatives that deliver meaningful business impact.

Join us and help shape the future of Supply Management across Continental Europe.

Additional information:

The position is full-time, with a start date to be agreed upon. We offer a hybrid working model, allowing you to combine work from one of our European offices with remote work.

Questions regarding the position and the recruitment process should be directed to Erik Gund, Talent Acquisition Specialist, at erik.gund@sodexo.com. We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible, but no later than August 16.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our recruitment system.

For this position, we will conduct a background check on the final candidate in cooperation with an external provider. The final candidate will be informed and asked to provide consent before the background check is carried out. All employees at Sodexo are also required to complete an identity verification process before employment begins.

jobs.title: Thon Hotel Nordlys søker Konferansevert (ekstra/tilkalling)
jobs.description:
Vi søker nå en engasjert ekstrahjelp til vår Kurs og konferanse-avdeling her hos oss. Arbeidstid vil være hovedsakelig på ettermiddag/kveld og helg. Stillingen rapporterer til kurs og konferansesjef. Tiltredelse etter avtale.

Hos oss skjer det mye under høysesong. Som Kurs- og konferansevert er du en av dem som sørger for at alt flyter fra første kaffekopp, til siste gjest går hjem. Du klargjør møterom, følger opp teknisk utstyr, møter gjester med et smil og bidrar til at kurs, konferanser, møter og arrangementer gjennomføres på en profesjonell og trygg måte.

Dette er stillingen for deg som liker varierte dager, høyt tempo og direkte kontakt med mennesker. Noen dager jobber du sammen med andre, andre dager får du selv ansvar for mindre møter og grupper. Felles for alle dager er at du er med på å skape gode opplevelser for gjestene våre. Arbeidsmiljø er viktig for oss og dette er en perfekt stilling for deg som motiveres av å sammen skape gode dager på jobb.

Ansvarsområder/arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Være ”ansikt utad” for hotellets konferanseavdeling

  • Generell kundebehandling

  • Klargjøring, rydding og rengjøring av møterom og gjestearealer

  • Oppsett av teknisk utstyr

  • Tilberedelse og servering av mat og drikke

  • Ansvar for eget kassaoppgjør og egne bestillinger

Har du kompetansen og egenskapene vi ser etter? Vi ser etter noen som:

  • Har relevant erfaring

  • Har gode tekniske datakunnskaper

  • Har et utpreget service- og kvalitetsfokus

  • Trives i en travel hverdag

  • Er tilpasningsdyktig

  • Liker systematisk arbeid

  • Er ansvarsfull

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner, både skriftlig og muntlig i norsk og engelsk

Vi tilbyr:

  • En spennende og variert stilling på et av byens beste hotell

  • Ansvar og muligheten til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag

  • En aktiv arbeidsdag med gjestekontakt og andre varierte oppgaver

  • God opplæring og utviklingsmuligheter i Thon Hotels

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer

  • Gode ansattfordeler og karrieremuligheter i en av Norges største hotellkjeder

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Thon Hotels: En av Norges største hotellkjeder, med over 90 hoteller i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Belgia og Nederland.

Thon Eiendom: Norges største private eiendomsaktør med utleie og salg av bolig- og næringseiendom, samt drift av over 80 kjøpesentre i Norge og Sverige.

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

    • Deltakelse i FNs Global Compact
    • Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisering av våre hoteller
    • Reduksjon av matsvinn
    • Fokus på likestilling og mangfold
    • Støtte til forskning og allmennyttige formål

jobs.title: Manlig personlig assistent till kille med rörelsehinder o autism, 80 %
jobs.employer: Göteborgskooperativet för Independent Living, GIL ek. för.
jobs.description:
Här finns ett jobb där du inte bara “går till jobbet” – du kliver in i någons vardag och gör den möjlig att leva fullt ut.

Vi söker nu en personlig assistent till en ung man som bor centralt på Hisingen tillsammans med sin familj. Tjänsten tillsätts efter överenskommelse.

Om uppdraget

Det här är ett arbete där struktur, närvaro och humor behöver samsas. Vardagen innehåller både tydliga rutiner och spontana stunder.

Stödet handlar bland annat om:

    personlig omvårdnad och hygien
    kommunikation via bilder, pratdator och iPad
    måltidssituationer och vardagsrutiner
    att skapa trygghet i övergångar och aktiviteter

Han har inget talat språk, men kommunicerar aktivt på andra sätt – och det är där du kommer in som en viktig del i att förstå, tolka och vara ett stöd i kommunikationen.

Vem du jobbar med

Intressen som ofta gör dagarna bättre:

    bussar och spårvagnar i Göteborg
    utflykter med tåg till närliggande orter
    restaurangbesök
    simträning två gånger i veckan, Tisdagar och Torsdagar.

Det här är en person där relation och förutsägbarhet betyder mycket – och där små saker i vardagen gör stor skillnad.

Om arbetssättet

Du arbetar tillsammans med en kollega i dubbelassistans under vissa pass. Det betyder att ni samarbetar tätt, växlar mellan att leda och stötta varandra, och tillsammans skapar trygghet runt personen ni jobbar med.

Vi tror att du passar om du

    är trygg i dig själv och gillar att ta initiativ när det behövs
    har lätt för att samarbeta med både familj och kollegor
    har humor och kan vara både lugn och lekfull i rätt lägen
    pratar svenska och är uppmärksam på hur språk och uttryck används i stunden
    gärna har erfarenhet av autism eller liknande funktionsvariationer (men rätt inställning väger tungt)

Arbetstider

    Måndag 15.00–22.00
    Tisdag 12.30–22.00
    Torsdag 12.30–22.00
    Helg (jämna veckor) 13.00–22.00

Det här är ett jobb för dig som vill ha ett uppdrag där relationen betyder allt. Där dagarna inte är likadana – och där du faktiskt är en förutsättning för att vardagen ska fungera.

GIL samordnar personlig assistans sedan 1989. För oss handlar personlig assistans om att skapa förutsättningar för att en person med funktionsnedsättning ska kunna leva det liv hen själv vill leva. I många uppdrag är den assistansberättigade själv arbetsledare, medan andra har utsett en ställföreträdande arbetsledare. Uppdrag och roller ser olika ut beroende på verksamhet och funktion.

GIL:s kontor ger stöd inom bland annat arbetsledning, administration, ekonomi, HR och utbildning. Tillsammans bidrar vi till att vardagen fungerar för både assistansberättigade och medarbetare inom kooperativet.

För att få och behålla trygga och engagerade medarbetare satsar GIL på utbildning och gemensamma aktiviteter.

• GIL:s assistenter har kollektivavtal med Fremia–Kommunal

• Friskvårdsbidrag upp till 2 500 kr/år

• Individuell lönesättning

• Utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister ska visas upp vid anställning

Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då urval sker löpande.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Up To My Eyes Limited requires a Business Development Manager to join the team in Co. Wicklow. Up To My Eyes Ltd. is an award-winning brow, lash and lip salon based in Greystones, Co. Wicklow, serving a loyal local, national and international client base. Alongside its salon services, the company operates the Up To My Eyes Academy, an online learning division that has to date provided V.T.C.T.-accredited training in techniques such as microblading, lipmentation, emBrowdery™ and eyelash extensions to beauty professionals in Ireland and internationally. The company is now launching a new, distinct business line within the Academy: a dedicated international online training programme in specialist beauty and aesthetic techniques for clients undergoing or recovering from cancer treatment (for example, brow, lash and camouflage techniques addressing hair and skin changes caused by chemotherapy and radiotherapy). This new venture will be marketed and sold to beauty professionals, salons and training partners internationally, and requires dedicated commercial development to build it into a viable revenue stream. The Business Development Manager will plan, organise and undertake market research to meet the requirements of the company's marketing and sales policies for this new online training venture. The role is commercial and sales-focused: it is responsible for identifying and developing international markets and customer segments for the new course line, building the sales and pricing strategy, and managing the resulting client accounts. The annual salary is €20 per hour for a standard 40-hour week.

jobs.title: Lab Engineer - Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
You will join the Product Test Lab for Landscape Maintenance Equipment products within the R&D Handheld organization – a team of experienced and curious test engineers working close to the products and the development projects behind them.

As a team, we support several development projects in parallel, sharing test responsibility, knowledge, and problem-solving. The work is hands-on and varied, combining laboratory testing, field testing, and analysis. Collaboration and technical discussions are a natural part of everyday work, and you will have colleagues who are just as interested in how and why things work as you are.

About the role

In this role, you work with testing and verification of 2-stroke handheld products such as grass trimmers, brush cutters, leaf blowers and hedge trimmers.

The position is broad and gives you influence across large parts of the product development cycle. You are involved from planning and setting up tests to executing, analyzing, and following up results, making sure the products meet performance, functionality, and quality requirements before they reach the user.

Your work includes:

    Mechanical, functional, and performance testing, as well as developing and improving test methods and measurement techniques
    Verifying and documenting technical performance in different phases of product development
    Close collaboration with design engineers, project teams, and other R&D functions – often acting as a coordinating link between different technical specialists
    Designing fixtures and test rigs, and analyzing and reporting test results

Field testing is a natural part of the job and takes place both in Sweden and, when needed, internationally. If you enjoy seeing how products perform in real-life conditions – not just in the lab – this role offers exactly that.

Overall, the position offers high variation, a strong hands-on element, and good opportunities to grow within testing and verification of technical complex products.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with a technical interest and a broad technical understanding. You enjoy combining practical testing with analysis and documentation, and you feel comfortable collaborating with different functions in a development environment. You work in a structured way but can adapt quickly when priorities change. You have:

    a technical education, for example within mechanical engineering, physics or similar – or have gained equivalent technical competence through professional experience
    2+ years experience from testing and verification, laboratory environments, or product development
    Curiosity, technical interest, and a hands-on mindset
    Fluent in both Swedish and English, spoken and written

Location

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:

Hiring Manager: Marina Karlsson, marina.karlsson@husqvarnagroup.com.  For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.description:

Sleutel jij graag aan techniek die écht impact maakt?

Wil jij werken in een industriële omgeving waar techniek, veiligheid én persoonlijke groei centraal staat? Zoek je een werkgever die investeert in jouw ontwikkeling én bijdraagt aan een duurzame wereld?

Dan is dit jouw kans.

Bij SABIC in Geleen zoeken we enthousiaste mechanische monteurs. Van starters tot ervaren vakspecialisten, die samen met een hecht team onze fabrieken in topconditie houden!

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Als Mechanisch Monteur zorg jij ervoor dat onze installaties veilig, betrouwbaar en optimaal blijven draaien. Jij bent onmisbaar in het onderhoud en de verbetering van onze productieprocessen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het oplossen van mechanische storingen aan onze installaties

  • Uitvoeren en begeleiden van reparaties en optimalisaties aan onze installaties

  • Uitvoeren van preventieve taken en verbeteringen

  • Voorstellen doen ter verbetering op het gebied van veiligheid, kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en kosten

  • Het begeleiden van projecten en werkzaamheden door derden

  • Het beheren en deels verzorgen van de technische documentatie binnen het vakgebied

  • Onderdeel van deze rol is het lopen van consignatiediensten

En het mooiste?

Je wordt intern opgeleid en begeleid richting senior niveau. Zo leer je stap voor stap alle ins en outs van onze fabriek kennen en bouw je aan een toekomst vol doorgroeimogelijkheden.

WIST JE DAT?

De fabrieken van SABIC in Geleen ongeveer 40% omvat van het industriepark Chemelot? En dat SABIC als eerste gecertificeerde circulaire polymeren produceert op basis van een grondstof afkomstig uit gemengd plastic afval?

De materialen die bij SABIC in Geleen worden gemaakt, je iedere dag tegenkomt?

Van onderdelen in auto’s en vliegtuigen tot zonnepaneelhouders, telefoononderdelen en medische toepassingen zoals insulinespuiten; jouw werk heeft impact op miljoenen mensen wereldwijd.

WAT BRENG JIJ MEE?

Jij houdt van techniek, denkt in oplossingen en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een opleiding MBO niveau 3/4 werktuigbouwkunde of gelijkwaardig

  • Een zelfstandige, resultaatgerichte en nauwkeurige werkhouding, met een passie voor techniek

  • Resultaatgericht, doorzettingsvermogen, accuraat kunnen werken;

  • Veiligheid zit in je DNA

  • Creatief en gedreven om problemen bij de kern aan te pakken

  • Ervaring met SAP is een pré

  • Beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, beheersing van de Engelse taal is een pré

jobs.title: System Architect, Automotive - Gothenburg
jobs.description:
About SEGULA Technologies

SEGULA Technologies is part of the SEGULA Technologies Group, a global engineering company with more than 15,000 employees across 30 countries. Together, they are involved in a wide range of important projects, leveraging extensive expertise and experience to develop the technologies of tomorrow.

As a consultant at SEGULA Technologies, you will have the opportunity to gain experience across a variety of industries and technical fields. They offer the chance to build valuable professional experience, expand your network, and work in exciting environments with well-known brands.

SEGULA Technologies is always looking for new, brilliant, and bold talent. What are you passionate about? Take on your next challenge with SEGULA!

For more information, visit them at: https://www.segulatechnologies.com/en/

About the role

SEGULA Technologies is looking for an experienced System Architect to join its engineering team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will play a key part in defining end-to-end software deployment solutions for connected vehicle platforms, with a particular focus on remote software download, connectivity, and uptime services.

Working closely with fellow system architects and stakeholders across production, aftermarket, and product development, you will analyze requirements, define technical concepts, and contribute to the architecture of future software deployment solutions. You will also ensure that proposed concepts are documented, anchored within governance forums, and aligned across the organization.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly experienced architect who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines.

Key Responsibilities

• Collaborate with other system architects to define end-to-end software deployment solutions.

• Analyze business and technical requirements together with stakeholders across production, aftermarket, and development.

• Break down requirements into scalable technical concepts and architectural solutions.

• Lead concept development and support technical decision-making within assigned areas.

• Present and anchor proposed concepts in governance forums for review and approval.

• Document architectural concepts, technical decisions, and decision logs for future reference.

• Apply technical expertise to analyze complex challenges and areas of uncertainty.

• Execute architectural activities according to established plans, priorities, and technical directives.

• Contribute to a collaborative engineering environment by supporting colleagues and sharing technical knowledge.

Location: Gothenburg

Employment type: Full-time, Permanent

Employment start date: As agreed with Segula

Profile - who are we looking for?

Qualifications:

•    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.

•    12+ years of relevant professional experience.

•    Recognized expert within your technical discipline.

•    Strong knowledge of remote software download (Over-the-Air / OTA) solutions.

•    Strong knowledge of connectivity services and functions.

•    Experience working with both onboard and offboard systems related to software deployment.

•    Experience collaborating with stakeholders across production, aftermarket, and product development.

•    Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within an architectural team.

•    Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Desirable:

•    Experience defining end-to-end software deployment architectures.

•    Experience performing technical requirement analysis and concept development.

•    Experience documenting architectural concepts and technical decision logs.

•    Experience presenting and anchoring technical concepts in governance forums.

SEGULA Technologies offers

    

Exciting assignments with Sweden’s leading industrial companies

    

Collective agreement

    

Health insurance

    

Childcare benefit (parental benefit)

    

Pension benefits, including flexible pension options

    

Discounts through our benefits platform on gym memberships, fitness equipment, massage, insurance (supplementary insurance or health protection), pension and savings plans (additional contributions or savings products), transportation and travel, as well as lifestyle benefits (discounts on culture, entertainment, and shopping)

    

Training and professional development opportunities through e-learning

    

Computer glasses

Application & Contact

Please note that applications and interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

We are committed to a recruitment process free from discrimination and bias. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, gender identity or expression, age, ethnicity, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation, or background.

To apply, click on “Submit application” and complete our AI-powered interview. It is a quick and easy way for us to get to know you and your experience, while giving you the opportunity to show us who you are.

The recruitment process

When you apply, you will be invited to complete an AI-powered interview with Hubert related to the position. The next step is a digital legal background check conducted through Fortcheck. After this, reference checks will be carried out digitally using Refensa. Following these steps, SEGULA Technologies will take over the recruitment process. Please note that the role may be filled before the application deadline.

jobs.title: Europcar søger en FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
FP&A Manager

Vil du spille en central rolle i at styrke finansiel styring, rapportering med stort forretningsaspekt i en dynamisk biludlejningsvirksomhed med sund vækst? Til at løfte vores finansfunktion til næste niveau søger vi en analytisk stærk FP&A Manager.

Om rollen

 Som FP&A Manager har du en nøglerolle i at udvikle og styrke virksomhedens rapportering, business controlling, FP&A og BI på tværs af den danske forretning. Udover den danske forretning, vil en mindre del af de opgaver, der hører til rollen, også gå med at supportere og drive den finske budget og forecast proces.

Med reference til vores Finance Director har du og dit team ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i den månedlige rapportering samt drive vores forecast- og budgetprocesser i tæt samarbejde med forretningen. Du vil derfor spille en væsentlig rolle i videreudvikling af vores eksisterende, solide fundament.

Samtidig fungerer du som et centralt bindeled til koncernens finansfunktion, hvor du sikrer rettidig, konsistent og veldokumenteret rapportering og bidrager til at skabe transparens og sammenhæng i den finansielle performance.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i månedlig rapportering til ledelse og koncern

  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre rapporteringspakker til Europcar Mobility Group Finance

  • Drive og udvikle budget- og forecastprocesser i Danmark og Finland

  • Udvikle og styrke brugen af forretningsdata, herunder rapporteringsværktøjer, dashboards og datagrundlag

I dag består vores FP&A afdeling af to controllere, der hver dag arbejder målrettet og ambitiøst for at levere til forretningen. Afdelingen er et godt sted i sammenhold og kultur. Og der er ønske om, at du som leder fokuserer på at teamet går fremtiden i møde med den rette støtte og ser løft af kompetencer og udvikling som vejen derhen.

Ansvaret for teamet indebærer også, at:

  • Sikre klare prioriteringer og høj kvalitet i leverancer

  • Udvikle teamets kompetencer og arbejdsprocesser

  • Skabe et motiverende og professionelt arbejdsmiljø

Udover dit fokus på os og teamet, har vi naturligt også et fokus på dig, så dit faglige og professionelle bidrag i virksomheden stemmer overens med det, vi søger.

Derfor forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, finans eller lignende

  • Har dokumenteret solid erfaring med FP&A, controlling eller reporting – gerne fra en større organisation eller koncern

  • Har erfaring med budget- og forecastprocesser

  • Kan demonstrere god forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte data til indsigt

  • Trives i en rolle med både operationelle og udviklingsorienterede opgaver

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller er klar til dette næste skridt i din karriere

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og synes vi lyder interessante, kan vi opsummeret tilbyde:

  • En central rolle med stor indflydelse på udvikling af afdelingen

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En attraktiv markedsrelevant lønpakke. Yderligere oplyses forud for eventuel forhandling.

  • Indtræden i en finansafdeling med stærkt sammenhold og høj faglighed

  • En arbejdshverdag i en organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til mennesket.

Ansøgningsfrist d.17. august 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og holder samtaler undervejs, da vi gerne vil finde den helt rette kandidat til stillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor interesserede til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Vi hører rigtig gerne fra dig via vores karriereportal. Men har du forinden spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Director, Thomas Lyngholm Jacobsen +45 61 99 99 87 | TLJ@europcar.dk

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.

Europcar Mobility Group is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe.  “We help to change the way you move” is what we stand for and brings us together.
