Head of Medical Scientific Affairs (ID2121\)  
Short Description  
The Head of Medical Scientific Affairs provides strategic and scientific leadership for AO's clinical evidence generation ecosystem and ensures that clinical research investments translate into meaningful improvements in patient care.  
He/she serves as a trusted scientific advisor to AO leadership, governance committees, and clinical divisions and represents AO ITC in internal and external scientific initiatives, partnerships, and expert forums.  
The role is accountable for developing a high\-impact portfolio of clinical studies across Trauma, CMF, Spine,TC, Veterinary, and related orthopedic disciplines, ensuring optimal allocation of resources, scientific excellence, and supporting effective translation of evidence into clinical practice.  
The position serves as a key interface between surgeons, researchers, clinical operations, governance bodies, industry partners, and educational stakeholders to maximize the generation, dissemination, and adoption of evidence\-based innovations within the AO ecosystem.

Lead the Medical Scientific Affairs team  
Provide scientific, strategic and operational leadership to the Medical Scientific Affairs team with two direct reports, fostering a high\-performing, collaborative, and service\-oriented culture.

Lead the Clinical Science Advisory Commission (CSAC).  
Lead the AO ITC Clinical Research Fellowship Program.  
Support the AO PEER program.  
Clinical Study Design \& Scientific Support

Support interpretation of results in close collaboration with surgeons, investigators, governance bodies, and Clinical Operations.  
Drive excellence in scientific publication strategies, congress presentations, and dissemination activities.

Lead scientific discussions regarding future evidence needs.  
Develop and maintain a strategic clinical research portfolio in collaboration with the Research Commissions and internal stakeholders which is aligned with AO's mission and priorities.  
Establish and continuously refine portfolio prioritization frameworks balancing available research funding, knowledge gaps, patient impact, scientific significance, feasibility, cost\-effectiveness and translational potential and risk\-benefit considerations in collaboration with the Research Commissions and internal stakeholders.

Lead implementation of health economic and outcomes research initiatives.

Advanced expertise in clinical research methodology.  
Strong understanding of orthopedic clinical practice and research.  
Advanced expertise in clinical study design, statistical principles, and evidence synthesis.  
Experience in designing and executing industry sponsored clinical studies as a CRO.  
Experience in health economic evaluation and outcomes research.  
Excellent scientific grant and publication writing and presentation skills.  
Sound understanding of regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and clinical research governance.

jobs.title: No
jobs.description:
(And how to say it. )

No to free pitching. So the ad industry finally seems to be finding a singular voice on calling out unhealthy business practice.

The message is clear. Learn how to say, âNoâ, or raise your hand to being a (worn out) door mat. For too long weâve given, âYes I canâ gold star status. So letâs hear it for, âNo, not for meâ. And relish every word.

But why is it so damn difficult to say?

What scares us the most about ânopeâ is that we perceive it to somehow diminish us, make us less âgoodâ. Less likeable.

Truth is itâs where respect starts.

So much of this people-pleasing stuff goes back to when were children. It came gilded as manners - being good and polite. But boy was it loaded. And we knew it.

So now when every fibre of our being is screaming, âNo!â thereâs a mute child within, worried about doing the wrong thing.

Bringing this back to creative basecamp. Iâm sure you can think of a million and one examples of when ânoâ is the perfectly right thing to say. Can you stay and work up a few more examples? Can you work the weekend? Can you give me some ideas (that I will then not credit you for)? Can you knock me up a quick logo /speed read my script (again)? Cut to that feeling when you show up or hand over. Youâve been âhadâ AGAIN. You missed out on doing something you really wanted to do. You denied yourself.

You know what I hate the most? Rather than say, âNoâ, we fall back on those pathetic well-worn excuses. You know the ones. Who is fooling who? And the guilt, the need for a fantastic memory. All because. And even when weâve made a pact with ourselves to say, âNoâ, we still get caught off guard. Why does a perfectly reasonable, âNoâ, pop out as a, âYesâ?

Iâll tell you why. We donât practise saying, âNoâ enough. Unlike all our positive affirmations, we just donât flex the, âNoâ muscle in a way thatâs easy to voice when we need it.

âNoâ needs a brand refresh.

ENTER THE NEW NO. A POSITIVE NEGATIVE (with added feel good factor).

Here Are a Few To Try For Size

(NB. Ditch the old âsorryâ appendage. There is nothing to be sorry for. End of.)

  • Iâd love to but Iâm already committed toâ¦
  • Thank you for thinking of me for x , but I like to give things 100% and I just donât have the time to give x the attention it deserves.
  • Itâs a busy month, let me check my diary when I get back. (Buy time.)
  • I canât do that date, but does x work for you? (Buy control.)
  • Itâs not something that feels right for me, but I could put you in touch with x (Helpful.)
  • I can do it, but I only have an hour. (Compromise.)

Write your own, pop them on your phone. Never get caught without a, âNoâ in your back pocket again.

Oh and hereâs a nice quoteâ¦

âStanding up for yourself and saying no doesnât make you argumentative, sharing your feelings doesnât make you oversensitive and saying no doesnât make you uncaring or selfish. If someone wonât respect your feelings, needs and boundaries, the problem isnât you; its them.â Lori Deschene.

If anything here resonates with you, please share. Iâm not saying anything radical, but sometimes a reminder of the basic stuff is all we need to make a big difference.

jobs.title: Widen the circle
jobs.description:
I coach a lot of creative professionals who come to me at real crossroads in their careers - some have a menu of choices they are trying to decide from, or for some, itâs, âhelp me to do anything other than what I am doing right now!â

Regardless of which curated coaching path we end up travelling along, the process starts with a deep dive into the unconscious mind and ends up with a lateral shift and a conversation with someone you never imagined. (I say ends, but thatâs really the start).

My point is this, we are all capable of polishing a CV, calling a recruiter or going to a network event but real finds are made when you step outside your networks and allow yourself to get curious.

Rather than think, who do I know, think who donât I know? Time and time again people tell me I want to do X but I donât know anyone, or they give up when a quick-fire email to friends, or friends of friends yields nothing. SLOW DOWN. Do your detective work. Challenge yourself to think outside your normal circle and widen your contact strategy. Get comfortable with using LinkedIn, it's still, in my opinion, the best platform for seeking out professionals who share your interests and voice interesting opinions. See what causes they support, and what events they pop up at. There will be someone doing something very similar to what youâd like to try somewhere in the world. 9/10 times those people are very generous with their time IF they sense a real connection and passion. And this is the point, your standard cover note and a CV will probably not be enough. Neither is the sycophantic, Iâve been a great fan approach.

Take time to do your research. What nugget of info can you share with them that shows a deeper level of interest or knowledge? Equally, as much as you want to speak to the CEO, are they the right person? A great piece of advice someone once gave to me was, to aim your intro to the middle ranks of a company. Someone within reach of the decision-makers, but not so overwhelmed with the really big stuff that they canât spare you the time. The bonus of this approach is that they, as your champion, can feel they are making a difference, and through your energy and enthusiasm, look good too.

It's easy to say donât give up, but please donât. Trust the process. Be strict about getting emails off, but equally, build a realistic framework for a reply. Nothing personal but the likelihood is, that you are at the bottom of the recipients' priorities. I like to work to a 2-week rule - no reply after 2 weeks., knock again. Keep adapting the tempo and the timing. Keep challenging yourself to think laterally about how to make contact and widen the circle of possible contact points. Creativity is your tool. Persistence is the means.

Frame your search as one of curiosity and discovery, because whilst it might not beat precisely to your âget me outta hereâ clock, it will protect you from search fatigue - the death toll for all career shifts. Keep reflecting on the evidence, If all your research is leading to the insight that you need to invest in new skills, donât just plough on, waiting to hear what you think you want to hear. Constantly re-evaluate your timeframe and reshape what you do. Be realistic. I donât mean that in the, âwho do you think you areâ sense, but the truth is, you only have so much time in a day.

Build time for research, volunteering, spec briefs etc, but keep a beady on what it is costing you - financially and time-wise. Time and money are grim reapers in the career move cast. Can you combine new learning with what you are doing right now? Constantly check your motivation levels and as Bill âDesign Your Lifeâ Burnett says, âGet good at feeling luckyâ. Thereâs evidence that people with this attitude are more likely to be tuned into the kind of interesting opportunities on the periphery of our vision. AKA, be less blinkered and try stuff.

And last but not least, get used to the idea that gut instinct is a real and valuable compass. Because it just is.

jobs.title: Butikschef
jobs.description:
Få nye udfordringer i en nystartet virksomhed med et stærkt fællesskab.

Vil du være en del af et nyt brand i Danmark – så søg ind til os i Hus og Hjem.

Vi har fællesskab og samarbejde som kerneværdier, da vi tror på, at godt arbejdsmiljø og glade kollegaer er med til at skabe en god kundeoplevelse.

Lyder det som noget for dig:

Du bliver en del af et stærkt team, hvor du vil komme til at spille en afgørende rolle i teamet. For at blive vores nye kollega skal du være god til at samarbejde, men også kunne tænke og arbejde selvstændigt samt tage ansvar. Du er resultatorienteret, serviceminded, har situationsfornemmelse og sans for god kundebetjening. Du formår at engagere dig og gå foran som det gode eksempel, er fleksibel og har en positiv indstilling til nye udfordringer, til kunderne og til kollegerne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. bestå i sikre en altid indbydende og salgsklar butik med en høj standard.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling, og der vil være aften- og weekendarbejde.

Få en spændende og afvekslende hverdag med fuld fart på samt mulighed for gode og fleksible arbejdsforhold og løn efter kvalifikationer.

Kan du se dig selv i:

Du er medansvarlig for butikkens udvikling. Du sikrer, at der altid er den rette bemanding, og butikken løbende udvikles til at nå dens fulde potientiale.

Du er en yderst fleksibel og stabil medarbejder. Du ved, at du i en butik kan blive afbrudt, og arbejdsopgaverne kan ændre sig i løbet af dagen, samt at vi alle er afhængige af hinanden for at få butikken til at spille.

Du er ambitiøs. Du har lyst til at dygtiggøre dig, og lyst til at gøre dit bedste for at skabe et godt resultat. Derudover går du foran som det gode eksempel.

Du er imødekommende. Du ønsker at få andre til at føle sig godt tilpas i dit selskab, da du ved, at det er starten på god kollegaservice og en god kundeservice.

Du er en god kollega. Du ved, hvor vigtigt det er at være omgivet af gode kollegaer. Både socialt og fagligt. Du ønsker at hjælpe og støtte dine kollegaer, samt skabe god energi.

Du nyder at have direkte kundekontakt. Du formår at skabe tillid og forstå kunden. Du brænder for at give kunden en troværdig og god oplevelse. Sammen med dine dygtige kollegaer sørger du for, at kunden kommer igen.

Da vores koncept stammer fra Italien er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med import fra EU og udenfor EU.

Hvis jobbet som noget for dig, så skynd dig at sende din ansøgning, da vi holder samtaler løbende. Stillingen forventes besat 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt.

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til os i Hus og Hjem på vores mail.

jobs.title: Senior engineer / lead engineer - software platform m/f for bangalore (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionThe Software Platform Senior Engineer / Lead Engineer, will be responsible for supporting a strong team of engineers working on hi-tech embedded applicative software in a provided project perimeter.



You will be part of Software Engineering Department which has multidisciplinary teams across multiple Safran sites working together to provide innovative, future products of high technological value in aeronautical, land and maritime industries.



You will work in close collaboration with the Reseach&Development headquarters of Safran Electronics and Defense in France. In the short term, you will join a task force dedicated to Low Level Testing.



You will have the responsibility of the Low Level Testing activities, by supporting your team directly. In this context you will be reporting directly to the Technical Manager and operationally to the Tech Lead.

Working with others, you shall responsible for:

- ensuring the highest level of quality for Team deliverables in compliance with DO-178C;

- providing help to the Team software engineers when stuck;

- handling the more complex pieces of software via Architecture/Integration/Development;

- challenge choices from the Management from a Technical standpoint by raising awareness on technical risks on challenging topics;

- train upcoming new engineers with knowledge learned from the Technical Management.



About Safran Electronics & Defence

Safran Electronics & Defence is an international company with over 14,000 employees mobilizing their expertise and team spirit to design high-tech solutions in aerospace, defence and space industries. By combining human and technological intelligence, the company develops products and services to help civilian and military players observe, decide and guide on land, at sea, in the sky and space thus contributing to safer world.

Safran Electronics & Defence's centre in Bengaluru is an upcoming centre of excellence to established to provide R&D and Engineering solutions to local (Make-in-India) as well as global requirements of the company.



Welcome to Safran, powering the aeronautical industry with trust.

Reference of excellence, open to the world, and part of the main characters of innovation, we share a common vision of a future for aviation.

Joining us is becoming part of the most challenging projects carried out in the field: propelling from the most pioneering Air Taxis startups to the legacy flagships counting HAL.

At Safran, we value long-term commitment from our collaborators, and promote an environment of trust at all levels, by empowerment.

jobs.description:
Hledáme kolegu/kolegyni na pozici Pracovní konzultant pro osoby se zdravotním znevýhodněním - pracovní poměr na dobu určitou do 31.12.2027 s možností prodloužení.

Chcete pomáhat lidem se zdravotním znevýhodněním na jejich cestě k větší samostatnosti a zaměstnání? Přidejte se k našemu týmu a staňte se součástí organizace, která již řadu let podporuje lidi při hledání jejich místa v běžném životě i na otevřeném trhu práce.
Koho hledáme
Uvítáme kolegu či kolegyni, který/á:
- splňuje odbornou způsobilost dle zákona č. 108/2006 Sb., o sociálních službách (§ 110 sociální pracovník nebo § 116 pracovník v sociálních službách),
- případně studuje příslušný obor a odbornou způsobilost právě dokončuje,
- má praxi v oboru (výhodou, nikoliv podmínkou),
- je samostatný/á, zodpovědný/á, empatický/á a komunikativní,
- umí pracovat samostatně i v týmu,
- nebojí se hledat nová řešení a přicházet s vlastními nápady,
- ovládá běžnou práci na PC (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, internet),
- má chuť učit se novým věcem a rozvíjet se v oblasti podpory lidí se zdravotním znevýhodněním,
- výhodou je řidičský průkaz skupiny B.
Platové podmínky
- nástupní mzda 28 000-34 000 Kč (při plném úvazku),
- po třech měsících možnost osobního ohodnocení.

Co vám nabízíme
- zajímavou, pestrou a smysluplnou práci v kanceláři i v terénu,
- důkladné zaškolení, metodickou podporu, pravidelnou supervizi, výměnné stáže a možnosti dalšího vzdělávání,
- prostor pro realizaci vlastních nápadů, profesní i osobní rozvoj,
- 25 dní dovolené a možnost práce z domova (home office),
- služební mobilní telefon s neomezeným tarifem i pro soukromé využití.

Co bude náplní vaší práce
- individuální i skupinová podpora lidí se zdravotním znevýhodněním při jejich osamostatňování v osobním i pracovním životě,
- plánování a koordinace podpory při hledání zaměstnání na otevřeném trhu práce i po jeho získání,
- nácvik pracovních a sociálních dovedností a v případě potřeby asistence na pracovišti po nezbytně nutnou dobu,
- spolupráce se zaměstnavateli, sociálními službami, školami, dalšími institucemi, rodinnými příslušníky a opatrovníky,
- vedení dokumentace,
- prezentace služby odborné i široké veřejnosti.

jobs.description:
NECHODIT NA PROVOZOVNU O2, KONTAKT VÝHRADNĚ E-MAILEM.

Sleduješ trendy, rád(a) zkoušíš nové věci a vždy víš, jaké vychytávky nabízí tvůj telefon? Pak už máš napůl vyhráno.
V O2 prodejnách spojujeme svět moderních technologií a lidský přístup - pomáháme zákazníkům vybírat chytré služby, které jim zjednoduší život. Pokud umíš naslouchat, hledat řešení a nelekneš se výzvy, v našem týmu se najdeš. Navíc tě čeká parta lidí, kteří si pomáhají a táhnou za jeden provaz.
Co tě na téhle pozici čeká:
- Prodej je tady v hlavní roli - žádné nudné sezení za přepážkou, ale živá práce s lidmi, kde tvůj šarm, energie a komunikační um hrají zásadní roli. Budeš zákazníkům pomáhat najít ideální řešení, které jim usnadní každý den, a k tomu nabídneš produkty a služby, které dávají smysl.
- Z každého rozhovoru může být obchod. A každý obchod ti přináší nejen úspěch, ale i vyšší odměnu. Tvoje práce má přímý dopad na výsledky celé prodejny i tvůj měsíční příjem. Provize nejsou omezené, takže čím víc prodáš, tím víc vyděláš.
- Na prodejně budeš součástí týmu, který jede naplno - sdílíme know how, tipy i motivaci jít dál. Zkusíš si různé prodejní přístupy, naučíš se jednat s různými typy zákazníků a každý den se v obchodě zlepšíš o kousek víc.
- Čeká tě prostředí, které má tah na branku, ale taky férovost a humor.
- Provize nemají strop. Naši nejlepší prodejci berou domů až 70 000 Kč měsíčně, běžný průměr je kolem 40 000 Kč včetně fixu a každý může růst výš.
Jak vypadá nástup u nás:
- Odstartuješ vstupním školením, které ti pomůže pochopit, jak fungují naše produkty, služby i komunikace se zákazníky. Dostaneš mentora, který tě povede první měsíce. Budeš růst - nejen v obchodě, ale i osobně.

jobs.title: Non Executive Director
jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of a Purpose-Driven Member Fund

The Ambulance Provident Fund (APF) is seeking an independent, volunteer Non-Executive Director to join its Board and contribute to the next chapter of the Fund's growth and sustainability.


Since 1981, APF has provided financial peace of mind to its members and their families by ensuring affordable, accessible and immediate financial assistance to nominated beneficiaries upon the death of a member. APF's vision is to be a national fund providing financial peace of mind for members' beneficiaries, supported by a strong commitment to fairness, transparency, accountability, integrity and compassion.


Following a recent Board Strategy Workshop and Board Skills and Capability Assessment, APF has adopted an ambitious strategic agenda for 2026â2029 focused on:

  • Contemporary governance and organisational resilience.
  • Sustainable financial performance and investment stewardship.
  • Enhanced member and stakeholder engagement.
  • Sustainable membership growth and national expansion opportunities.

 As part of its succession planning and ongoing Board renewal, APF is seeking an independent Director who can complement the existing Board and bring critical skills, experience and strategic insight to support the achievement of these objectives.


About the Opportunity

This is a volunteer Board position providing strategic oversight, governance and stewardship of the Fund. Directors work collaboratively to ensure APF remains financially sustainable, well-governed and responsive to the needs of current and future members.


Desired Skills and Experience

The Board is particularly interested in candidates with demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Financial management, investment oversight or treasury management.
  • Actuarial, insurance, superannuation or mutual fund experience.
  • Strategic growth, business development or member-based organisations.
  • Board experience.

Candidates with experience in not-for-profit, member-based, emergency services, healthcare or community-focused organisations will be highly regarded.


Personal Attributes

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

  • Strong strategic thinking and sound judgement.
  • High standards of integrity and ethical leadership.
  • A collaborative and respectful approach.
  • A commitment to good governance and accountability.

The Board meets approximately six times throughout the year in a combination of face to face and online formats, with Directors also participating in strategic planning sessions, committee work and other governance activities as required.


How to Apply

Applicants should provide:

  • A current curriculum vitae; and
  • A brief covering letter outlining their interest in the role and the skills and experience they would bring to the APF Board.

Join us in supporting a trusted organisation dedicated to providing financial peace of mind to members and their families. Together, we can help shape APF's future and extend its impact for generations to come.


Applications

To apply, please send your application (cover letter and resume) to secretary@ambprov.org.au  by COB Wednesday 5 August 2026.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Haven Safety:
Haven is transforming how organizations learn from workplace incidents.

Built in partnership with The AES Corporation and backed by AI Fund, Haven applies purpose-built AI to incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and organizational learning. Our platform helps utilities, energy companies, construction firms, and other high-risk industries dramatically reduce investigation effort while improving investigation quality and organizational learning.

We're an early-stage company with enterprise customers, global ambitions, and an experienced leadership team. We're looking for exceptional salespeople who enjoy building a category rather than simply selling software.

The Opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive with a successful track record selling enterprise EHS software. You will own opportunities from discovery through executive alignment, proof of value, commercial negotiation, and close. You will engage Fortune 1000 executives across Safety, Operations, IT, Risk, and Procurement and help customers rethink how work gets done through AI.

\n


Responsibilities Include:
  • Own enterprise sales opportunities from qualification through close.
  • Develop executive relationships across Safety, Operations, IT, Risk, and Procurement.
  • Lead consultative discovery and business value discussions.
  • Demonstrate Haven's platform and ROI.
  • Coordinate pilots and proof-of-value engagements.
  • Build business cases and ROI models.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement, security, and legal reviews.
  • Partner with Customer Success during implementation.
  • Represent Haven at industry events.
  • Consistently exceed revenue targets.


What Success Looks Like:

Within your first year you will close multiple enterprise customers, become a trusted advisor to senior EHS leaders, contribute to Haven's go-to-market strategy, and help establish Haven as the leader in AI-powered industrial safety.


Required Experience Includes:
  • 7+ years of enterprise B2B software sales.
  • Success selling into Fortune 1000 organizations.
  • Experience leading complex multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.
  • Consistent history of exceeding quota.
  • Experience building executive relationships with EHS, Operations, Risk, or Operational Excellence leaders.
  • Strong consultative selling skills.
  • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience navigating procurement, security, and legal reviews.


Nice to Haves Include:
  • AI or advanced analytics solutions.
  • Utilities, Oil & Gas, Construction, Manufacturing, Mining, Chemicals, or other high-risk industries.
  • Early-stage or venture-backed SaaS companies.
  • Experience with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDICC or Challenger.
  • Direct experience selling EHS (Environmental, Health & Safety) software solutions.


\n

Why Join Haven:
Build a new AI category, work directly with founders and enterprise customers, influence product direction, receive competitive compensation, uncapped commissions, equity participation, health benefits, and flexible working arrangements.

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Communication (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Corporate Communication (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1127

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

The Head of Corporate Communication is responsible for  the implementation and day-to-day management of  internal and external communications, CSR and sponsorship  initiatives, external relations, and stakeholder engagement,under the supervision and direction of  the Chief Communications Officer.

The role focuses on delivering impactful communication activities that enhance visibility, strengthen stakeholder engagement, and support the achievement of corporate goals. Working in close alignment with the Head of Branding and Marketing to ensure consistency of messaging, positioning and brand expression,  the Head of Corporate Communication interfaces with diverse internal and external stakeholders and proactively contributes to the successful implementation of the Bank's communications agenda. Strong relationship-building, communication, project management and leadership capabilities are essential to supporting and reinforcing BIL's reputation as an innovative and entrepreneurial Bank.

He/she reports to the Chief Communications Officer (CCO)..

Your next challenge:

External Communications:

Under the direction of the Chief Communications Officer, the Head of Corporate Communications:

• Coordinates communication support for corporate events, sponsorships, partnerships, and community initiatives.
• Coordinates the development and dissemination of press releases, media communications, corporate announcements, and external content.
• In alignment with the Head of Branding and Marketing, oversees the publication of corporate content across external communication channels, including the corporate website and social media platforms.
• Supports media engagement activities, including interview coordination, briefing preparation, and spokesperson support.
• Monitors media coverage and communication performance, providing recommendations to the Chief Communications Officer for continuous improvement.Contributes to reputation management activities and supports communication responses during issues or crisis situations.

Internal Communications

Under the direction of the Chief Communications Officer, the Head of Corporate Communications:

• Executes internal communication plans that support business priorities and organizational objectives.
• Oversees the delivery of timely, clear, and consistent communications to employees.
• Manages internal communication channels, including the intranet and employee communication platforms.
• Coordinates communications related to organizational developments, transformation projects, and change initiatives.
• Lead Townhall preparation and execution (logistics and content)

In alignment with HR, promotes the Bank's culture, values, purpose, and strategic priorities through effective internal storytelling.

• Coordinates communications relating to CSR, employee engagement, and corporate culture initiatives.
• Monitors employee feedback and communication effectiveness, proposing enhancements where appropriate.
Team and Functional Management

Under the direction of the Chief Communications Officer, the Head of Corporate Communications:

• Manages the day-to-day activities and performance of the Corporate Communications team.
• Ensures the efficient delivery of communication projects, campaigns, and initiatives.
• Provides guidance, coaching, and support to team members, fostering collaboration and professional development.
• Establishes effective processes and quality standards to ensure consistency across communication activities.
• Acts as a trusted communication partner for internal stakeholders, providing advice on communication planning and execution.
• Identifies opportunities to enhance communication impact through innovation, best practices, and new communication tools.
• Supports the Chief Communications Officer in achieving the objectives of the Communications function and the broader corporate agenda.
  
Your skills:

• 10+ years' professional experience at management level in Corporate Communications, Internal and External Communications, CSR, Media Relations and Corporate Events, including several years in a management position. Proven experience in developing and implementing communications plans, stakeholder engagement initiatives, sponsorship and high-profile events.
• Demonstrated ability to lead, develop and inspire communications professionals, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and innovation.
• Sound understanding of the regional, international and multicultural environments in which BIL operates.
• Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken. Luxemburgish would be an asset.
• Highly collaborative, with the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization.
• Strong team leader who inspires, coaches and develops others while fostering a positive and high-performance culture.
• Proactive and solutions-oriented, anticipating communication needs and responding effectively to emerging challenges.
• Excellent communicator with strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
• Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior management and external stakeholders.
• Organized and disciplined, capable of managing multiple priorities and delivering under tight deadlines.
• Resilient and composed under pressure, particularly in sensitive or fast-moving situations.
• Pragmatic and business-oriented, balancing creativity with operational effectiveness.
• Curious and innovative, continuously seeking new ways to enhance communication impact and engagement.
• High level of professional integrity, discretion and sound judgment.
• Results-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

• Fluency in French and English. Luxembourgish and/or German considered an asset.
• Strong understanding of banking products, business models, profitability drivers, financial planning processes and performance management. Knowledge of banking regulatory environment and capital considerations is an advantage.
• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills. Strong knowledge of financial planning, reporting and data visualization tools. Experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) systems, Power BI, Microstrategy, or similar tools is a plus.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Ability to engage and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.

• Strong leadership and change management capabilities.

If you have an entrepreneurial mind-set and are looking to constantly challenge yourself, J.P. Morgan is the place for you. You will be working alongside a team of talented colleagues from other markets, businesses and functions to provide you with the opportunity to take your career to the next level.

As a Banker in J.P. Morgan's Private Banking business, you would lead new client acquisition and retention through a broad knowledge of investments, banking, trust services and financial planning. This role is also responsible for the client experience and engaging our resources to deliver a complete wealth management solution.

Job responsibilities

• Prospect and acquire new clients and new assets from new and existing clients from Poland
• Maintain and further develop an existing book of business consisting of Ultra High Net Worth clients from Poland
• Responsible for sales and implementation of investment, banking and trust/estate products to core clients as appropriate.
• Leverage and coordinate specialists (Investor, Capital Advisor, Trust and Estate Advisor and Wealth Advisor) to provide interdisciplinary expertise for our most complex clients.
• Manage each account to ensure that the client has a completed profile and that accounts are properly maintained and serviced, specifically adhering to J.P. Morgan Risk Management policies.
• Build trust with clients and effectively manage relationships.
• Ensure that the proposed products and services maximize the clients' needs, goals and objectives.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
• Significant experience in Private Banking working with Polish UHNW individuals and families.
• Previous business development experience.
• Achievement oriented, focused on exceeding business goals with sufficient attention to detail.
• Proven sales success including: prospecting, profiling, overcoming objections, negotiation, team selling approach, closing the sale and asking for referrals.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
• Strong relationship management and team building skills; views team concept as critical to mode.
• Emirati male nationals must have completed or have no obligatory military service obligations.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

Bei uns gibt es viele Möglichkeiten, sich selbst zu verwirklichen und beruflich aufzusteigen. Wir bieten ein vielfältiges Angebot an Aus- und Weiterbildungen, darunter fachliche sowie überfachliche Qualifizierungen mit Fokus auf konkrete Positionen oder Karrierewege. GOURMET bietet als verlässlicher und familienfreundlicher Arbeitgeber darüber hinaus viele Vorteile sowie Sozial- und Zusatzleistungen (Rabatte in unseren Gastronomiebetrieben oder für GOURMET-Produkte, etc.), Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Gesundheitsförderungsmaßnahmen und fördert Chancengleichheit. Durch Ihren Bewerbungsprozess führt Sie Christina Heigl. Bei Fragen oder Anliegen nehmen Sie sehr gerne direkt Kontakt auf. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

jobs.title: UČITELJ/ICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“, br. 87/08., 86/09., 92/10., 105/10., 90/11., 16/12., 86/12., 94/13., 152/14., 7/17., 68/18., 98/19., 64/20., 151/22. i 156/23.) i članka 6. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Vladimira Nazora Pazin, Osnovna škola Vladimira Nazora Pazin, raspisuje

N A T J E Č A J

Za popunu slobodnih radnih mjesta:

1. UČITELJ/ICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE (M/Ž) - 1 izvršitelj na nepuno, određeno radno vrijeme (12 sati tjedno) za rad u produženom boravku u Područnoj školi Lupoglav

Osim općih uvjeta sukladno općim propisima o radu kandidati moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete iz čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti životopis i preslike:

  • diplome odnosno drugog dokaza o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaza o državljanstvu,
  • rodnog lista,
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak u Republici Hrvatskoj, ne starije od 3 (tri) mjeseca u skladu s člankom 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi,
  • elektronički ispis radne knjižice.

Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji.

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata.

Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja biti će pozvani na procjenu u skladu s odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Vladimira Nazora Pazin (http://os-vnazora-pazin.skole.hr/dokumenti).

U skladu s Uredbom Europske unije 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 17. travnja 2016. godine te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“, br. 42/18.) prijavom na natječaj osoba daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a sve u svrhu provedbe natječaja za zasnivanje radnog odnosa.

Pri sklapanju ugovora o radu s odabranim kandidatima odredit će se probni rad u skladu s člankom 20. Pravilnika o radu Osnovne škole Vladimira Nazora Pazin.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Rok za prijavu kandidata je od 23. srpnja do 4. kolovoza 2026. godine.

Prijave s dokumentima dostaviti osobno ili poštom na adresu škole: Osnovna škola Vladimira Nazora Pazin, Šetalište Pazinske gimnazije 9, 52 000 Pazin, s naznakom „Prijava na natječaj - upisati naziv radnog mjesta za koje se kandidat prijavljuje“.

Dokumentaciju priloženu uz prijavu na natječaj Škola ne vraća.

Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka kao i poziv na procjenu bit će objavljeni na mrežnim stranicama Škole.

jobs.title: STRUČNI/A SURADNIK/CA U SUSTAVU ZNANOSTI I VISOKOM OBRAZOVANJU
jobs.employer: Sveučilište u Osijeku, Fakultet agrobiotehničkih znanosti Osijek
jobs.description:
SVEUČILIŠTE JOSIPA JURJA STROSSMAYERA U OSIJEKU

FAKULTET AGROBIOTEHNIČKIH ZNANOSTI OSIJEK

raspisuje

NATJEČAJ

za izbor

jednog zaposlenika/zaposlenice na radnom mjestu I. vrste – stručnog suradnika u sustavu znanosti i visokom obrazovanju iz znanstvenog područja Biotehničkih znanosti, znanstvenog polja poljoprivreda za rad na projektu „AgroAI 360; Automatizirani, digitalizirani i optimizirani poljoprivredni uvidi i odluke“ na određeno vrijeme u punom radnom vremenu do povratka privremeno nenazočne zaposlenice s rodiljnog dopusta

Svi kandidati na Natječaj moraju ispunjavati opće uvjete propisane Zakonom o radu „Narodne novine" broj 93/14., 127/17., 98/19., 151/22., 46/23. i 64/23.).

Kandidat na natječaj osim općih uvjeta propisanih Zakonom o radu obvezan je ispuniti uvjete propisane člankom 123. stavak 6. Statuta Sveučilišta Josipa Jurja Strossmayera u Osijeku i člankom 51. stavak 6. Statuta Fakulteta agrobiotehničkih znanosti Osijek i to:

- završen sveučilišni diplomski studij iz znanstvenog područja Biotehničkih znanosti, znanstvenog polja poljoprivreda i

- jednu godinu radnog iskustva u struci ili objavljen jedan znanstveni ili stručni rad.

Kandidat na natječaj prijavljuje se na obrascu br. 6A – prijava na natječaj za rad na projektu koji je objavljen na http://www.fazos.unios.hr/fakultet/otvoreni-natjecaji

Uz prijavu na natječaj kandidat je obvezan priložiti: životopis, izvornik ili ovjerenu presliku diplome o završenom sveučilišnom diplomskom studiju, ukoliko ima stečen akademski stupanj, izvornik ili ovjerenu presliku diplome o stečenom akademskom stupnju magistra znanosti odnosno o stečenom akademskom stupnju doktora znanosti, dokaz o radnom iskustvu u struci (elektronički zapis o podatcima osiguranja Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (e-radna knjižica), potvrdu poslodavca o vrsti poslova koje je kandidat obavljao i trajanju radnog odnosa ili drugi odgovarajući dokaz o radnom iskustvu i/ili popis radova i radove te popunjen i potpisani obrazac privole za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka u svrhu provedbe natječaja.

Na mrežnoj stranici Sveučilišta Josipa Jurja Strossmayera u Osijeku, Fakulteta agrobiotehničkih znanosti Osijek https://www.fazos.unios.hr/fakultet/otvoreni-natjecaji naveden je opis poslova za radna mjesta.

Na natječaj se, pod jednakim uvjetima, mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravovremenu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u ovom natječaju i koja je vlastoručno potpisana od kandidata koji je podnio prijavu na natječaj. Nepravovremene i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Svi kandidati na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja moraju pristupiti pisanom testiranju i/ili razgovoru, a o mjestu i vremenu održavanja pisanog testiranja i/ili razgovora bit će obaviješteni putem mrežnih stranica Fakulteta i putem elektroničke pošte. Za kandidate koji ne pristupe testiranju i/ili razgovoru po pozivu za testiranje smatrat će se da su povukli prijavu na Natječaj i neće se smatrati kandidatom na natječaj.

Kandidati koji na temelju posebnih propisa - Zakon o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN br. 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21.), članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rada (NN br. 84/21.) i članak 48.f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN br. 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), članak 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, obvezni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze kojе posebni propisi propisuju za ostvarivanje tog prava. Navedeni kandidati ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju u odnosu na ostale pristupnike, samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Za kandidate koji se u prijavi na natječaj pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rada i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN br. 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21.) i Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN br. 84/21.) popis dokaza potreban za ostvarivanje tog prava dostupan je na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) u prijavi na natječaj dužni su se pozvati se na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu.

Svi kandidati na natječaj bit će obaviješteni o rezultatima natječaja najkasnije u roku od (15) dana od dana njegova dovršetka.

Svaki kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu da se svi njegovi osobni podaci sadržani natječajnoj dokumentaciji prikupljaju i obrađuju u svrhu provedbe natječaja u skladu s propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka posebno Uredbom Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. o zaštiti pojedinca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka te o stavljanju izvan snage Direktive 95/46/EZ (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka). Svaki kandidat na natječaj obvezan je priložiti potpisan i popunjen Obrazac privole koji je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama Fakulteta agrobiotehničkih znanosti Osijek https://www.fazos.unios.hr/fakultet/otvoreni-natjecaji Bez uredno popunjenog potpisanog Obrasca privole uz prijavu na Natječaj, prijava će se smatrati nepotpunom i odbacit će se.

Svi kandidati na natječaj prijave s prilozima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja dostavljaju u pisanom obliku u jednom primjerku i u elektroničkom obliku na CD-u ili USB-u, u pdf. formatu u roku od 50 (pedeset) dana od dana objave natječaja u „Narodnim novinama“.

Prijave se podnose na adresu: Sveučilište Josipa Jurja Strossmayera u Osijeku, Fakultet agrobiotehničkih znanosti Osijek, Ulica Vladimira Preloga 1, P.P. 310, 31000 Osijek s naznakom "prijava na natječaj – pod točkom ___“

jobs.title: RADNIK/RADNICA U ODRŽAVANJU
jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • Održavanje okoliša redovitom košnjom travnjaka
  • Obrezivanje grmlja, živica i ukrasnog bilja
  • Briga o vinogradu, ukrasnim biljkama i ostalim zelenim površinama
  • Zalijevanje biljaka, travnjaka i drugih zelenih površina prema potrebi
  • Održavanje okoliša objekata urednim, čistim i sigurnim za korištenje
  • Obavljanje ličilačkih (soboslikarskih) radova prema potrebi
  • Izvođenje sitnih popravaka i osnovnih radova održavanja na objektima i opremi
  • Rukovanje, pravilno korištenje te redovito održavanje vrtlarskih alata, strojeva i druge radne opreme
  • Redovita kontrola spremnika za otpad te njihovo iznošenje na dan organiziranog odvoza otpada
  • Pravodobno podnošenje zahtjeva upravi tvrtke za nabavu materijala, alata i drugih sredstava potrebnih za nesmetano obavljanje poslova
  • Samostalno planiranje i organiziranje dnevnih radnih zadataka uz učinkovito upravljanje vremenom
  • Suradnja s ostalim zaposlenicima te sposobnost samostalnog rada ili rada kao dio tima
  • Obavljanje drugih poslova održavanja imanja prema nalogu poslodavca, u skladu s potrebama procesa rada
Uvjeti:
  • dobro opće zdravstveno stanje
  • fizička sposobnost za obavljanje poslova koji uključuju rad na otvorenom, dugotrajno hodanje i stajanje, podizanje i prenošenje tereta te rukovanje alatima i opremom
  • sposobnost sigurnog rada uz pridržavanje propisanih mjera zaštite na radu
  • odgovoran odnos prema radu, imovini i radnoj opremi

Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja biti će pozvani na procjenu u skladu s odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Vladimira Nazora Pazin (http://os-vnazora-pazin.skole.hr/dokumenti).

U skladu s Uredbom Europske unije 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 17. travnja 2016. godine te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“, br. 42/18.) prijavom na natječaj osoba daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a sve u svrhu provedbe natječaja za zasnivanje radnog odnosa.

Pri sklapanju ugovora o radu s odabranim kandidatima odredit će se probni rad u skladu s člankom 20. Pravilnika o radu Osnovne škole Vladimira Nazora Pazin.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Rok za prijavu kandidata je od 23. srpnja do 4. kolovoza 2026. godine.

Prijave s dokumentima dostaviti osobno ili poštom na adresu škole: Osnovna škola Vladimira Nazora Pazin, Šetalište Pazinske gimnazije 9, 52 000 Pazin, s naznakom „Prijava na natječaj - upisati naziv radnog mjesta za koje se kandidat prijavljuje“.

Dokumentaciju priloženu uz prijavu na natječaj Škola ne vraća.

Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka kao i poziv na procjenu bit će objavljeni na mrežnim stranicama Škole.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti životopis i preslike:

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja biti će pozvani na procjenu u skladu s odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Vladimira Nazora Pazin (http://os-vnazora-pazin.skole.hr/dokumenti).

U skladu s Uredbom Europske unije 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 17. travnja 2016. godine te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“, br. 42/18.) prijavom na natječaj osoba daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a sve u svrhu provedbe natječaja za zasnivanje radnog odnosa.

Pri sklapanju ugovora o radu s odabranim kandidatima odredit će se probni rad u skladu s člankom 20. Pravilnika o radu Osnovne škole Vladimira Nazora Pazin.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

  • financijsko i administrativno praćenje provedbe projekata

  • SSS/VSS/VŠS

  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu, osobito alata MS Office
  • samostalno korištenje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu, najmanje na razini B1
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije i aktivno vozačko iskustvo
Tražene osobine i kompetencije: Tražimo osobu koja:
  • odgovorno, precizno i organizirano pristupa radu
  • može samostalno obavljati povjerene zadatke, ali je istodobno spremna na timski rad
  • pokazuje inicijativu, prilagodljivost i usmjerenost na rješavanje problema
  • ima razvijene komunikacijske i organizacijske vještine
  • spremna je kontinuirano učiti i profesionalno se usavršavati
Prednost imaju kandidati koji posjeduju:
  • iskustvo rada na projektima financiranim sredstvima Europske unije ili drugih donatora
  • praktično iskustvo u administrativnim i računovodstvenim poslovima
  • iskustvo rada u organizacijama civilnog društva
Način prijave: Prijave se podnose isključivo putem e-pošte na adresu: posao@zeleni-osijek.hr U predmet poruke potrebno je upisati: IME I PREZIME – PROJEKTNI ASISTENT/ICA Uz prijavu je potrebno priložiti:
  • životopis – obvezno
  • presliku svjedodžbe ili diplome o završenom obrazovanju – obvezno
  • motivacijsko pismo – obvezno
  • potvrde o završenim programima neformalnog obrazovanja, edukacijama ili tečajevima – poželjno
  • preporuke prethodnih poslodavaca – poželjno.
Rok za podnošenje prijava je 10. kolovoza 2026. godine do 16:00 sati. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja i odgovaraju traženom profilu bit će pozvani na razgovor te, prema potrebi, na provjeru znanja, sposobnosti i vještina. Razgovori i testiranja mogu se provoditi i prije isteka roka za podnošenje prijava.

  1. Završen preddiplomski i diplomski sveučilišni studij socijalnog rada, ili preddiplomski sveučilišni studij socijalnog rada i diplomski sveučilišni studij socijalne politike ili integrirani preddiplomski i diplomski sveučilišni studij socijalnog rada
  2. Radno iskustvo u struci: 1 godina
  3. Položen stručni ispit
  4. Položen vozački ispit B kategorije
  5. Odobrenje za rad Hrvatske komore socijalnih radnika
  6. Nepostojanje zapreke iz članka 261. Zakona o socijalnoj skrbi ( Narodne novine“ broj 18/22, 46/22 i 119/22,71/23,156/23,61/25)
Probni rad ugovara se u trajanju od 3 mjeseca. Uz prijavu na natječaj kandidati/kandidatkinje su dužni priložiti slijedeće dokumente:
  1. Životopis
  2. Preslika domovnice
  3. Preslika osobne iskaznice
  4. Preslika diplome
  5. Elektronički zapis o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje
  6. Preslika uvjerenja o položenom stručnom ispitu
  7. Preslika odobrenja za samostalan rad izdana od nadležne komore (važeća licenca)
  8. Uvjerenje nadležnog suda da protiv kandidata/kandidatkinje nije pokrenut i da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 30 dana)
  9. Preslika vozačke dozvole
Kandidat/kandidatkinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan/na je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, odnosno priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati/kandidatkinje koji/e ispunjavaju sve uvjete iz natječaja mogu biti pozvani/e na razgovor i testiranje.   • Iskustvo s projektima sustava pohrane energije (BESS).

  • Odlično znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu je obavezno.

jobs.title: SKLADIŠTAR / SKLADIŠTARKA
jobs.description:
Postani dio tima Antela d.o.o.! Antela d.o.o. više od 10 godina uspješno posluje u Hrvatskoj te se bavi proizvodnjom i distribucijom papirnate galanterije, personaliziranih papirnatih salveta i papirnatih slamki. Zbog kontinuiranog rasta i širenja poslovanja ulažemo u budućnost – krajem ove godine proizvodnju selimo u novi, suvremeni proizvodni pogon u Čabdinu (Jastrebarsko), dok glavno skladište ostaje u Bonacima (Baderna). Upravo zato tražimo odgovornu i motiviranu osobu koja će se pridružiti našem timu i zajedno s nama sudjelovati u daljnjem razvoju tvrtke.

Opis posla:
  • utovar i istovar robe
  • priprema i kontrola robe za otpremu
  • zaprimanje i kontrola pristigle robe
  • slaganje i organizacija robe u skladištu
  • briga o urednosti skladišta i radnog prostora
Od kandidata očekujemo:
  • KV ili SSS
  • poželjno prethodno radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima (nije uvjet)
  • poželjno položen ispit za vozača viličara (nije uvjet)
  • odgovornost, samostalnost i točnost u radu
  • spremnost na timski rad
Nudimo:
  • rad u jednoj smjeni
  • redovita i sigurna primanja
  • dugoročan i stabilan posao u uspješnoj hrvatskoj tvrtki
  • ugodno i dinamično radno okruženje
  • mogućnost profesionalnog razvoja i napredovanja
  • priliku da budete dio tvrtke koja kontinuirano raste i ulaže u nove proizvodne kapacitete

jobs.title: KUSTOS/ICA, ODJEL ZA STRUČNE MUZEJSKE POSLOVE-DOKUMENTACIJA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 27. Statuta Arheološkog muzeja Osijek, a u skladu s odredbama Pravilnika o unutarnjem ustrojstvu i sistematizaciji radnih mjesta Arheološkog muzeja Osijek, uz prethodnu suglasnost Ministarstva kulture i medija RH, Klasa: 112-01/26-01/0097, Urbroj: 532-02-01/1-26-02 od 8. srpnja 2026. godine, ravnatelj Arheološkog muzeja Osijek, Tomislav Hršak dana 22. srpnja 2026. godine objavljuje NATJEČAJ za prijam u radni odnos jednog (1) zaposlenika radi popunjavanja radnog mjesta: Kustos/ica, Odjel za stručne muzejske poslove-dokumentacija - 1 izvršitelj/ica na neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme uz probni rad od (6) šest mjeseci Uvjeti:
  • završen sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ili s njim izjednačen studij humanističkog smjera, prednost arheologija
  • položen stručni ispit za kustosa
  • znanje jednog stranog jezika
  • znanje rada na računalu
  • znanje rada u bazama podataka
  • znanje rada na računalu u Windows radnoj okolini s programima za grafičku obradu i oblikovanje (npr. Autocad, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator i sl.)
Uz pisanu prijavu kandidat treba obvezno priložiti:
  • prijavu na natječaj
  • životopis, vlastoručno potpisan (iz kojeg je vidljivo da kandidat zadovoljava sve uvjete natječaja)
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (preslika domovnice)
  • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (preslika diploma)
  • dokaz o poznavanju stranog jezika (presliku svjedodžbe srednje škole, indeksa, prijepisa ocjena iz kojih je vidljivo da je položen predmet jednog stranog svjetskog jezika, certifikata ili potvrde odgovarajuće institucije koja provodi izobrazbu stranog jezika ili vlastoručno potpisanu Izjavu,)
  • dokaz o poznavanju rada na računalu, bazama podataka, programima za grafičku obradu i oblikovanje (presliku svjedodžbe srednje škole, indeksa, prijepisa ocjena iz kojih je vidljivo da je položen predmet informatika, potvrde o završenom tečaju ili vlastoručnu potpisanu Izjavu)
  • dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu za kustosa (ako je ispit položen)
  • elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (e-Radna knjižica) preuzet iz sustava e Građani ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje koju Zavod na osobno traženje osiguranika izdaje na šalterima područnih službi/ureda Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, ne stariji od dana objave ovog natječaja
  • uvjerenje Općinskog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od šest mjeseci)
  • popunjen i potpisan obrazac suglasnosti za korištenje osobnih podataka (obrazac dostupan na web stranici Arheološkog muzeja Osijek)
Plaću čini umnožak koeficijenta za obračun plaće radnog mjesta za koje je zaposlenik sklopio ugovor o radu i osnovice za obračun plaće sukladno Odluci o visini osnovice za obračun plaće zaposlenicima u javnim službama u 2026. godini (NN 11/26) uvećano za dodatak za radni staž u iznosu 0,5% po godini radnoga staža (koeficijent za obračun plaće je 2,00) Isprave se prilažu u preslici, a izabrani kandidat predočit će dokumentaciju u izvorniku/ovjerenoj preslici. Priložena natječajna dokumentacija se ne vraća. Prijava treba sadržavati najmanje sljedeće podatke: ime i prezime kandidata, adresu, broj telefona i adresu elektroničke pošte za primanje obavijesti. Prijavom na natječaj, prijavljeni kandidati izričito su suglasni da Arheološki muzej Osijek kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka, može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati osobne podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno Zakonu o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN, broj 42/18) i Uredbe (EU) 2016/679. Prijavu na natječaj potrebno je vlastoručno potpisati. Na natječaj se mogu javiti i osobe koje nemaju prethodno položen stručni ispit za kustosa, ali su ga dužne položiti sukladno Pravilniku o stručnim muzejskim zvanjima i drugim zvanjima u muzejskoj djelatnosti te uvjetima i načinu njihova stjecanja, na prvom roku nakon stjecanja uvjeta za polaganje istoga. Na natječaj za prijam u radni odnos mogu se prijaviti osobe oba spola. Riječi i pojmovi koji imaju rodno značenje korišteni u ovom natječaju odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod bez obzira jesu li korišteni u muškom ili ženskom rodu. Arheološki muzej Osijek zadržava pravo da, ukoliko ocijeni da je potrebno, provede postupak selekcije kandidata putem razgovora (intervjua) i/ili provjere radnih sposobnosti. O vremenu održavanja razgovora / provjere radnih sposobnosti kandidati/kinje će se obavijestiti putem dostavljenih e-mail adresa ili telefonski. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju uvjete propisane javnim natječajem bit će pozvani na razgovor. Kandidat koji se ne odazove na poziv za razgovor smatrat će se da je odustao od natječaja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi razgovoru / provjeri radnih sposobnosti, smatrat će se da je povukao/la prijavu na natječaj te se u daljnjem postupku više neće smatrati kandidatom. Odluku o izboru kandidata donosi ravnatelj vodeći računa o interesima, profesionalnim ciljevima i motivaciji kandidata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti kod prijema u javnu službu prema članku 102. Zakona o pravima hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21.), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine br. 33/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.), članku 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21.)dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati na to pravo te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 102. Zakona o pravima branitelja iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN121/17,98/19 i 84/21) dužni su priložiti sve potrebne dokaze navedene na: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti civilnih i vojnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13,152/14,39/18 i 32/20), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti i dokaz o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata Zakon o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) dužni su priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. navedenoga Zakona. Popis dokumenta potrebnih za ostvarivanje prednosti pri zapošljavanju dostupan je na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Natječaj za zasnivanje radnog odnosa objavljen je na mrežnim stranicama Muzeja, Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te Ministarstva kulture i medija RH. Prijave na natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta podnose se u roku od 8 (osam) dana od objave natječaja na adresu: Arheološki muzej Osijek Trg Svetog Trojstva 2 31000 Osijek s naznakom „ Za natječaj Kustos/ica- Odjel za stručne muzejske poslove-dokumentacija – NE OTVARAJ“. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u tekstu ovoga natječaja. Nepotpune i nepravovremeno pristigle prijave, kao i prijave kandidata koji ne ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, neće se razmatrati. Muzej zadržava pravo u svako vrijeme poništiti natječaj, odnosno ne donijeti odluku o izboru kandidata. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni javnom objavom Odluke o izboru kandidata na mrežnoj stranici Arheološki muzej Osijek www.amo.hr. Dostava Odluke o izboru kandidata za radno mjesto kustos/ica - 1 izvršitelj/ica na neodređeno vrijeme u Odjel za stručno muzejske poslove (dokumentacija) smatra se obavljenom istekom osmoga dana od objave na mrežnoj stranici Arheološkog muzeja Osijek, www.amo.hr.

jobs.title: SEO/GSO Specialist (m/f/d) - part time (Onlinemarketing-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Become SEO/GSO Specialist (m/f/d) - part time at Retarus.

Retarus is a worldwide provider of cloud-based messaging solutions at enterprise scale. We serve over 40% of the companies listed on the S&P Global 100, e.g. Adidas, Bayer, SAP, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, T-Systems, Swarovski & UPS, as well as governmental agencies and major players in markets across the world. Privately owned and founder-managed for over thirty years, Retarus is customer-oriented, stable, a fair employer, and a strategic business partner with a long-term vision. With some 500 employees in 19 offices on four continents, Retarus operates locally and thinks globally: our teams are organized across borders and are highly integrated. This makes Retarus a multicultural, multilingual, and engaging workplace. We are committed to creating a diverse and dynamic environment for our employees, with generous compensation, time off, and a global, collaborative workplace.

What we offer

- Mobile working and flexible working time
- Collaborative, diverse company culture and superior team spirit
- Flat hierarchies and great feedback culture
- Development opportunities & career perspective
- International business & cross-site collaboration
- Modern, dog-friendly offices with nice amenities
- Company-paid health insurance, public transportation, lunch vouchers and further benefits

What you´ll do

- Own Regional Search Strategy: Build and execute the regional SEO/GSO roadmap for France, Spain, and Italy with a focus on pipeline contribution and revenue impact. Drive keyword and intent research across the enterprise buying journey, identify content gaps, and increase visibility among key decision-makers in strategic industries.
- Technical SEO: Ensure technical excellence across regional domains by managing site health, conducting audits, and optimizing page architecture, internal linking, and content structures in close collaboration with the web development team.
- Generative Search Optimization (GSO): Lead Retarus' visibility across AI-driven search platforms such as Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, and ChatGPT Search. Optimize content, metadata, and authority signals, and develop AI-citable assets to maximize inclusion in generative search results.
- Content, Campaign, and ABM Alignment: Partner with Content Marketing, Product Marketing, ABM, and regional marketing teams to develop search-optimized content and campaigns, align keyword strategies with target accounts and verticals, and support digital PR and authority-building initiatives.
- Experimentation & Competitive Intelligence: Drive continuous optimization through structured testing, competitive analysis, monitoring of algorithm changes, and identification of opportunities to improve search visibility and conversion performance.
- Measurement & Reporting: Define and track SEO/GSO KPIs, build executive-level dashboards, report performance to key stakeholders, and support marketing attribution by measuring organic search impact across the customer journey.

What you'll need

- 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience in B2B technology, SaaS, or enterprise software environments, with a proven track record supporting complex, multi-stakeholder buying journeys
- Deep expertise in technical SEO, including site architecture, crawl optimization, Core Web Vitals, structured data, hreflang, and international SEO, as well as a solid understanding of Generative Search Optimization (GSO) and AI-driven search
- Proficiency with industry-standard SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush and/or Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog or comparable crawlers
- Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with the ability to translate search data into actionable business insights and communicate effectively

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager (m/f/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Become Senior Account Manager (m/f/d) at Retarus.

Retarus is a worldwide provider of cloud-based messaging solutions at enterprise scale. We serve over 40% of the companies listed on the S&P Global 100, e.g. Adidas, Bayer, SAP, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, T-Systems, Swarovski & UPS, as well as governmental agencies and major players in markets across the world. Privately owned and founder-managed for over thirty years, Retarus is customer-oriented, stable, a fair employer, and a strategic business partner with a long-term vision. With some 500 employees in 19 offices on four continents, Retarus operates locally and thinks globally: our teams are organized across borders and are highly integrated. This makes Retarus a multicultural, multilingual, and engaging workplace. We are committed to creating a diverse and dynamic environment for our employees, with generous compensation, time off, and a global, collaborative workplace.

What we offer

- Mobile working and flexible working time
- Collaborative, diverse company culture and superior team spirit
- Flat hierarchies and great feedback culture
- Development opportunities & career perspective
- International business & cross-site collaboration
- Modern, dog-friendly offices with nice amenities
- Company-paid health insurance, public transportation, lunch vouchers and further benefits

What you'll do

- Own the full new-business sales cycle end to end: prospecting (direct outreach, events, and partner channels), opportunity management, negotiation, and closing.
- Build a qualified pipeline from scratch and convert it into new customers in the Spanish market.
- Sell software solutions to mid-market and enterprise customers with medium-length sales cycles (typically 6–12 months, sometimes longer).
- Work closely with the pre-sales team, who will support you during technical discussions and solution design.
- Develop market presence, especially in underdeveloped verticals such as transportation, logistics, and tourism.
- Work with clear, realistic targets and maintain structured reporting and close collaboration with the wider team.

What you'll need

- A completed commercial apprenticeship or a degree in economics, sales, or a related field; motivated career changers with a strong drive for sales are also welcome.
- Several years of proven experience in new customer acquisition, ideally in a B2B or SaaS environment, allowing you to work autonomously and create impact quickly.
- Demonstrated hunter mentality with a clear focus on new business development and new customer acquisition.
- Resilience and persistence when facing initial market resistance and managing longer sales cycles.
- A collaborative, dependable working style that contributes to strong team fit and sustainable cooperation.
- A serious, credible, and professional sales approach, focused on substance rather than hype.
- Solid understanding of the Spanish market and its business landscape.
