Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Bevorzugte Standorte für diese Position sind Deutschland, Portugal und Polen. Bewerbungen aus anderen Ländern der EMEA-Region (Europa, Naher Osten und Afrika) können ebenfalls berücksichtigt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie stellen einheitliche Governance-Standards über das gesamte Dienstleisterportfolio hinweg sicher.- Sie steuern die täglichen Beziehungen zu den Ihnen zugeordneten Service Providern und stellen sicher, dass die Leistungserbringung den geschäftlichen Anforderungen entspricht.- Sie übernehmen die Rolle des primären fachlichen Verantwortlichen für ausgewählte Dienstleisterkategorien (z. B. Relocation-, Umzugs- und Destination-Services).- Sie definieren und überwachen die Leistung der Dienstleister anhand vertraglicher Verpflichtungen durch SLAs, KPIs und Scorecards und führen regelmäßige operative Reviews sowie Leistungsgespräche durch.- Sie fungieren als Eskalationsinstanz für dienstleisterbezogene Service-Themen und treiben die Lösung von Problemen, Ursachenanalysen (Root-Cause-Analysen) sowie Korrekturmaßnahmen voran.- Sie treiben Initiativen zur Konsolidierung und Rationalisierung von Dienstleistern voran, um die Lieferantenlandschaft zu vereinfachen, Effizienzsteigerungen zu erzielen, Kosten zu senken und die Employee Experience zu verbessern.- Sie unterstützen die Implementierung von Verträgen und stellen sicher, dass vertragliche Vereinbarungen operativ umgesetzt werden, einschließlich der Einrichtung von Abrechnungsstrukturen, Bestellprozessen, Kostenallokationen und der Rechnungsprüfung.- Sie erhöhen die finanzielle Transparenz innerhalb des Global-Mobility-Portfolios.- Sie arbeiten eng mit Einkauf, Finanzen, Recht, HR und weiteren Stakeholdern in Bezug auf Dienstleisterperformance, Rechnungsgenauigkeit, Vertragsverlängerungen und Beschaffungsentscheidungen zusammen.- Sie unterstützen Compliance-, Risikomanagement- und Audit-Anforderungen und gewährleisten die Kontinuität der Dienstleisterleistungen in Veränderungsphasen.- Sie identifizieren Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Vendor-Management-Prozessen, Governance-Rahmenwerken, Reporting-Strukturen und der Servicebereitstellung.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.- Sie bringen mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vendor Management, in HR Operations, Shared Services, Global Mobility oder im Professional-Services-Umfeld mit.- Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit einem Bachelorabschluss und zusätzlicher einschlägiger Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich sind ebenfalls herzlich willkommen.- Sie verfügen über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung und dem Management ausgelagerter Dienstleister in einem komplexen internationalen Umfeld.- Sie besitzen ein fundiertes Verständnis von Service Delivery, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Governance-Strukturen und Performance Management.- Sie haben Erfahrung in der bereichsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Teams aus Einkauf, Finanzen, Recht, HR, IT, Risiko- und Compliance-Management.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlich langjähriger Berufserfahrung und weiteren Qualifikationen in diesem Bereich.

jobs.title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

jobs.title: (Senior) Demand Planner (all genders), Prag (Demand Planner)
jobs.description: Ist unsere Story auch deine Story? Wenn Kinder die authentischen Figuren und Spielsets von schleich® in die Hand nehmen, eröffnen sich wunderbare Fantasiewelten. Jeder Dinosaurier, jeder Elefant, jede Elfe ist der Beginn einer aufregenden Story. Unsere Vision: ,,Shaping Storytellers for life". Und deine Geschichte bei schleich® beginnt hier. Lass uns zusammen nicht nur die Freude am Geschichtenerzählen wecken, sondern auch die Story von schleich® weitererzählen ­- vom traditionellen Spielzeughersteller zur Global Love Brand. Werde Teil unserer aufregenden Transformationsstory. Wir vertrauen dir, geben dir Ownership und die Möglichkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld international und digital zu arbeiten. Wir packen gemeinsam alle Herausforderungen an, die in der Zukunft noch auf uns warten. Nutze deine Chance, mit uns zu wachsen und wirklich etwas zu erreichen. Working at Schleich. Make your mark. (Senior) Demand Planner (all genders) Bitte beachte, dass diese Position im Rahmen unseres hybriden Arbeitsmodells in Prag angesiedelt ist. Umzugshilfe wird nicht angeboten. Folgende Abenteuer warten bei Schleich auf dich: Du gestaltest den globalen Demand Plan über internationale Märkte hinweg als Teil unserer zentral gesteuerten Demand & Supply Planning Organisation. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Demand-Planning- und S&OP-Prozesse und prägst aktiv, wie Planning Excellence bei schleich® gelebt wird. Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Finance und Supply Planning weltweit zusammen, um eine abgestimmte Sicht auf die zukünftige Nachfrage sicherzustellen. Du verantwortest die Forecast-Erstellung für Produktneueinführungen, saisonale Kampagnen und trendgetriebene Sortimente. Du übersetzt Markttrends und Geschäftsdaten in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für relevante Entscheidungsträger. Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Verbesserung der Forecast-Qualität und Planungsperformance und setzt entsprechende Maßnahmen um. Du gestaltest Prozesse, Tools und Arbeitsweisen im Rahmen unserer laufenden Transformation aktiv mit und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter. Du nutzt SAP IBP, Power BI und moderne Analysemethoden, um datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen und die Planung auf das nächste Level zu heben. Die Kapitel deiner bisherigen Story: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Supply Chain Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Demand Planning, Forecasting und S&OP in einem internationalen FMCG-, Consumer-Goods-, Spielwaren- oder ähnlich dynamischen Umfeld. Fundierte Erfahrung mit SAP IBP Demand Planning sowie die Fähigkeit, Daten in relevante Business-Entscheidungen zu übersetzen. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power BI, Excel und weiteren Planungs- und Reporting-Tools. Kommunikationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, Stakeholder unterschiedlicher Funktionen, Märkte und Hierarchieebenen erfolgreich einzubinden und zu überzeugen. Erfahrung in der Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Planungsprozesse, Projekte und kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen. Proaktive, lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit dem Anspruch, Bestehendes zu hinterfragen und neue Wege zu gestalten. Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse. Grundkenntnisse in Python sowie Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Weder Königreiche noch Goldberge - aber viele andere Belohnungen: Arbeite in einem abwechslungsreichen Umfeld mit individuellen Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie Zugang zu einer Vielzahl an Onlinekursen über unsere Weiterbildungsplattform Gemeinsam schreiben wir schleich® Geschichte. Werde Teil eines motivierten Teams, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und zusammen Erfolge feiert Dein Einstieg bei uns zahlt sich aus! Freu dich auf eine faire und attraktive Vergütung, ergänzt durch Zusatzleistungen, die wir regelmäßig prüfen und anpassen Genieße außerdem die Vorteile eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells: 3 Tage im Office, 2 Tage Remote Bleib aktiv! Mit der MultiSport-Mitgliedschaft hast du in ganz Tschechien Zugang zu zahlreichen Sport- und Freizeitangeboten Das schmeckt! Je nach Standort erhältst du ein Verpflegungsbudget (für München bis zu 75,00 EUR netto monatlich und für Prag bis zu 82,60 CZK pro Arbeitstag) Jeder Held und jede Heldin geht mal in Rente. Deshalb bieten wir dir eine geförderte Altersvorsorge Freu dich über tolle Rabatte auf unsere schleich® Produkte, die nicht nur Kinderherzen höherschlagen lassen Spare in München zusätzlich mit Corporate Benefits und entdecke eine Welt exklusiver Rabatte für verschiedene Marken und Aktivitäten Apropos Geld sparen: Für den Standort München bezuschussen wir auch das Leasing eines Fahrrads Pause von den Abenteuern bei Schleich? Freu dich über 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell ohne Kernarbeitszeiten Du möchtest eine aktive Rolle in unserer Story spielen? jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
About Co-Star

Someone downloads CoâStar every 5 seconds.

In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app. Big Sean has rapped about us, Ariana Grande & Kevin Durant post screenshots to their IGs, and we've been App of the Day twice. We've been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of NYT Style. We have a global following, in 193 countries â missing just North Korea and Eritrea.

We don't pay for marketing â we designed the app to go viral, and it did.

Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years.

Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you're experiencing, and how you relate to other people â in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It's a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.

Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on. An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.

We're merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.

Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, CoâStar generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes â a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person's unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. CoâStar combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called "wildly beautiful."

We're a small, experienced team.

Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).

About The Brand Designer Role

We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what's now but what's next.

You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows.

What you'll do

  • Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches â from concept through finished assets
  • Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery
  • Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate
  • Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like
  • Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team

You might be a fit if

  • You're a senior IC â roughly 5â8 years in â with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital
  • Typography and composition are your first language
  • You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them
  • You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet
  • You work well remotely and independently

Nice to have

  • Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines)
  • Motion or illustration
  • You already make things with generative tools

Logistics

  • Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow
  • Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)

To apply

Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

jobs.title: Ecommerce Specialist
jobs.description:
Looking for a hands-on associate to execute the day-to-day Shopify work that keeps our site running; Product builds, storefront assets management, collection management, and merchandising updates.

This is a junior role built for someone early in their ecommerce career who wants to learn how a

fast-moving DTC site gets built and managed day-to-day. A successful candidate will be the person

actually in Shopify admin every day, supporting the team, and escalating clearly when something needs deeper technical attention.

Core Responsibilities

â Own day-to-day product and storefront execution

â Build products in Shopify: structural setup, tagging, image uploads, populate copy, manage

metafields

â Manage collections: update, add or remove products, assets, metafields, and rules

â Update storefront assets: banners, links, imagery, copy, navigation

â Keep product data clean and consistent across the catalog (naming, tagging, image sizing)

â Build and manage SOP documentation for site execution

â Execute merchandising changes accurately and on time

â Apply markdowns and sale pricing updates

â Follow merchandising directive

â Support GWP, promotions, and bundle setup in Shopify as directed by team

â Flag inventory or pricing inconsistencies

â Support QA on every site change

â QA site; site pages, cart, and checkout. Daily, with particular focus on high traffic times and pages

â Confirm links, assets, copy, and pricing display correctly across devices

â Document and report bugs clearly, with steps to reproduce, so they can be prioritized

â Eagerness, Curiosity, Hands-on, Data-driven

â Build familiarity with how site changes connect to reporting and performance

â Expected to develop increasing autonomy, through identification of department gaps and desired professional direction

â Take initiative to identify, test, and flag opportunities for growth and process improvements.

Requirements

â Basic understanding of Shopify admin, relevant ecommerce coursework, or a relevant internship

â Comfortable learning new software quickly and navigating admin systems without hand-holding

â Highly detail-oriented and organized: this role lives and dies on accuracy

â Clear written communicator, especially when flagging issues or asking for help

â Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and the site changes often

â Curious and eager to learn the operational side of a DTC ecommerce business

Nice to Have

â Direct hands-on experience in Shopify admin (even personal or class projects)

â Basic familiarity with spreadsheets for tracking tasks or simple reporting

â Interest in growing toward more advanced merchandising or site operations responsibility

Reporting Structure

This role sits in the Digital Operations team, under the Associate eCommerce Manager, with a dotted line to the Sr. eCommerce Manager and Sr. Director, Digital Operations.

jobs.title: Quantum Photonic Engineer
jobs.description:
Qraken Quantum is building the backbone of quantum communication infrastructure.
Our cutting-edge technology enables efficient fast switching in quantum networks, br... 1 Quantum Photonic Engineer As a Quantum Photonic Engineer at Qraken Quantum, you will play a pivotal role in the design, assembly, and realization of our QLMs. You will bridge the gap between quantum optics and engineering, working directly with the co-founders to take our prototypes into the field.

Key Responsibilities
* Quantum Optics System Development: Partake in technical efforts on building, characterising, and refining our QLM architecture. This includes work on multi-reflection delay lines, collimation and coupling optics, electrooptic devices, and integration of our UQOS and QLM.
* Quantum Characterization: Run entangled photon experiments to validate our QLM, collect, analyze, and present data for white papers, publications and investor pitches.
* Lab Automation: Write custom scripts to automate experimental data collection, optical alignment monitoring, and hardware control.
* System Design: Contribute to our long-term mission by exploring and implementing tests of next generation use cases.

Required Qualifications & Skills
* Education: A PhD or Master's degree in quantum optics, experimental physics, photonics, or a closely related field.
* Optical Alignment Expertise: Hands-on experience aligning complex optical systems.
* Quantum Hardware Experience: Previous work with photonic quantum experiments, including single-photon detectors (SPADs/SNSPDs), time-taggers, and photon sources.
* Programming Skills: Solid coding experience (preferably in Python) for data analysis, instrument interfacing, or hardware control.

Additional Assets
* Experience working with ultrafast pulsed lasers.
* Familiarity with electro-optics, high-voltage RF drivers, or free-space modulators.
* Experience with optical simulations.

What We Offer
* Career Opportunities: As an early-stage quantum startup, we offer career growth opportunities and exposure to the rapidly advancing quantum technology sector. You will be provided with many possibilities to advance and shape your career and contribute to the growth of a quantum hardware startup from day one.
* Cutting-Edge Technology: Work on a hardware paradigm that avoids the fundamental limits of matter-based quantum memories.
* Prime Location: Based in Vienna, Austria-consistently ranked as one of the world's most livable cities-with access to the University of Vienna's premier infrastructure.
* Flexibility: We value work-life balance and understand the needs of working parents within our team, offering flexible working arrangements and part-time possibilities.
* Competitive Compensation: Salary aligned with postdoctoral and deep-tech startup standards in Austria. The gross annual salary for this position is between €50,000.00 and €80,000.00, depending on your qualifications and experience. This range exceeds the minimum salary stipulated by the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

Diversity & Equal Opportunity
At Qraken Quantum, we believe that groundbreaking deep tech thrives on diverse perspectives and unique backgrounds. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, or age. We strongly encourage applications from everyone who meets the technical requirements of the role.

How to Apply
If you are ready to help build the future of the quantum network, we want to hear from you! Send your CV and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience to: jobs@qraken-quantum.com . Your ability to lead, collaborate, and deliver results will be essential in achieving our strategic objectives and exceeding client expectations. We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Global Air Logistics Vertical Implementation Manager (m/f/d) to lead and oversee complex global customer implementation projects and programs from initiation to successful stabilization within a defined business vertical. As part of the vertical PMO, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects on time, within scope, and within budget. You will collaborate with the related vertical leadership teams on the Sales side and the Business Unit Air Logistics side to develop vertical related strategic goals and best practice to continuously meet the market requirements and conditions of our customers. This role requires at least 5 years of experience in leading/driving large, complex projects and/or programs through complete project Life-cycle, preferably on an international basis and a solid operational background in Air Logistics.

* Project Planning and Initiation: Lead project definition, scope, and objectives by collaborating with stakeholders. Create detailed plans, including timelines, resource and risk management

* Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships, communicate status, be transparent and highlight opportunities effectively
* Quality Assurance: Ensure deliverables meet Kuehne+Nagel and ISO 21205 standards, conduct evaluations, and suggest and implement improvements
* Competence & Strategy: Collaborate closely with the stakeholders of the assigned PMO vertical within the Sales and Business Unit Air Logistics organization to develop and lead strategic internal projects to further grow the success of vertical specific implementation management
* Risk & Change Management: Identify and mitigate risks, manage scope changes professionally for successful integration
* Mentoring/Supervision: Serve as a patient mentor, coaching, sharing best practices, fostering learning, and guiding junior managers on the assigned vertical requirements

What we would like you to bring
* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration or a related field
* Proven experience as a Project Manager and/or Program Manager, with a track record of successfully delivering complex global projects in the assigned business vertical
* Strong understanding of Air Logistics operation and processes
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide cross-functional teams
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and software
* Project Management Professional (PMP, PMI, Prince2) or equivalent certification is a plus

What's in it for you
At Kuehne+Nagel, you get to grow your expertise, shape processes and deliver innovative solutions. We are continuously building our local and global network and our product portfolio, creating career opportunities in different fields of work worldwide. As a leader in the logistics industry, we provide a collaborative and IT-driven environment where you will work with motivated and customer-centric colleagues across the world. We look forward to receiving your comprehensive online application.

At Museum of Ice Cream, we exist to spark joy, create connection, and turn everyday moments into unforgettable experiences â while serving as the global champion of ice cream culture. From the brands and makers shaping the category to the communities that gather around it, MOIC sits at the center of a cultural movement built on nostalgia, creativity, and shared joy.

Creative Production & Project Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of creative projects across campaigns and marketing channels, from brief through to final delivery.

Process & Workflow Management

  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and proactively recommend improvements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Gather and clarify briefs from internal stakeholders before they reach the creatives.
  • Manage external vendor relationships â photographers, videographers, fabricators, and agencies â within the scope of your projects.

Budgets & Resources

  • Manage vendor estimates and POs as required.
  • Manage contract creative team budgets in support of the Director, Marketing Strategy & Ops

Reporting & Communication

  • Produce clear status updates and project recaps for the team and senior stakeholders.

  • Run post-mortems on completed projects and feed learnings back into process.

Contract Details

  • This is a temporary contractor role
  • The hourly pay is between $65/hr-$75/hr

  • Duration: 3 months, with potential to extend

  • A clear, confident communicator who earns trust quickly â with creatives, stakeholders, and vendors alike.
  • Comfortable owning budgets and managing vendor relationships with minimal oversight.
  • Calm under pressure, solutions-oriented, and highly organized.
  • Available for a consistent part-time commitment each week (hours to be agreed at contract stage).
  • Able to work independently as a contractor â you manage your own time and hit your deadlines.

jobs.title: Social Community Representative
jobs.description:
The Social Community Representative is responsible for engaging with consumers, creators, and ambassadors across social media channels to build community, strengthen brand affinity, and support a positive customer experience. This remote, part-time role combines community management, creator support, social engagement, and content execution to help drive meaningful connections and brand growth.

Reporting to the DIGITAL COMMUNITIES' ASSOCIATE MANAGER, the SOCIAL COMMUNITY REPRESENTATIVE will support our collegiate team in the following areas and meet the job requirements below.

This is a remote, part-time position.

--

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to direct messages, comments, tagged content, and community interactions across social media platforms to support audience engagement and strengthen brand affinity.
  • Act as a trusted voice of the brand by reviewing and responding to consumer, creator, and ambassador inquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and attention to detail.

  • Support creator, ambassador, and community engagement by resharing stories, engaging with tagged content, and recognizing standout community members.

Identify and report recurring community themes, ambassador questions, consumer complaints, and engagement opportunities to help improve brand communications and customer experience.

  • Encourage participation in community programs, ambassador challenges, competitions, seasonal campaigns, and engagement initiatives through proactive outreach.
  • Research social trends, creators, cultural moments, and emerging platforms to identify opportunities for community growth and engagement.

Requirements

  • Experience with excel.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent the brand voice professionally and enthusiastically.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, etc.) and current social trends.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and track many moving pieces at once.

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Role: Recruiter & People Operations Specialist

Base Salary: $95,000 - $110,000

We're looking for a People Operations Specialist to lead recruiting across Blackthorn while also supporting core people operations work. You'll own the full-cycle hiring process for open roles company-wide â from intake through offer â while partnering with the VP of People Operations on onboarding, HR systems, and day-to-day operational support. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role suited to someone who enjoys both the relationship-driven work of recruiting and the precision of operational execution.

What youâll do

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own the end-to-end recruiting process for roles across the company, from intake calls with hiring managers through offer negotiation.
  • Source, screen, and manage candidate pipelines using our ATS, partnering closely with hiring managers on role requirements and timelines.
  • Build and maintain a strong candidate experience at every stage of the process.
  • Track recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness) and report regularly to leadership.

People Operations Support



  • Support onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure a smooth experience for new hires and departing employees.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HRIS data.
  • Assist with benefits administration and respond to employee questions on policies and programs.
  • Help maintain compliance with employment law across the states (and potentially countries) where Blackthorn has employees.

Process & Systems Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to streamline recruiting and HR operational workflows.
  • Partner with the VP of People Operations on building scalable people processes as the company grows.

What we look for

  • 3â5+ years of experience in recruiting, with some HR or people operations exposure.
  • Proven ability to manage full-cycle recruiting independently, including sourcing, screening, and closing candidates.
  • Comfortable working with HRIS and ATS tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can build trust with hiring managers and candidates alike.
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in a remote-first, distributed team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for a B2B SaaS or Salesforce ecosystem company.
  • Familiarity with PEOs or multi-state employment compliance.

What we offer

  • An incredible team of smart and supportive people
  • A deep feeling of satisfaction and completion
  • Fully remote global team working from home
  • Stock options for every employee
  • Flexible work week
  • $400 office stipend
  • Maternity/Paternity leave
  • Student loan debt assistance
  • Pledge 1% - time off during the year for helping nonprofits
  • Health insurance contribution (if in the US)
  • Children's 529 college fund assistance (if in the US)

About Blackthorn

Blackthorn turns any organization's SalesforceÂ® CRM into event planning software powered by their connected data. We're a growing, distributed team with teammates across the globe, and we build Salesforce-native tools that help teams create events, engage attendees, process payments, and measure success â all without leaving their CRM. Our customers range from tiny nonprofits to global corporations, and our products are known for going live in hours, not weeks. We believe the best enterprise software should feel as intuitive as the apps you use every day.

Why our work matters

Most event management tools force teams to juggle disconnected systems, wrestle with flimsy integrations, and spend more time syncing data than planning events. We're building the alternative: a connected platform inside Salesforce that gives organizations richer analytics to prove event ROI, better attendee experiences through personalization and automation, and the flexibility to fit any workflow. Every feature we ship helps our customers spend less time on logistics and more time on the events themselves.

What the job will bring you

A deep level of satisfaction through ownership of your role. You'll get more autonomy than at other companies (our team has told us). Connection. Our team is tightly knit, assisted through occasional team meetups (as we're remote). Challenge. We're trying to move as quickly as possible. This is not for you if you want to sit back and chill. As Ray Dalio says about life, "Meaningful work and meaningful relationships" provide meaning to life. We aim to bring this.

While we are a remote-first culture, we are currently only able to accept applicants in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, and WI

jobs.title: Embedded Software & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Key responsibilities
Firmware and embedded software development: - Develop and maintain embedded software and firmware primarily in Rust. - Use C where relevant for embedded and low-level development. - Develop for bare-metal RISC-V and embedded Linux on ARM environments. - Implement reliable software for resource-constrained embedded systems. - Investigate and resolve software, firmware and system-level issues. Hardware integration and verification: - Integrate firmware with electronics, hardware and communication interfaces. - Test, debug and validate software on target hardware. - Support hardware–software integration and system-level testing. - Contribute to verification activities and resolve integration issues. Engineering collaboration and documentation: - Work closely with electronics, optics and systems engineers. - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. - Create and maintain clear technical documentation. - Help improve software development, testing and documentation practices. - Take increasing ownership of technical tasks as your understanding of our systems develops.

We offer: What we offer:
- A hands-on engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication technologies. - Meaningful technical ownership and the opportunity to see your work move from implementation to hardware integration and validation. - Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team. - The opportunity to develop your expertise across embedded software, electronics, optics and aerospace systems. - The ability to contribute to technical decisions and engineering practices as the company grows. - A gross annual base salary of €35,000–€57,000, depending on experience, skills and the expected level of responsibility. - Relocation support to Estonia if required. - Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs. Working arrangement: This is a primarily onsite position in Tallinn, Estonia, as the role involves close collaboration with hardware, integration and testing. Limited hybrid work may be agreed depending on the employee’s responsibilities and the stage of the work. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager. Other important information: This position may require the selected candidate to be eligible to obtain government security clearance. At Golbriak Space, we use our passion for purposeful innovation to help keep people safe and solve complex engineering challenges. We foster an inclusive environment built on integrity, responsibility and employee empowerment.

Option to work from home: No

Un poste de terrain, au cœur de nos résidences
Vous aimez les environnements variés, les nouveaux défis et les missions qui ont du sens ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de plusieurs établissements plutôt que d'un seul ?

KOSY Appart'Hôtels, exploité par Habitat Gestion, c'est :
- Un réseau de 16 résidences,
- Présents dans 9 villes,
- Exploitant près de 1 400 logements en France,
- Avec plus de 25 ans d'expertise.
Implantés à Forbach, Saint-Avold, Reims, Nancy, Troyes, Mâcon, Grenoble, Aix-Les-Bains et Avignon.

Pour en savoir plus : www.kosy-apparthotels.com

Rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel, votre mission s'articule autour de deux axes principaux :
- Renforcer les équipes lors des pics d'activité, des rentrées universitaires, des périodes touristiques ou tout autre besoin opérationnel.
- Remplacer les responsables de résidence pendant leurs absences (congés, formations, maladie, etc.) afin de garantir le bon fonctionnement de chaque établissement.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené(e) à :

- Veiller au respect des procédures, des standards qualité et des règles de sécurité ;

Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans la gestion d'un établissement d'hébergement (résidence de services, résidence étudiante, appart'hôtel).

- Une grande autonomie dans vos missions.
- Une forte diversité d'environnements et de rencontres.

- L'opportunité de développer vos compétences sur plusieurs typologies d'établissements.

jobs.title: Head of Treasury
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategically minded Head of Treasury to join our global Energy Storage Business organisation in a rapidly growing renewable energy market.


This is a unique opportunity to establish and lead the treasury function of a newly carved-out business, taking full ownership of building treasury operations from the ground up. As the ideal candidate you will have direct experience of this process.

You will set up banking structures, develop treasury processes, manage liquidity routines and ensure a seamless transition into an independently operating group of companies. Success in this role requires solid expertise in cash and liquidity management, financial risk management, hedging and bank relationship management.

You should also be comfortable navigating compliance, internal controls and treasury-related reporting requirements within a global corporate environment. This role will be a hands-on position where a self-driven person will thrive. Your work will be essential in safeguarding financial integrity, supporting the business with reliable treasury insights and enabling future growth.

As a key member of the global finance team, you will manage both local and international treasury needs, collaborate closely with banks, auditors, and internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements across all treasury processes.

The ideal location for this position is Helsinki, Finland, however we would consider suitably qualified individuals based in Vaasa or Turku.

Key Responsibilities

Cash & Liquidity Management


* Ensure the company maintains adequate liquidity to support global operations and strategic initiatives.
* Manage global cash pooling structures, daily cash positioning, and short- to long-term cash flow forecasts.
* Optimise cash deployment and internal funding between group entities, enhancing working capital efficiency.
* Provide management with timely insights and recommendations on cash movements, trends and requirements.


Hedging & Financial Risk Management


* Develop, execute, and monitor hedging strategies for foreign exchange in alignment with corporate risk policies.
* Assess financial risks and propose mitigation strategies based on market developments and business needs.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and treasury governance frameworks.


Guarantees


* Manage the full portfolio of bank guarantees, letters of credit, parent company guarantees and other trade finance instruments.
* Oversee the issuance, amendment, extension, and cancellation of guarantees in a timely and compliant manner.
* Partner with commercial, legal, and project teams to structure trade finance solutions that support contract execution.


Bank Relationship Management


* Establish and maintain strong, strategic relationships with global banks and financial partners.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, facility structures, and service agreements to ensure optimal banking support for the business.
* Monitor banking performance, market conditions, competitive offerings to drive continuous improvement and cost efficiency.


Additional Contributions


* Liaison closely with the businesses' trade finance team on different trade finance topics
* Manage treasury reporting and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, and digitalization within treasury processes.
* Provide guidance and support to finance team on treasury-related matters.
* Manage corporate financing activities, including credit facilities and capital structure development, as needed.

jobs.title: VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth
jobs.description:
About HealthCorps

HealthCorps is a national non-profit committed to improving lives by addressing health challenges in communities through innovative programming in education, leadership, and service learning. We empower teens to become change agents within their families, schools, and neighborhoods. Our program is grounded in the understanding that limited access to health education can lead to a lifetime of social, emotional, and physical challenges.

The Opportunity

HealthCorps is launching a new Growth & Strategic Partnerships Division, and the VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth will be its architect, engine, and external face. You'll hold a broad, high-impact portfolio: leading HealthCorps' national funder and strategic partnerships, driving development, grant management, and fundraising, shaping our brand and marketing, and growing our alumni, community, and hub partnership work. You won't do it alone. A national team, along with program managers across our hubs, will help you build and execute this vision.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will hold your own portfolio of partnerships, work closely with leadership to develop and execute strategies that meet HealthCorps' revenue and growth goals, and represent HealthCorps externally at donor meetings, funder convenings, and sector events. This is an ideal role for a mission-aligned leader who can prospect a health system executive and coach a marketing manager in the same week, someone energized by both the hunt and the build.

For-profit and private sector backgrounds are strongly welcomed. If you have driven revenue, built partnerships, and told a compelling brand story, in any sector, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

External Relationship Strategy, Cultivation & Maintenance (30%)

  • Serve as a key external relationship officer alongside the CEO, cultivating and stewarding relationships across health systems, corporate sponsors, school districts, foundations, and community organizations
  • Design and lead a comprehensive partnership strategy spanning grant, sponsor, and programmatic relationships that aligns funder priorities with organizational growth goals
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of new and emerging partnership opportunities, cultivating prospects from first touch through qualification
  • Steward existing partners to deepen loyalty, increase lifetime value, and drive renewals and upgrades
  • Track funding trends and shifting funder priorities to position HealthCorps ahead of major market shifts

Pitching, Proposals & Partner Stewardship (25%)

  • Own the full partnership sales cycle for mid-tier and emerging opportunities, from first outreach through close and activation
  • Develop pitches, proposals, and grant applications that translate HealthCorps' outcomes data into a compelling, fundable case for support
  • Partner with the CEO and leadership to identify, solicit, and close transformational sponsorships for the major annual fundraiser and national and hub-level programming
  • Demonstrate ongoing value to existing partners through exceptional stewardship that keeps them connected to our mission and measurable impact

Brand Strategy & Voice (20%)

  • Set strategic tone and direction for the HealthCorps brand across all external-facing channels and oversee the Marketing Manager in executing it across social media, website, newsletters, and press
  • Lead the design and execution of a brand and communications strategy that builds awareness and trust across funders, partners, and the broader public
  • Partner with program teams to translate research-validated impact data and stories into compelling, consistent external narratives
  • Develop partner-facing collateral â partnership decks, impact reports, and stakeholder communications â that reflect the quality of the organization
  • Represent HealthCorps at conferences, sector events, and media opportunities alongside the CEO and program leaders

Hub, Community & Alumni Partnerships (15%)

  • Build local advisory committees that connect HealthCorps to local civic, education, and philanthropic leaders, in partnership with the Alumni & Community Manager and Program Directors
  • Strengthen HealthCorps' presence in each market by partnering with local teams to plan events, cultivate partnerships, and raise the organization's visibility
  • Cultivate and engage HealthCorps' alumni as a strategic community, building a strong, active network and connecting alumni to advisory roles, volunteer opportunities, and local partnerships that extend our reach

Division Leadership & Team Management (10%)

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team: Senior Manager of Development, Marketing Manager, Director of Events (part-time), and Alumni & Community Manager
  • Serve as a player-coach who models the work while developing others, holding your own partnership portfolio while coaching the team toward revenue and relationship goals
  • Establish and monitor division KPIs across pipeline, revenue, and brand performance, reporting to the CEO and Board to ensure measurable ROI
  • Manage the division budget and contribute to organization-wide strategic planning as a member of the leadership team

Who You Are

You are a relationship-builder, a closer, and a brand thinker. The ideal candidate brings:

  • 7+years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, sales, or revenue-generating roles, with a demonstrated track record of closing and stewarding high-value relationships. Nonprofit, for-profit, and private sector backgrounds are all strongly welcomed
  • Experience holding your own portfolio while leading and developing a team; you are a player-coach who can model the work and develop others simultaneously
  • Proven pitching and presentation skills; you are comfortable in a boardroom, at a funder meeting, and in a pitch meeting, and you know how to read a room and close
  • Experience setting brand direction and overseeing marketing or communications functions, with the ability to translate complex program outcomes into compelling external narratives
  • Strong written communication skills: from partner proposals to grant narratives to impact reports, your writing moves people to act
  • Familiarity with health systems, corporate social responsibility, education, or youth-serving sectors; experience working with health systems or school districts is a strong plus
  • Comfort building and operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-growth environment where you may be creating systems and structures from scratch
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking. And a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking
  • A genuine belief in the power of near-peer mentorship and a passion for health equity and youth development

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in business, public health, communications, marketing, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience in business development, strategic partnerships, sales, or revenue leadership in any sector.
  • Experience managing direct reports and leading cross-functional teams

Preferred

Compensation & Benefits

This is a full time, exempt position, and you will be offered a comprehensive benefits package. Yearly compensation for the role depends on a number of factors, including candidates' qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and location.

Because we operate across multiple states, compensation is aligned with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including salary thresholds where applicable. Slight preference given to the candidate that live in one of our hub areas: Pittsburgh, PA, Philadelphia, PA, Cleveland, OH, Oklahoma City, OK, South Florida (Palm Beach/Miami), Houston, TX and Phoenix, AZ.

At HealthCorps, we believe our team members are our greatest asset. That's why full-time employees enjoy comprehensive benefits packages designed to support your health, financial security, and overall, well-being. Our offerings include

Plus, HealthCorps proudly recognizes and observes most federal holidays, giving you even more opportunities to rest and connect outside of work.

jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
jobs.description:
Aalborg University, Department of Energy, Campus Esbjerg, invites applications for a three-year PhD Stipend from October 1st or soon hereafter in dynamic modelling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid. You will contribute to interdisciplinary research spanning process engineering, power engineering and sustainable energy systems and help develop future large-scale Power-to-X solutions.

Your work tasks
In this PhD fellowship at AAU Energy, you will work with dynamic modeling, simulation and optimization of Power-to-X processes for renewable fuel production, such as green methanol and sustainable aviation fuel produced through Fischer–Tropsch and methanol-to-jet pathways. The project primarily focuses on the process-engineering aspects of renewable fuel production, with particular emphasis on the interactions among the electrical grid, electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage and heat integration in integrated Power-to-X systems.

You will develop and apply physics-based process models that describe the behavior of Power-to-X plants under varying operating conditions. This includes modelling electrolysers, fuel-synthesis units and supporting energy-system components and analyzing how these systems can operate efficiently and flexibly in response to fluctuations in renewable electricity generation, energy prices and wider energy-system conditions. The work will combine process simulation with operational optimization, techno-economic assessment and model validation.

The research will also examine the coordinated operation and control of Power-to-X processes, electrolysers and energy-storage systems in interaction with the electrical grid. You will contribute to research on grid-supporting operation and control strategies for integrated Power-to-X plants.

You will carry out your research in close collaboration with academic and industrialpartners in Denmark and across Europe. The position includes, among others, preparing scientific publications, presenting results at conferences and workshops, and participating in project meetings and activities. You will also make a limited contribution to teaching or supervision at Aalborg University, for example by supervising bachelor’s and master’s students working on relevant topics.

Your competencies 
You have, or are about to obtain, a master’s degree in chemical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, sustainable energy engineering or a closely related field. You bring a solid foundation in areas such as process modelling, thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics and control, optimization or energy-system analysis, and you are interested in applying these disciplines to Power-to-X and renewable fuel production.

You have experience with process-modelling tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS or other related software and are motivated to develop and apply dynamic models of energy and chemical processes. You are familiar with programming languages and computational tools. Expertise in a particular software package is not required, but experience with one or more computational environments, such as MATLAB, Python or similar tools, will support your work in the project. Knowledge of Power-to-X, electrolysis, renewable fuels, process integration or energy storage will be advantageous.

Knowledge of electrical power systems, electricity markets, grid integration or the control of grid-connected energy systems would strengthen your profile but is not a requirement for the position. The core academic profile sought is within process engineering or a related discipline. You should have an interest in and motivation to learn about the interaction between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid, including how process-level operation and control affect plant flexibility and system-level performance.

You are able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and are comfortable discussing technical ideas across disciplinary boundaries.
You have good analytical abilities, scientific curiosity, and the ability to document and communicate your work clearly in writing and presentations. You have strong written and spoken English skills suitable for scientific collaboration and publication. We value your motivation and potential to develop across disciplines, and you are not expected to have prior expertise in every aspect of the project from the outset.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
You will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy, and electrical engineering. The group works with modeling, simulation, control, optimization, and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels, and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows, and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance.

At Campus Esbjerg, you will work alongside academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, and PhD fellows across a range of energy-related disciplines. The campus setting supports close day-to-day collaboration across disciplines and research projects.

Collaboration with industry is an important part of the research environment, and many research and student projects are developed with external partners to address real-world engineering challenges. We aim to provide a supportive working environment with a healthy balance between professional commitments and life outside work.

The fellowship offers strong opportunities for professional and academic development.
As part of the three-year PhD program, you will conduct independent research under supervision and complete PhD courses corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS.
Courses may be taken at Aalborg University or other relevant institutions in Denmark and abroad. You will have opportunities to participate in specialized courses, summer schools, international conferences, and project workshops. The position will also provide experience in scientific publishing, research dissemination, teaching or student supervision, interdisciplinary project work, and collaboration with industrial partners.

AAU Energy offers access to modern experimental and computational facilities supporting research in sustainable energy systems. At Campus Esbjerg, these include facilities for thermal and fluid processes, electrical engineering, power electronics, renewable-energy control, offshore energy systems, and Power-to-X.

The research environment is being further strengthened through the C-TECH initiative, which is establishing a modular test site for carbon capture, electrolysis, and methanol synthesis at Campus Esbjerg. The facility is intended to support research, education, and industrial collaboration in Power-to-X and carbon capture, utilization, and storage. This creates an attractive setting for a PhD project connecting process modeling with industrial validation and integrated sustainable-energy systems.

Campus Esbjerg is located in one of Denmark’s major energy and offshore hubs, providing favorable conditions for collaboration with companies involved in renewable energy, Power-to-X, offshore technologies, and the wider energy transition. The relatively compact campus supports close professional relationships, close interaction with supervisors and colleagues, and collaboration across research and educational activities.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that:
    describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

UAB „Camira Fabrics“ – tekstilės įmonė, kuri sėkmingai vykdo veiklą audimo, verpalų gamybos, kirpimo, siuvimo, baldų apmušalų bei pavyzdžių gamybos srityse. „Camira Fabrics Ltd“ yra viena iš pasaulinių rinkos lyderių, tiekianti audinius biuro baldams ir transporto sektoriui tokiems klientams kaip Londono metro, „Microsoft“ ar „Google“. Įmonėje Ariogaloje dirba apie 160 darbuotojų, o šiuo metu prie komandos kviečiamas prisijungti dar vienas specialistas, kurio indėlis bus svarbus siekiant užsibrėžtų tikslų ir puoselėjant bendrą įmonės viziją.

Šioje pozicijoje Jums reikės:
• Užtikrinti darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos politikos bei procedūrų laikymąsi;
• Vykdyti darbo vietų patikras, vertinti rizikas ir teikti sprendimus;
• Valdyti ir atnaujinti DSS, priešgaisrinės ir civilinės saugos dokumentaciją;
• Organizuoti darbuotojų saugos mokymus (įskaitant pirmąją pagalbą ir priešgaisrinę saugą);
• Valdyti asmeninių apsaugos priemonių tiekimą ir užtikrinti jų atitiktį reikalavimams;
• Tirti nelaimingus atsitikimus ir incidentus;
• Užtikrinti ISO 45001 standarto laikymąsi;
• Prižiūrėti saugos įrangą ir užtikrinti jos parengtį naudojimui;
• Rengti DSS ataskaitas;
• Atlikti profesinės rizikos vertinimus ir siūlyti prevencinius sprendimus;

Tikimės, kad Jūs:
• Turite bent aukštesnįjį (koleginį) išsilavinimą;
• Turite galiojantį darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos specialisto pažymėjimą;
• Esate sukaupęs (-usi) darbo patirties darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos srityje (patirtis gamybinėje įmonėje – privalumas);
• Išmanote Lietuvos Respublikos darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos teisės aktus;
• Puikiai dirbate su MS Office programų paketu;
• Mokate anglų kalbą žodžiu ir raštu;
• Turite B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimą.
Atlyginimas: 2300–3100 €/mėn. Bruto.
Įmonė siūlo:
• Draudimą nuo nelaimingų atsitikimų darbe
• Nemokamus užkandžius ir kavą;
• Kelionės į/iš darbo kompensaciją;
• Telefoną ir kompiuterį asmeniniam naudojimui;
• Darbą Penktadienį iki 14:30
• Reguliarius profesinius mokymus

jobs.title: Ledige stillinger i IMM-avdelingen hos SalMar
jobs.description:
SalMar er en av verdens ledende produsenter av oppdrettslaks, og vi søker nå flere dyktige medarbeidere til vår IMM-avdeling. Vi ser etter engasjerte og kompetente personer til følgende stillinger:

  • Lettmatroser
  • Kokekyndig lettmatroser
  • Motorkyndig lettmatroser

 Om SalMar:

SalMar er en av verdens største og mest effektive produsenter av oppdrettslaks, med produksjon i Norge, Island og Skottland. Siden 1991 har vi vært en pådriver for bærekraftig utvikling i havbruksnæringen. Vår visjon, "Passion for Salmon", gjenspeiler vårt engasjement for å levere sunn og velsmakende mat til over 50 land verden over. Vi legger stor vekt på fiskevelferd, miljøhensyn og lokal verdiskaping.

 

 Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Oppfølging/planlegging av IMM-behandlinger
  • Daglig dekksarbeid på IMM-lekter
  • Ivareta god fiskehelse
  • Servicearbeid, oppfølging og kontinuerlig vedlikehold om bord
  • Bruk av bedriftens kvalitets- og vedlikeholdssystem
  • Bidra til at avdelingen alltid har SalMar standard

 

Hva vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Et dynamisk og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • Muligheten til å jobbe med innovative løsninger i en fremtidsrettet bransje
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Turnusordning, 3x3 uker

 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Erfaring fra oppdrettsnæringen, og/eller servicebåtfartøy
  • Relevante kurs
  • Teknisk utdanning eller relevant erfaring
  • Gyldig helseattest forutsettes
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å jobbe selvstendig

 

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Systematisk og pålitelig
  • Lærevillig, løsningsorientert og proaktiv
  • Stå-på-vilje
  • Fokus på HMS
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig, men også samarbeide med resten av teamet

 

Er du den vi leter etter? Send inn din søknad. (Noter i søknaden hvilken av stillingene du søker på)

jobs.title: Cleanroom & GMP Cleaning Specialist Pharma and Datacenter
jobs.description:
Cleanroom & Critical Environment Cleaning Specialist

Demonstrated experience working in both pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and hyperscale data centre environments is required.

About Vantage Support Group

Vantage Support Group provides specialist workforce and compliance services for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and hyperscale data centres throughout Denmark.

We are seeking an experienced Cleanroom & Critical Environment Cleaning Specialist to join our team on high-security projects where precision, contamination control and strict compliance with quality standards are essential.

About the Position

The successful candidate will perform specialist cleaning in highly controlled environments, including:

  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities

  • GMP production areas

  • ISO 14644 classified cleanrooms

  • Critical environments within hyperscale data centres

  • Technical installations and commissioning areas

The role requires exceptional attention to detail and strict compliance with contamination control procedures, client requirements and health & safety regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform specialist cleaning of cleanrooms and controlled environments.

  • Clean technical installations and critical infrastructure.

  • Carry out GMP-compliant cleaning within pharmaceutical production areas.

  • Perform post-construction and commissioning cleaning within hyperscale data centres.

  • Follow ISO 14644 cleanroom standards.

  • Work in contamination-controlled environments.

  • Operate industrial cleaning equipment.

  • Operate heavy machinery including telehandlers, forklifts and MEWPs where required.

  • Maintain cleaning records and quality documentation.

  • Comply with all HSE and client procedures.

Essential Qualifications

Applicants must have:

  • Minimum 3 years of documented experience in specialist industrial cleaning.

  • Proven experience within pharmaceutical facilities and/or hyperscale data centres.

  • Experience with GMP cleaning procedures.

  • Experience working in ISO 14644 classified cleanrooms.

  • Knowledge of contamination control procedures.

  • Experience with cleaning of technical installations and sensitive equipment.

  • Experience working in live construction or commissioning environments.

  • Experience operating industrial cleaning machinery.

  • Experience operating telehandlers, forklifts or similar heavy equipment.

  • Valid Category B driving licence.

  • Ability to obtain security clearance.

Language Requirements

Communication

Daily communication on site is conducted primarily in English. Applicants must therefore be able to understand work instructions, safety procedures and site documentation in English.

Additional language skills are considered an advantage when working in international teams.

Personal Profile

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Excellent attention to detail.

  • Strong quality awareness.

  • Ability to work independently.

  • Professional attitude towards safety and compliance.

  • Flexibility regarding working hours.

  • Ability to work within multinational teams.

We Offer

  • Permanent employment in Denmark.

  • Competitive salary based on experience.

  • Long-term projects within the pharmaceutical and hyperscale data centre sectors.

  • Continuous training and professional development.

  • Opportunity to work on some of Europe's most advanced technical facilities.
