jobs.title: Responsable commercial aéronautique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste Job Description:***Un poste de *Responsable Commercial et Contrats (h/f)* est à pourvoir au sein de l'organisation Ventes et Marketing d'Airbus Defence and Space. Le poste sera basé à Elancourt (78 Le Responsable Commercial et Contrats (h/f) sera chargé/e d'apporter son expertise commerciale et juridique au cours de la phase de BID, pendant l'exécution du contrat et jusqu'à sa clôture.


En tant que Responsable Commercial et Contrats (h/f), vous serez le point focal commercial et contractuel pour les autres départements et fonctions impliqués dans la préparation de l'offre puis, dans l'exécution du projet. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe Core Team avec le Campaign Manager, le Bid Manager, le Program manager, l'acheteur ou l'engineering, et la Finance.


Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l'IGI 1300 du 30/11/2011 (article 65 Tâches et responsabilités***Vos principales tâches et responsabilités seront les suivantes Négociation offres et propositions***Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes (juridique, conformité, finance, centre de compétence, export control, etc.) et fournir des solutions commerciales rentables***Évaluer les risques commerciaux, financiers, contractuels, de conformité et de contrôle des exportations et trouver des alternatives pour les minimiser***Proposer et négocier des modifications contractuelles toujours dans le but d'améliorer la performance de nos projets et de limiter les risques***Préparation de la documentation relative aux aspects commerciaux et juridiques de l'offre***Assurer la cohérence avec les directives d'Airbus Defence and Space***Responsable de la négociation sur les aspects commerciaux de la proposition avec les clients***Soutenir le développement de nouvelles opportunités et de nouveaux services.***Gestion des contrats***Gérer les contrats existants conformément aux procédures de l'entreprise et aux exigences contractuelles, afin d'assurer une exécution efficace et performante des activités commerciales (telles que le paiement rapide des factures, la résolution des réclamations)***Rédiger et négocier les avenants au contrat***Être le point focal pour tout sujet contractuel pendant l'exécution du projet en soutien au gestionnaire de projet/programme et avec le support du service juridique***Développer le rapport/relation avec les clients pour assurer le bon déroulement des contrats existants.


Des déplacements professionnels sont à prévoir en Europe. e ce fait, vous devez être disposé(e) à vous déplacer en conséquence.***Compétences requises***De formation ingénieur, juridique ou commercial, vous avez ensuite développé une connaissance et expérience en appel d'offre et en négociation commerciale et contractuelle.


Vous avez les compétences et l'expérience suivantes Au moins* 5 ans* d'expérience dans le montage de propositions commerciales et contractuelles (la connaissance des règles des marchés publics/gouvernementaux - DGA française est un plus)***Connaissance accrue d'Excel, Word et PowerPoint***Autonomie et capacité de synthèse et d'analyse***Esprit d'équipe, communication et capacité de convaincre Vous avez l'habitude des négociations (tant au sein d'Airbus qu'avec les clients), en français mais également en *anglais***Un CV en anglais et un CV en français est demandé.***A Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f) position is available within the Sales and Marketing organization of Airbus Defence and Space. The position will be based in Elancourt.


The Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f) will be responsible for providing commercial and legal expertise during the BID phase, contract execution, and until contract closure.


As a Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f), you will be the commercial and contractual focal point for other departments and functions involved in the preparation of the offer and then in the project execution. You will be part of the Core Team with the Campaign Manager, the Bid Manager, the Program Manager, the buyer or engineering, and Finance.


This position will require a French security clearance or will require eligibility for clearance by recognized authorities.***Tasks and Responsibilities***Your main tasks and responsibilities will be as follows:***Offer and Proposal Negotiation***Work closely with internal stakeholders (legal, compliance, finance, center of expertise, export control, etc provide profitable commercial solutions Evaluate commercial, financial, contractual, compliance, and export control risk***find alternatives to minimize them***Propose and negotiate contractual amendments always with the aim of improving the performance of our projects and limiting risks***Prepare documentation related to the commercial and legal aspects of the offer Ensure consistency with Airbus Defence and Space directives***Responsible for negotiating the commercial aspects of the proposal with customers Support the development of new opportunities and new services.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance, Business Partnership & Workflow Automation
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Finance Business Partner to join Notion’s Strategic Finance team. In this role, you’ll partner closely with leaders across Finance, People, Legal, and other business functions to drive financial insights, improve planning processes, and provide strategic analyses to enable the company to scale thoughtfully. The ideal candidate brings deep FP&A expertise and a passion for automation and continuous improvement.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with executive leaders and functional leaders to drive critical business decisions. Build trusted relationships and proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities.

 - Build and own financial models, including capacity and benefits modeling. Prepare strategic trade-off analyses that help leadership prioritize investments so Notion scales responsibly.

 - Partner with Corporate Finance, Accounting, and cross-functional teams to deliver monthly and quarterly reporting and forecasting. Ensure accurate, timely reporting, providing clear variance explanations, and translating results into actionable recommendations for executives and functional leaders.

 - Identify and implement AI and automation-driven improvements that allow financial processes to scale, drive real-time reporting, and enable impactful analyses.

 - Deliver thoughtful ad hoc analyses for executive and business partner with strong judgment, speed, and attention to detail.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Experience leveraging AI in financial workflows. You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - 4-6 years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance in the technology industry; or in accounting, investment banking, consulting, treasury, or private equity

 - Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, budget vs. actuals, annual planning, and long-range planning

 - Comfortable partnering directly with senior leadership and building cross-functional relationships

 - Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to continually up-level current approaches and processes

 - Strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail — “get it done” attitude




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with a high-growth tech company, including native AI, SaaS, or consumption-based businesses

 - Experience with NetSuite, Workday, Zip, and planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan)

 - Working knowledge of SQL



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $165,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
Fund Controller - Senior Manager
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Job description
Requisition ID:  1727473

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Fund Controller

Position Summary

The Fund Controller is responsible for the overall financial governance, oversight, and representation of a portfolio of Real Estate / Private Equity funds serviced.

Acting as the primary finance lead and trusted advisor to the client, the Fund Controller provides fund-level accountability for financial reporting, investor deliverables, audit coordination, regulatory compliance, and operational performance. The role serves as the key interface between the client and EY's delivery teams, ensuring that all outputs produced through EY's Managed Services platform are accurate, complete, timely and fit for investor, auditor and regulatory use.

The Fund Controller operates within a global delivery model leveraging EY's technology-enabled platform, including fund accounting, treasury, consolidation, reporting and workflow solutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Fund Governance and Fund Representation

• Serve as the designated Fund Controller for a portfolio of client funds.
• Provide overall governance and financial oversight across all fund processes.
• Review, challenge and approve financial outputs prepared by EY delivery teams.
• Assess whether reporting outputs are fit for investor, auditor, lender and regulatory purposes.
• Act as the final approval authority for fund-level reporting deliverables.
• Escalate significant risks, accounting issues and operational matters to client leadership and EY management.

2. Client Relationship Management

• Act as the primary finance contact for assigned clients.
• Lead governance and operating committee meetings.
• Build trusted relationships with CFOs, Fund Directors, Portfolio Managers and Investors.
• Provide proactive insights regarding fund performance, risks and reporting matters.
• Support business development opportunities and contribute to account growth initiatives.

3. Oversight of Fund Accounting Operations

• Oversee end-to-end fund administration activities performed by EY delivery teams.
• Challenge accounting treatments and complex transactions.
• Review:
o NAV calculations
o Consolidations
o Capital calls and distributions
o Debt and financing activities
o Waterfall calculations
o Investment accounting
o Foreign currency translations
• Ensure compliance with agreed reporting calendars and service level agreements.

4. Financial Reporting & Investor Deliverables

• Review and approve:
o Financial statements
o Consolidated reporting packages
o Investor reporting
o Board reporting materials
o Fund performance analyses
• Ensure reporting remains audit-ready throughout the reporting cycle.
• Drive consistency of reporting across fund structures and jurisdictions.

5. Audit and Regulatory Oversight

• Coordinate statutory audits and investor audit processes.
• Act as the primary contact for external auditors.
• Challenge audit observations and oversee remediation actions.

6. Service Provider Coordination

• Oversee interactions with:
o Property Managers
o Administrators
o Depositaries
o Banks
o Auditors
o Tax Advisors
o Legal Advisors
• Monitor service quality and performance.
• Resolve operational issues and coordinate complex stakeholder interactions.

7. Oversight of EY Delivery Teams

• Lead multidisciplinary EY teams across Luxembourg and Global Delivery Services.
• Review quality of work produced by accounting, controlling and reporting teams.
• Define review standards and escalation thresholds.
• Drive continuous improvement, standardisation and automation initiatives.
• Promote efficient utilisation of EY technology platforms and managed service tools.

8. Risk Management & Control

• Identify operational, financial and reporting risks.
• Challenge unusual transactions and accounting judgments.
• Ensure robust documentation, governance and audit trail requirements are maintained.
• Review and monitor key controls across the end-to-end operating model.

Required Experience

Education

• Master's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business Administration.
• Professional qualification strongly preferred:
o ACCA
o CPA
o CA
o CFA

Experience

• 8–15 years of experience in:
o Fund Administration
o Private Equity
o Real Estate
o Infrastructure
o Alternative Investments
o Asset Management Servicing
• Strong experience managing audits, investor reporting and complex fund structures.
• Experience working within a global operating model and managing offshore delivery teams.

Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of:

• IFRS, Lux GAAP, US GAAP
• Fund Accounting
• Consolidation
• NAV Oversight
• Capital Activity Management
• Fund Structures and Waterfalls
• Debt and Treasury Management
• Regulatory Framework
• Internal Controls and Governance

Experience with:

Key Competencies

• Commercial mindset

Technical Excellence

Operational Leadership

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

jobs.title: EXPERIENCED RESEARCHER IN THE FIELD OF FRUGAL/GREEN AI (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.
• Developing and coaching the LIST RDI teams in this topic; and
• Maximising the impact of Frugal AI initiatives through externally funded projects with public or private organisations.
Your role will include:
• Lead the research, development and innovation (RDI) activities on the Frugal AI topic, defining and shaping research directions in line with LIST's strategic objectives.
• Drive the development of innovative Frugal AI technologies and methodologies.
• Develop and manage RDI project proposals, ensuring alignment with strategic research objectives at the group and unit level. Identify funding and grant opportunities; prepare and submit proposals to secure financial support for RDI activities.
• Oversee the execution of RDI projects with external partners, ensuring that they meet their objectives, timelines and budgets.
•  Align with ongoing standards around Frugal AI and Green AI and explore opportunities and collaborations with the consortia behind those standards.
• Establish and maintain collaborations with industrial partners, public organisations, research institutes and universities to enhance research impact and technology transfer.
• Actively participate in EU and (inter)national consortia and contribute to collaborative research projects.
• Increase LIST's visibility in the AI field through publications, presentations and participation in relevant forums and conferences.

Deep scientific and technical expertise, demonstrated by publications and successful RDI projects, in at least some of these topics is required:

About the Role

This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for designing, building and leading Uplift360's operational backbone.
As Operations Director, you will oversee the company's operational infrastructure, business services, corporate operations, governance and support functions across Luxembourg and the United Kingdom, ensuring the organisation operates efficiently, compliantly and at scale.
Working directly with the Co-Founders, CTO and Senior Leadership Team, you will establish the operational systems, governance frameworks and management disciplines required to support accelerated growth, investor readiness, customer delivery and industrial expansion.
A key objective of the role is to help Uplift360 scale intelligently through the adoption of automation, AI-enabled workflows and modern digital operating systems. You will be expected to identify opportunities to increase organisational productivity, strengthen decision-making and reduce operational overhead through the effective application of technology.
Success in the role will be measured not only by organisational growth, but by your ability to build a scalable operating model that combines exceptional people, robust processes and intelligent technology - enabling growth without a proportional increase in administrative complexity or headcount.
The role has management responsibility for the HR function and broader business services team. However, this is not an HR leadership position. The Operations Director will ensure that the HR function is appropriately resourced, managed and aligned to business priorities, but will not personally deliver HR services or own the company's people strategy.
Responsibility for HR strategy, workforce planning, organisational design, reward strategy and board-level people governance remains with the founders and designated HR leadership.
This role combines strategic leadership with operational execution and is ideally suited to an experienced operational leader who has successfully scaled organisations in high-growth, venture-backed or industrial environments.

About Uplift360

Uplift360 is an Advanced Materials Company securing sovereign supply for Europe's defence, security and vital industries.
We secure and produce critical advanced materials, including carbon fibre and aramids, for European defence and industry by sourcing, recovering and regenerating high-value materials into secure industrial supply chains.
As geopolitical instability, supply chain fragility and industrial competition intensify, access to advanced materials is becoming a defining strategic advantage. Uplift360 is building the infrastructure and technology required to secure it.

As a Director of Operations, your key accountabilities will include:

Business Operations and Operational Excellence:  Lead the development and continuous improvement of Uplift360's operating model, ensuring efficiency, accountability and scalability across Luxembourg and UK operations.

Corporate Services, Risk and Compliance

• Provide leadership across corporate infrastructure, governance, risk management and business support functions.
• Establish and maintain operational governance, reporting and performance frameworks.
• Develop scalable processes, controls and workflows across the business.
• Lead operational planning and resource coordination across Luxembourg and UK operations.
• Oversee procurement, supplier management and operational service providers.
• Drive continual operational improvement initiatives.
• Develop KPIs, dashboards and management reporting.
• Facilitate leadership operating rhythms, action tracking and accountability.
• Ensure operational processes scale effectively as the company grows.

Digital Transformation and AI-Enabled Scaling

• Lead the development of a modern, technology-enabled operating model capable of supporting rapid growth, stronger decision-making and industrial scaling without adding unnecessary administrative burden.
• Develop and implement a roadmap for operational scalability through automation, AI and process optimisation.
• Identify and automate repetitive administrative, reporting and coordination activities.
• Deploy practical digital tools for workflow management, document control, action tracking, meeting cadence and cross-functional collaboration.
• Champion data-driven decision-making through dashboards, management reporting and operational analytics.
• Partner with functional leaders to simplify workflows, reduce hand-offs and remove avoidable inefficiencies.
• Ensure AI and technology solutions are deployed responsibly, securely and in line with company governance requirements.

Strategic Projects and Company Execution

• Act as a key operational partner to the founders in delivering strategic, cross-functional and growth-critical initiatives.
• Lead company-wide projects that improve organisational capability and effectiveness.
• Coordinate strategic planning activities, leadership initiatives and cross-functional execution priorities.
• Support customer, investor, partner and government stakeholder engagement where operational coordination is required.
• Ensure operational readiness for audits, funding reviews, due diligence exercises and growth milestones.
• Drive execution of business priorities through structured programme management, action tracking and escalation discipline.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Personal Qualities:

• 10+ years' experience in Operations Leadership, Business Operations, General Management, Chief of Staff or related leadership roles.
• Experience within high-growth, venture-backed, technology, manufacturing, industrial or deep-tech environments.
• Proven track record of building scalable operational frameworks and business systems.
• Experience leading cross-functional business services and operational support functions.
• Practical experience implementing automation, AI-enabled workflows, digital collaboration tools, dashboards or process improvements that materially improve organisational productivity.
• Strong understanding of governance, risk management and operational compliance.
• Demonstrated success partnering with founders and executive teams.
• Strong commercial, organisational and stakeholder management capability.
• Fluent English with the right to work in Luxembourg/EU.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Personal Qualities:

• Manufacturing, advanced materials, engineering, chemicals, defence or industrial sector experience.
• Experience supporting grant-funded programmes.

• Experience overseeing operational finance functions.
• French and/or German language capability.

Why Join Uplift360?

We are a family friendly company that believes in the importance of supporting our employees to find and maintain an excellent work life balance. Your physical, mental and financial wellbeing matters to us.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist

INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

In this role, you will guide clients through our structured onboarding process, ensuring they adopt INNERGY effectively and achieve measurable business value early in their journey.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Client Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new clients by setting clear expectations, defining milestones, and tracking progress against onboarding goals.
  • Education & Enablement: Support client education by integrating learning opportunities into onboarding and collaborating with the Content Creation team to prioritize and request the training resources clients need most.
  • Process Monitoring: Use data and progress tracking to monitor client health during onboarding, identifying and addressing potential challenges early.
  • Client Motivation: Keep clients engaged and motivated throughout onboarding, encouraging adoption of INNERGY processes and best practices.
  • Communication: Maintain clear, consistent communication with clients, providing regular updates and documenting all interactions for cross-team visibility.
  • Problem Solving: Identify and address challenges such as limited client engagement or resistance to change. Develop strategies to overcome these obstacles and keep onboarding on track.
  • Feedback Loop: Gather client feedback throughout onboarding and share insights to help refine onboarding strategies and influence future training content priorities.

Qualifications

  • Experience in onboarding, client success, or related roles, preferably within Microvellum architectural millwork industry, or manufacturing.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and use insights to manage progress and risks.
  • Skilled at motivating and guiding clients toward successful outcomes.
  • Experience collaborating with content or training teams to prioritize and influence resource development.
  • Problem-solving mindset with adaptability to client needs and challenges.
  • Travel up to 10%

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

INNERGY is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. We support reasonable adjustments for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your role, please let us know.

This role is primarily computer-based and may involve extended periods of screen time and frequent communication through digital tools. Work may be performed remotely or in an office setting, depending on the role and location. We prioritize employee wellbeing, flexibility, and a safe, supportive work environment across all regions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

INNERGY is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity at every level of the organization. We are committed to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Location Eligibility Notice

This is a U.S.-based remote role. Due to current regulatory requirements, we are only able to consider candidates residing in certain U.S. states.

Eligible states include, but are not limited to: Texas, Florida, Missouri, Arizona, Indiana, North Carolina, and Wisconsin.

At this time, candidates located in California, Colorado, New York, Illinois, Washington, or other states with active pay transparency requirements are not eligible for consideration.

jobs.title: Animal Cruelty Case Specialist
jobs.description:
Description

Term of Employment: Full-Time, Exempt

Reports To: Criminal Justice Program Managing Attorney

Union: Bargaining Unit Position, Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU)

Location: Remote (U.S. Based)

Who We Are

The Animal Legal Defense Fundâs mission is to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system. The Animal Legal Defense Fund accomplishes this mission by filing high-impact lawsuits to protect animals from harm, providing free legal assistance and training to prosecutors to assure that animal abusers are held accountable for their crimes, supporting tough animal protection legislation and fighting legislation harmful to animals, gathering data about and advocating for effective regulation of animal exploitative industries and providing resources and opportunities to law students and professionals to advance the emerging field of animal law.

Role Description

The Criminal Justice Program (CJP) Animal Cruelty Case Specialist position furthers the mission of the Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system, by providing prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues with essential operational and forensic support on criminal animal cruelty cases and encouraging the investigation and prosecution of animal crimes to ensure justice for animal victims. The CJP Animal Cruelty Case Specialist triages all incoming reports of animal cruelty and maintains the active case database. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist applies their experience and expertise to in-depth case-related research and to the training of key stakeholders. This position acts as a liaison across ALDFâs programs to disseminate approved case response information in a timely and responsible manner. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist is accountable for the day-to-day management of their assigned cases and projects.

How You Will Make a Difference

Case Support

  • Receive reports of animal cruelty and requests for case assistance from professional stakeholders, the Administrative Manager, and other sources. Provide initial responses and triage via phone or email.
  • Exercise discretion in analyzing and recommending which cases CJP chooses to pursue, including communicating efficiently with complainants and advocates by phone and email; gathering relevant facts (through eyewitness accounts, media reports, and other sources as needed) for potential criminal cruelty cases; and identifying, after thorough independent analysis, those cases warranting further investigation and/or veterinary forensics.
  • Generate and categorize cases, and work with Managing Attorneys to assign cases to CJP staff according to department protocols. Ensure that complete and accurate case information is relayed in a timely fashion to the appropriate team members.
  • Input and access information using automated systems, make entries into automated record files, seek to maximize use of automated systems available to CJP to further efficiency and accuracy in case response and record keeping.
  • Maintain and organize all case-related records and documentation in a timely, logical, and confidential manner. Ensure that electronic logs of all legal cases are accurate and current. Review case notes to maintain consistent and timely response in all cases.
  • Conduct internet research on potential/active cases (i.e. Facebook, social media, news sources, and company websites). Provide basic assistance in research projects, special reports, and case information gathering. Prepare materials for meetings, court proceedings, and case discovery.
  • Follow up with professional stakeholders on case outcomes/resolutions where possible. Create and maintain a system for tracking date and time of upcoming court proceedings related to CJP-assisted cases.
  • Manage CJP grant processing for expert witnesses, forensic testing, and costs of care in criminal cases, coordinating with internal and external individuals as needed.
  • Inform and assist law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues on animal cruelty case investigations and case strategies, including reviewing and advising on interview tactics, department policies and procedures, veterinary exams and reports, protective custody foster care programs and related agreements, and large-scale animal rescue implementation.
  • Participate in deployment to crime scenes and rescues as needed, exercising discretion in both the decision to travel on-site and the orchestration of such activities.
  • Assist with hands-on scene processing for animal cruelty cases, including identifying, collecting and packaging evidence; assisting with logistics and operational expertise; and assisting with other aspects of search and seizure operations and animal rescue support.
  • Provide support as requested to CJP Case Response Unit.

External Relationship Building and Outreach

  • Build strategic relationships with prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues to facilitate agency assistance in forensics, crime scene processing, and veterinary medicine.
  • Schedule and conduct outreach and training presentations for various disciplines, including but not limited to law enforcement agencies, veterinarians, prosecutors, animal shelters and rescues, and social service agencies.

Internal Relationship Building

  • Proactively maintain intradepartmental relationships and act as a liaison to other programs.
  • Create and maintain system for sharing information about CJP case work and outcomes across departments and facilitate the sharing of information approved for public-facing materials.
  • Provide in-house expertise for staff on questions concerning Criminal Justice Program cases, animal cruelty cases in general, criminal investigation, veterinary forensics, animal rescue and sheltering.

Please note, this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position, which are subject to change in order to best advance ALDFâs strategic objectives and mission.

Requirements

We Are Looking for Candidates With:

  • A bachelorâs degree in a related field desired; or 5 years equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of.
  • At least 3 years of experience in enforcement fieldwork operations, animal cruelty response, dispatch, and/or criminal case management.
  • Demonstrated veterinary forensics or animal cruelty enforcement expertise, including but not limited to, retaining related certifications in the field (such as Certificate in Veterinary Forensics, NACA certifications, FEMA certification, Property and Evidence Certifications, Police or Humane Officer certification).
  • The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information and materials according to the highest standards of confidentiality, chain of custody, and ethical conduct and exercise discretion in the use of related materials and information.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, organizational members and supporters, members of the public, and others. A positive attitude, ability to work cooperatively with others, and ability to function well in a team-oriented work environment.
  • Comfort speaking in public to audiences of various sizes and demographics.
  • The ability to maintain composure and lead others in times of heightened urgency or stress.
  • An understanding of and full commitment to the vision, mission, and core values of the Animal Legal Defense Fund.
  • The ability to travel frequently to conferences, trainings, meetings, and other events as required; estimated 5-7 events per year.

We Offer Competitive Compensation With Excellent Benefits, Including

  • Starting annual salary of $71,509 for most geographic locations.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of Washington D.C., Cotati, CA, and Los Angeles, starting pay is $75,273.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of New York City and San Francisco, starting pay is $79,036.

To ensure salary equity, we do not negotiate salary outside of the published starting rate. Rate is determined by role, using set geographical factors.

  • Comprehensive health care, dental, life and vision benefits (100% employer paid); Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Account (DCA) are also available
  • 192 hours of PTO
  • 19 paid holidays
  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of continuous employment
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • 401k plan with a maximum 5% employer contribution match after one year of employment
  • Alternative work schedules (at managerâs discretion)
  • One-time remote work allowance of $750
  • Annual professional development reimbursement of up to $1,000.

Maintaining a healthy work/life balance is a core value for the Animal Legal Defense Fund.

Additional Information

This role is included in a collective bargaining unit that is represented by the Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU). Certain terms and conditions of your employment, including wages and benefits, have been negotiated with the Union and are included in a collective bargaining agreement between ALDF and the Union.

This is a U.S. based position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

The Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) is an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing an employment environment which is welcoming of persons from diverse backgrounds and free from unlawful discrimination and harassment, and in which all legal rights of our employees are recognized and protected. ALDF conducts all internal and external operations, programs, and employment-related decision making (including hiring decisions) without regard to actual or perceived race, ancestry, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, immigration status, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, political affiliation, disability or medical condition (including physical, intellectual, or psychiatric), sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, age, or other protected category, and in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination and anti-harassment laws.

Consistent with the organizationâs mission, our offices and events are free of animal products and byproducts.

jobs.description:

Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly targets

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts; understand client needs deeply, align Linear’s solutions to business objectives + shape decision criteria. Effectively communicate and align our value proposition to decision-makers

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

 - Help build the foundation and define our enterprise sales process

What we're looking for

 - 3+ years selling to the enterprise, and 7+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling a technical product to both engineering and product leadership; bonus if you have experience selling collaboration or project management software

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Ability to understand complex client needs, craft tailored discovery, and drive sales through consultative approaches.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Je recrute, pour le compte de mon client, un groupe hôtelier reconnu qui exploite une trentaine d'établissements en France, un(e) Directeur(trice) d'Hôtel 4 pour prendre la direction de deux établissements complémentaires idéalement situés au cœur de Beaune, en Bourgogne.

Je vous offre l'opportunité de rejoindre un groupe solide, reconnu pour la qualité de ses établissements et l'accompagnement qu'il apporte à ses équipes de direction. Vous bénéficierez d'un véritable support des services du siège tout en conservant une réelle autonomie dans le pilotage de vos hôtels.

À la tête d'un établissement 4 étoiles d'une centaine de chambres ainsi que d'un second établissement complémentaire, vous aurez pour mission de garantir l'excellence de l'expérience client, de fédérer vos équipes et de développer durablement les performances de l'exploitation.

Vous piloterez une équipe de collaborateurs que vous accompagnerez au quotidien avec proximité, exigence et bienveillance. Vous serez responsable des résultats économiques, de l'optimisation des coûts, de l'amélioration continue des performances et du développement commercial des établissements. Véritable ambassadeur des hôtels, vous développerez les partenariats locaux et veillerez à renforcer leur attractivité sur un marché dynamique.

Vous intégrerez un groupe qui met à la disposition de ses Directeurs les moyens, les outils et l'accompagnement nécessaires à leur réussite. Vous pourrez ainsi vous appuyer sur les fonctions supports du groupe tout en bénéficiant d'une réelle autonomie dans vos prises de décisions.

Au-delà d'un poste à responsabilités, je vous propose un cadre de vie privilégié au cœur de la Bourgogne, dans une ville emblématique pour son patrimoine, son art de vivre, sa gastronomie et son vignoble de renommée internationale.

Rémunération et avantages

Je vous propose une rémunération d'environ 50 000 € brut annuel, complétée par un variable pouvant atteindre 3 000 € brut par an selon l'atteinte des objectifs. Le poste est proposé sous le statut Cadre au forfait jours. Un logement pourra être mis à votre disposition durant votre période d'intégration, afin de faciliter votre installation dans la région.



Profil

## Le profil que je recherche

Je recherche avant tout un(e) véritable leader de terrain, passionné(e) par l'hôtellerie et capable de fédérer durablement ses équipes autour d'objectifs communs.

Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie d'au moins trois ans en qualité de Directeur(trice) d'hôtel, idéalement au sein d'un établissement 4 étoiles.

Doté(e) d'une forte fibre commerciale, vous savez développer le chiffre d'affaires, identifier les leviers de croissance et optimiser durablement les résultats de votre établissement. Vous êtes orienté(e) performance tout en veillant à maintenir un haut niveau de satisfaction client.

Manager reconnu(e), vous aimez accompagner, faire progresser et responsabiliser vos collaborateurs. Vous êtes capable de créer une véritable dynamique d'équipe, de fédérer autour d'objectifs communs et de développer les talents.

Organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et doté(e) d'un excellent sens de l'analyse, vous maîtrisez le pilotage d'un centre de profit, le suivi des indicateurs de performance, la gestion budgétaire ainsi que l'optimisation des coûts.

Votre sens du service, votre leadership, votre capacité d'adaptation, votre esprit d'initiative et votre excellent relationnel seront les clés de votre réussite.

Si vous souhaitez rejoindre un groupe hôtelier de référence, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, bénéficier d'un accompagnement de qualité et vivre dans l'une des plus belles régions viticoles de France, j'aurai plaisir à échanger avec vous en toute confidentialité.

jobs.title: Revenue Strategist Manager, Renewals
Tech Operations Specialist
Customer Success Manager- Public Sector
Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
## About Outsite

 

Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.

 

## About Outsite for Teams

 

Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

 

## Role Overview

 

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.

 

This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

 

## Key Responsibilities

 

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound

- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder

- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base

- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging

- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages

- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities

 

### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management

- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture

- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close

- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged

- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets

 

### 3. Collaboration & Handoff

- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound

- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals

- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time

 

### 4. Reporting

- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers

- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

 

## Required Skills & Experience

 

- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)

- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders

- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads

- Able to work autonomously and independently 

- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive 

- Comfortable working European timezone hours

- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job

- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to

- Comfortable using AI in workflow

 

## Nice to Have

 

- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams

- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot

- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space

- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product

 

## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

 

- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)

- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM

- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed

- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing

- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

 

## Benefits

 

- Remote, travel encouraged

- Credits for Outsite locations 

- Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description:
We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

 

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates 

The estimated hourly earnings for this role are 14 USD per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

 

Assessment

To join the program as an independent contractor, you will complete a language assessment, an open-book qualification exam, and an identity verification process.

 

The exam must be completed within a specified timeframe, but you may do so at your convenience.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent till kvinna
jobs.description:
Hej,

Jag är en glad och positiv kvinna i 50-årsåldern som bor i Arabiastranden i Helsingfors. Nu söker jag en personlig assistent som kan tillbringa cirka 15 timmar i månaden tillsammans med mig.

På vardagarna har jag dagverksamhet fram till kl. 13.00. Kvällar och veckoslut har jag däremot inget regelbundet program. Jag deltar gärna i vissa av DUV:s fritidsaktiviteter och uppskattar också möjligheten att ibland göra en utflykt under veckosluten. Särskilt under veckosluten önskar jag sällskap, eftersom dagarna annars kan bli långa.

Till mina intressen hör bland annat musik, sång, olika bollsporter, att pyssla hemma vid dåligt väder eller att åka en tur med spårvagnen. Jag tycker även om att besöka museer och bibliotek för att läsa djur och båttidningar. Jag behöver stöd i vardagen med till exempel påklädning, toalettbesök, tidsuppfattning och kommunikation.


Jag söker dig som är glad, empatisk och trygg. Det är viktigt för mig att du tycker om att umgås, prata och skämta, och att du kan skapa en trivsam och avslappnad stämning tillsammans med mig.

Den person som väljs till jobbet behöver visa upp ett giltigt straffregisterutdrag (Lag om tillsynen över social- och hälsovården 741/2023 § 28).

Intresserad?

Lämna din ansökan direkt via länken. Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och anställer så fort vi hittar en lämplig assistent!

Vill du veta mera innan du söker? Hör av dig till vår rådgivare Fanny Väärä, tel. 040 648 7747.

Din arbetsgivare blir JAG Assistans Ab , en icke-vinstdrivande serviceproducent som är specialiserad på personlig assistans för personer med olika funktionsnedsättningar. Det betyder att vi anställer, och är arbetsgivare åt, personliga assistenter och sköter administrationen kring den personliga assistansen. JAG står på en stark värdegrund: Alla människor är lika mycket värda, alla kan vara självbestämmande, alla kan kommunicera och alla har rätt att vara huvudperson i sitt eget liv!

jobs.description:
Wärtsilä Energy is looking fora Project Engineer, Electrical. This position is located in Vaasa, Finland. We offer the possibility of hybrid remote work.


The main responsibilities for this role are:

* Supporting project and sales teams with project-specific Electrical & Automation design
* Carrying out and coordinating assigned project activities, integration engineering and technical correspondence with internal team members, vendors, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders
* Creating project-specific technical specifications and design requirements for purchasing purposes
* Carrying out sub-supplier delivery and quality follow-ups
* Acting as a stand-in for Chief Project Engineers
* Supporting the site team during installation and commissioning



Development responsibilities for this role are:

* Participate in developing and maintaining tools and work methods in your own responsibility area
* To give, collect, and handle feedback regarding technical solutions and complaints
* Provide lessons learned initiatives for developing issues in your own responsibility area



For you to be able to shine in this role, we hope that you have the following experience:

* BSc. or MSc. in Electrical or Automation Engineering
* Understanding of electrical engineering systems and technical drawings
* Experience in design work, for example in industrial, infrastructure, marine, energy, or similar environments
* Being self-driven, having teamwork skills, being motivated to learn and grow professionally
* Being willing to travel, as well as being able to understand and work with diverse cultures
* Working experience in the electrical or automation field is seen as a benefit
* Ability to communicate in English



Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

For further questions, please reach out to Mathias Holmlund,Manager, Project Engineering through +358 50 300 9615 with any questions related to this position (only for questions from direct job applicants, applications through email will not be recorded or responded to).

Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja HAMINAAN
jobs.description:
**Tule töihin APUNA Avustajapalveluille!**

Etsimme henkilökohtaista avustajaa asiakkaallemme **Haminaan**. Haemme luotettavaa, ystävällistä ja oma-aloitteista avustajaa, jolla on aito halu auttaa toista ihmistä arjessa. Aiempi kokemus henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä tai sosiaali- ja terveysalalta on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä – tärkeintä on oikeanlainen asenne, luotettavuus ja hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot. Työ sopii erinomaisesti myös opiskelijalle.

Tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.Työ sisältää asiakkaan avustamista päivittäisissä toimissa, kuten: avustamista peseytymisessä ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa, avustamista pukeutumisessa ja siirtymisissä, kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, asioinneilla ja kodin ulkopuolisissa toiminnoissa avustamista, sekä muuta asiakkaan arkea tukevaa avustamista hänen yksilöllisten tarpeidensa mukaisesti.

Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen, joten voit hakea tehtävää myös ilman aiempaa kokemusta.Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääasiassa arkipäiviin. Työtuntien määrä ja työajat sovitaan asiakkaan tarpeen mukaisesti. Toivomme, että pystyt sitoutumaan asiakkuuteen pitkäaikaisesti.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- merkityksellisen työn, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan toisen ihmisen arkeen

- kattavan perehdytyksen ennen työn aloittamista

- kannustavan ja helposti tavoitettavan esihenkilön tuen

- mahdollisuuden palkanmaksuun kerran tai kahdesti kuukaudessa

- yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan, **G15–G17 työtehtävistä ja osaamisesta riippuen**.

**Tervetuloa mukaan APUNA Avustajapalveluiden tiimiin!**

APUNA Avustajapalvelut tarjoaa henkilökohtaisen avun palveluita eri elämäntilanteissa oleville ihmisille ympäri Suomen. Toimintamme perustuu luotettavaan, yksilölliseen ja asiakkaan omia voimavaroja tukevaan palveluun. Haluamme olla työnantaja, jossa työntekijät viihtyvät ja voivat keskittyä siihen, mikä työssä on tärkeintä – ihmisten auttamiseen.

jobs.title: Myyjiä henkilöstöpooliin Koillismaan osuuskauppaan
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUUSAMO

Haemme myyjiä Koillismaan osuuskaupan henkilöstöpooliin eli Savottatiimiin

Savotalla kukaan ei pärjää yksin – parhaat tulokset syntyvät yhteistyöllä. Siksi savottalaisen sydän ohjaa meidän arkeamme täällä Koillismaalla: autamme toisiamme yli toimipaikkarajojen, tartumme rohkeasti toimeen ja huolehdimme siitä, että niin työkaverit kuin asiakkaatkin voivat luottaa siihen, että apua löytyy silloin, kun sitä tarvitaan. Tätä tarvetta varten rakennamme Savottatiimin – henkilöstöpoolin, jonka jäsenet varmistavat, että apu on lähellä.

Haemme joukkoomme rohkeita tekijöitä – Savottalaisia – jotka ovat valmiita tekemään aidosti merkityksellistä työtä useissa oman savotta-alueensa toimipaikoissa. Toimipaikkoja ovat osuuskauppamme Salet, S-marketit, Prisma ja ABC:t. Savottatiimi toimii kolmella alueella: Itälapin alue (Kemijärvi – Salla – Savukoski), Ruka-Kuusamon alue ja Taivalkoski – Posion alue. Työ edellyttää mahdollisuutta liikkua oman savotta-alueesi toimipaikkojen välillä omalla autolla tai muulla luotettavalla kulkutavalla. Työsopimuksen viikkotyöaika on 10–25 tuntia, ja työvuorot suunnitellaan työvoimatarpeen mukaan. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan elo–syyskuun aikana. Sopimus on määräaikainen.
Savottalaisena yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen. yhtenä päivänä voit aloittaa työvuorosi Prismassa hyllytyksen ja asiakaspalvelun parissa, seuraavalla viikolla olla tukemassa Salea sesonkikiireessä ja kuukauden päästä auttaa ABC:llä ruuhkahuipun aikana.

Mitä Savottalaisen työ on?
Savottalaisena työskentelet siellä, missä osaamistasi juuri sillä hetkellä tarvitaan. Työpäiväsi voivat sijoittua alueesi eri toimipaikkoihin esimerkiksi:
äkillisten sairauspoissaolojen tueksi
vuosilomien sijaisuuksiin
sesonkien kiireisiin
uusien tiimien ja toimipaikkojen vahvistukseksi
Jokainen savottavuoro on mahdollisuus auttaa työyhteisöä onnistumaan ja varmistaa, että asiakkaamme saavat aina parasta mahdollista palvelua. Työvuorot suunnitellaan pääosin etukäteen, mutta osa vuoroista voi tulla tarjolle myös lyhyemmällä varoitusajalla esimerkiksi äkillisten poissaolojen vuoksi.

Kenelle työ sopii?
Sinulle, joka:
nautit vaihtelevista työpäivistä
innostut uusista ihmisistä ja työyhteisöistä
opit nopeasti uusia toimintatapoja
toimit oma-aloitteisesti ja joustavasti
haluat kehittyä moniosaajaksi
olet valmis liikkumaan savotta-alueesi toimipaikkojen välillä
Aikaisempi kokemus kaupan alalta on eduksi, mutta perehdytämme tehtävään huolellisesti. Saat perehdytyksen niihin toimipaikkoihin ja työtehtäviin, joissa työskentelet.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
monipuolisen työn eri toimipaikoissa
kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen
mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi laajasti
S-ryhmän erinomaiset henkilöstöedut Erinomaiset edut – Koillismaa
Kaupan TES:n mukainen myyjän palkkaus ja mahdollisuus tulospalkkioon

Miksi Savottatiimi?
Savottatiimissä et työskentele vain yhdessä toimipaikassa – pääset tutustumaan koko osuuskauppaamme ja rakentamaan laajan verkoston eri työyhteisöissä.
Savottatiimi pitää arjen liikkeessä. Savottalaiset menevät sinne, missä heidän osaamisellaan on juuri sillä hetkellä suurin merkitys, ja varmistavat, että asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta palvelua myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa.
Savottalaisena toimit eri toimipaikoissa, tutustut uusiin työyhteisöihin ja pääset jakamaan omaa osaamistasi samalla, kun kartutat kokemusta erilaisista työympäristöistä. Työ tarjoaa vaihtelua, jatkuvaa oppimista ja mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti.
Savottatiimissä työskentely avaa myös uusia näkökulmia organisaatioomme ja voi tarjota arvokkaita kokemuksia sekä uusia uramahdollisuuksia oman osuuskauppamme sisällä.
Savottatiimissä et jää yksin – jokaisessa toimipaikassa sinut otetaan vastaan osaksi työyhteisöä, ja tukenasi ovat sekä esihenkilöt että kollegat.

Oletko sinä seuraava Savottalainen?
Jos nautit vaihtelusta, haluat oppia uutta ja tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitystä, Savottatiimi voi olla juuri sinun paikkasi. Hae mukaan tekemään yhdessä sujuvaa arkea – yksi savottavuoro kerrallaan.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer (CIO – at Assistant Secretary level) and working closely with the Director of Operations and Platforms, the Director of Technology and ICT Transformation will lead a team of circa 4 Principal Officers and over 120 staff, managing a complex ICT portfolio and major change programs with significant technology dependencies. They will oversee high-value service contracts with IT providers and lead the Enterprise Architecture function to align technology with departmental, Government and EU objectives. A key priority will be developing a new Target Architecture to reduce legacy platform risks and enable modern, data-driven services. Key priorities include advancing cloud migration, strengthening cybersecurity, embedding automation and AI technologies, and enabling innovative service models that support remote working and digital self-service. As a member of the ISD Management Board, the Director will champion transformation strategies aligned with the Programme for Government and DSP’s Statement of Strategy, challenging traditional approaches, continue to gain operational effectiveness from our ICT investment and demonstrating the potential of new emerging technology and paradigms (such as proactive customer service). Strategic initiatives will include providing strategic oversight and evaluation of enterprise architecture decisions, including the replacement and/or re-platforming of legacy monolithic platforms, implementing enhanced proactive service for our customers and implementing a core pillar of the government’s Digital Public Service Plan 2030 (such as Life Events services). The Director will sit on the ISD Management Board and lead strategies such as the ICT, Data, AI and Cloud Strategies, and contribute to implementing strategies such as the Security and IT Skills, ensuring alignment with the Programme for Government and the Department’s Statement of Strategy and acting as a thought leader and advocate for digital transformation. This role faces significant challenges: maintaining continuous service delivery while modernising systems, meeting growing demand for ICT services and data, ensuring compliance with GDPR, ISO 27001 and NIS2, strengthening cybersecurity, and leveraging automation technologies including AI. An understanding of social welfare and employment services, or the ability to quickly acquire it, will be important, alongside the ability to develop practical and innovative ICT solutions. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in ICT transformation and large-scale change programmes, strong stakeholder engagement and contract management skills. Further information regarding the post and candidate requirements is set out in the Candidate Information Booklet. To download the Candidate Information Booklet and access the link to apply, please visit www.gov.ie/dspcareers. Candidate queries in relation to the campaign can be sent to ICTRecruitment@welfare.ie

jobs.title: Head Baker Wanted – Lead the Rise at Flåm Bakery
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled and passionate baker who loves crafting high-quality baked goods – and ready to take charge of production in a bakery known for its high standards? Would you like to build strong teams and play a key role in further developing our bakeries in Flåm and Lærdal? Then we’d love to hear from you!

Flåm Artisan bakery is looking for an experienced baker to lead the production team.

About us:

Flåm Bakeri opened in 2016 and has been a fantastic success ever since. Last summer, we moved into brand-new, spacious premises on the waterfront in the heart of Flåm. Our second location, Laksen Bakeri & Kafé in Lærdal, has seen similar growth. Together, we offer a wide range of products, including artisan breads, traditional Norwegian sweet buns, and classic international pastries – as well as local juices, sandwiches, pizza, and barista coffee. We also do daily deliveries of bread and pastry products to Myrkdalen Resort, our hotels in Flåm/Aurland and Sognaporten.

As Head of Bakery Production, you will play a central role in ensuring our bakeries deliver top-quality baked goods every day. You’ll be a key partner to Gro, manager at 3 of our venues, and help drive the development of our production processes, product range, and team culture.

Key responsibilities:

  • Plan and organize the daily production of baked goods across our locations to ensure freshness and quality at all times
  • Actively participate in production while maintaining high standards and efficient workflows
  • Collaborate with the leadership team to develop and adapt our product offerings in line with customer preferences and market trends
  • Follow established food safety and hygiene procedures (IK-mat) and ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations
  • Support administrative tasks such as shift planning and recruitment
  • Foster a positive and inclusive team culture with a focus on motivation, collaboration, and well-being
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of production routines and product development

    Qualifications:

  • Certificate of apprenticeship (fagbrev) as a baker or equivalent experience in food production
  • Several years of experience from an artisan bakery, with solid knowledge of production techniques and quality control
  • Experience with cake baking is a plus
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead and inspire a team
  • Driver’s license (Class B)
  • Good English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Knowledge of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is an advantage, but not a requirement

We offer:

An exciting position in an ambitious and dynamic company committed to people and community. You’ll join a proud and passionate team within one of Norway’s leading tourism companies, where we encourage both personal and professional growth. At Norway’s Best, we value diversity and inclusion – it’s reflected in our culture. Our employees are encouraged to ask questions, be themselves, and are seen and respected for who they are.

Some of our employee benefits:
