Norway’s best Group AS (NBG) er eit leiande norsk reiselivskonsern, med nokre av Norges mest spektakulære natur- og kulturbaserte reiseopplevingar i vår portefølje. Konsernet har sitt hovudkontor i Flåm, og kontorstader i Myrkdalen, på Voss, i Bergen og Narvik. Vi har ein nasjonal ambisjon og er ein konsolidator i norsk reiseliv. NBG er i front på heilskapleg reisemålsutvikling, og har i dag ei verksemd bygd på våre heilårssatsingar i Flåm, Myrkdalen og Narvik. I over 25 år har vi posisjonert Flåm, med Flåmsbana og Nærøyfjorden, til å bli eit av Norges mest populære reisemål. I pudderparadiset Myrkdalen, med Myrkdalen Fjellandsby, har vi den største skidestinasjonen på Vestlandet. I nord eig vi Narvikfjellet i Narvik og verdens nordlegaste dyrepark Polar Park i Bardu. Selskapet har i tillegg aktivitet i Aurland, Lærdal, Geiranger og Oslo. Selskapet har ein stor kommersiell avdeling som marknadsfører og selger våre eigne og andre aktørar sine attraktive produkt til gjester over heile verda. NBG har ein omsetning på vel 850 MNOK, meir enn 500 heilårs- og deltidsansatte og 2 millionar gjester årleg. Utover vår reisemålssatsing eig NBG-konsernet også det innovative selskapet The Fjords, som tilbyr unike nullutslepps reiseopplevingar på norske fjordar, og 50% av den spektakulære Flåmsbana. NBG er ikkje berre eit reiselivskonsern, vi er også ein samfunnsbyggar som ønsker å skape positive ringverknader og attraktive lokalsamfunn der vi har vår verksemd. Vi ønsker å vere i front på bærekraftig reiselivsutvikling og bidra til ei ansvarleg og framtidsretta reiselivsnæring. Vi gjer vårt yttarste for å redusere vår miljøpåvirkning og støtte opp rundt lokal verdiskaping. Våre ansatte er kjernen i verksemda og vi ønsker å skape eit inkluderande, mangfaldig og likestilt miljø med attraktive arbeidsplassar.

jobs.title: Senior Analog Design Engineer, ASIC
jobs.description:
We are strengthening ASIC Design Team in Murata Finland. Therefore, we are looking for a Senior Analog Design Engineer to join our team in Vantaa, Finland.

Murata Finland is developing leading edge gyroscope and accelerometer safety-critical sensors for global automotive, industrial and healthcare markets. We design full custom mixed mode ASICs from concept level to volume production including wafer level testing. Murata has flexible remote work policy and way of working can be planned according to your personal needs. The job includes on-site work, and part of it can also be done remotely.

Based on your experience and preferences in this position you have opportunity to focus and develop your skills in one of the following roles:

· ASIC Sr. Design Engineer role focusing on block level design and verification or

· Technical Lead role taking responsibility of a specific ASIC design area including leading a small sub team or

- In analog technical lead role, you will take responsibility for a specific ASIC design area and become an expert on that. You work together with a small group of designers leading their design activities and providing support for them. As a technical lead you will also work closely with ASIC PM, other technical leads and stake holders in ASIC project.


· ASIC Project Manager role leading the work of entire ASIC project.

- After you gain experience on Murata ASIC projects there is a possibility to take also a project manager role.


Your main responsibility areas are:

· ASIC specification and system description

· ASIC design, verification and reporting

- Including modules like bandgap, LDO, PLL, ADC, DAC, different SC-circuits and high voltage circuits


· Characterization specifications and result analysis

· Support for production wafer test and result analysis

To be successful in these roles, these are the expected qualities and skills:

- Technical education (e.g. M.Sc., Ph.D. or D.Sc.) with emphasis on microelectronics

- 5+ years of experience in analog ASIC design

- Understanding and knowhow of the common analog blocks such as: VBG, LDO, amplifiers, ADC, DAC, oscillators, filters etc, Basic understanding of digital signal processing

- Know-how of both continuous and switched capacitor circuits

- Experience of EDA tools and mixed signal design flows

- Proactive, systematic and careful way of working

- Fluent communication in English

- Good communication skills to understand various requirements and communicate with external partners and internal teams

- Innovative mindset and interest in working in an international environment

- In addition to the skills mentioned above, the Tech Lead and PM roles also require task management skills, leadership abilities and experience on a technical lead role.

We also strengthen customer satisfaction by being proactive and innovative and always thinking what our customer needs. Would this kind of work community suit you?

This is an excellent opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology contributing to the advancement of society. We believe that the tiniest things can have the greatest impact. jobs.title: Driver & Mechanic
jobs.employer: VOI TECHNOLOGY NORWAY AS AVD STAVANGER
jobs.description:
Your mission at Voi 

For the position as a Driver & Mechanic - (Fleet Specialist) you'll have the possibility of working in two different areas, depending on workload and suitability. We have our mechanical team, where you will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of our vehicles. This means keeping our scooters in top shape and provide strong support to our team on the ground. We also have our In field team, where you'll be utilising our vans to perform different tasks in the Stavanger area, making sure our operations runs as efficiently as possible. Here are some exciting tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist:

  • Ensuring the logistics of collecting and providing Voi scooters.⚙️

  • Searching for and collecting damaged scooters. 🛴

  • Battery replacement.🔋

  • Performing quick on-site repairs of the scooters.🔧

  • Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles.🔧

  • Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired. ♻️

  • Assisting with the acceptance, packaging, and provision of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse. 🔍

  • Supporting our on-site team as needed, whether it's identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces, or setting up fallen vehicles.🤝

What you'll need to embark

We're looking for a highly motivated and responsible team player who can handle tasks and solve problems independently. With a proactive approach, you should be skilled in finding innovative solutions and achieving set objectives. In addition, the right candidate should have:

  • A valid drivers license for Norway preferred

  • Fluent english, both verbal and written

  • Previous experience with tools or mechanical practices

  • General familiarity with digital tools and applications

  • Local knowledge of Oslo and experience driving in the city

  • The ability to remain calm in stressful situations (such as difficult parking or traffic)

Job conditions 

  • Working hours: Part time 60% - Rotating shifts

  • Contract type: Fixed term

  • Start date: ASAP

NOTE: our Talent Acquisition is based in UK, you will receive a phone call from a UK number (+44)

Why Voi?

Working at Voi is more than just a job; it's a personal Voiage where you'll grow as a professional and be part of a diverse team and culture that's committed to making a positive impact on society. In addition to this, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Join Europe's leading micromobility company and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups

  • Make a direct impact on our ongoing success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in Stavanger.

  • Collaborate with inspiring, motivated, and diverse colleagues who share a common goal

  • Be a part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are clean, quiet, and free from pollution

Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Since 2018, Voi has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 150,000+ vehicles in 110+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 400+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.

Diversity Matters

As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

jobs.title: Analog Design Engineer, ASIC
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Analog Design Engineer to join our ASIC Design Team in Finland. Our office is located in Vantaa, capital region area of Finland.

Murata Finland is developing leading edge gyroscope and accelerometer safety-critical sensors for global automotive, industrial and healthcare markets. We design full custom mixed mode ASICs from concept level to volume production including wafer level testing. Murata has flexible remote work policy and way of working can be planned according to your personal needs. The job includes on-site work, and part of it can also be done remotely.

In this role your main responsibility areas are:

· ASIC design, verification and reporting

- Including modules like bandgap, LDO, PLL, ADC, DAC, different SC-circuits and high voltage circuits.


· Characterization specifications and result analysis

· Support for production wafer test and result analysis

To be successful in this role, these are the expected qualities and skills:

· Technical education (e.g. M.Sc) with emphasis on microelectronics

· Basic understanding of the most common analog blocks (e.g. opamps, current mirrors, voltage references, AD/DA converters)

· Some design experience in analog ASIC design from industry or university projects

·You have experience or readiness to learn

- Design and verification of analog blocks using EDA tools

- Layout design using EDA tools

- Modeling and simulation of analog blocks with System Verilog

- Support of ASIC characterization

- Modeling and simulation system solutions with Matlab or Simulink-


· You communicate fluently in English

· Systematic and careful way of working

· You are innovative and interested in working in an international environment

Our culture is based on our values, which are employee satisfaction and customer satisfaction, and we have agreed together what the values mean in practice. We call this cultural etiquette. According to our cultural etiquette we strengthen employee satisfaction by helping each other, treating each other equally and friendly as well as open discussion culture. We also strengthen customer satisfaction by being proactive and innovative and always thinking what our customer needs. Would this kind of work community suit you?

This is an excellent opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology contributing to the advancement of society. We believe that the tiniest things can have the greatest impact. With our innovative sensor technology, cars remain in their lanes, peoples hearts keep beating and bridges do not collapse. The combination of our Finnish and Japanese capabilities will enable safe and autonomous driving – in all places.

For more information, please contact the hiring manager Juha Syvänen, tel. +358 40 641 6301 (after 3rd August 2026) or e-mail juha.syvanen@murata.com. Juha is pleased to tell you more about Murata and the job. Please send your application with resume and salary expectations via the link latest on 12th Aug 2026. Our hiring team is on vacation during July so we will start browsing through applications in August. Interviews will be held around calendar weeks 34 and 35. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

Read more about Murata at www.muratafinland.com and follow us in LinkedIn (Murata), Instagram (@muratafinland) and Facebook (@MurataFinland).

From our News & Stories, you can read more about what it's like to work at Murata and find out if Murata is the right workplace for you! You can read about the different teams, the study and career path opportunities, as well as how development and growth appear at Murata, from product development to production work.

Ympäristötekninen toimiala

Ympäristöteknisellä toimialalla näet työsi jäljen konkreettisesti päivittäin. Huolehdimme siitä, että Kajaani on viihtyisä ja sujuva kaupunki: kadut ja puistot ovat kunnossa, liikuntapaikat kutsuvat liikkumaan ja rakennettu ympäristö kehittyy kestävän kehityksen periaatteiden mukaisesti.

Kajaanin kaupunki on monialainen työnantaja, joka arvostaa työn ja perhe-elämän tasapainoa. Perheiden monimuotoisuus nähdään vahvuutena, ja haluamme kehittää jatkuvasti käytäntöjämme entistä perheystävällisemmiksi. Lue lisää Kajaanin kaupungista työnantajana: kuntarekry.fi/kajaaninkaupunki

jobs.description:
Fixus korjaamo Ruskon Autohuolto Oy etsii vahvistuksia tiimiinsä!

Haluatko töihin nykyaikaiseen ja rentoon korjaamoon, jossa hommia tehdään hyvällä asenteella ja ammattiylpeydellä?

Aikaisempaa kokemusta autoalalta

Vakinaisen työpaikan

Monipuoliset työtehtävät

Hyvän työporukan

Nykyaikaiset työtilat ja työvälineet

Palkkaus tes / sopim mukaan.

Laita avoin hakemus niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja
jobs.description:
Haetaan lähihoitajaa mielenterveyskuntoutujien palvelukotiin. Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa, joka sisältää myös yksintyöskentelyä. Työntekijältä vaaditaan oma-aloitteisuutta, luotettavuutta sekä yhteistyötaitoja. Valmiutta ja rohkeutta itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja kykyä kohdata asukkaat rauhallisesti ja ennakkoluulottomasti. Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä tehdä itsenäisiä päätöksiä. Työ sisältää asukkaiden ohjausta ja avustamista kaikissa arkipäivän asioissa sekä kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä. Arjen pyörittäminen, kuten ruoan laitto, siivous, pyykkihuolto ja kaupassa käynti ovat tärkeä osa työtäsi. Tehtävät tehdään yhdessä asukkaiden kanssa heidän toimintakykyään tukien ja vahvistaen. Vastaat asukkaiden turvallisesta lääkehoidosta ja dokumentoinnista.

Kyseessä aluksi määräaikainen työsuhde 30.8.2026 saakka ja sen jälkeen työtä tarjolla joustavasti. Saat pitkän ja huolellisen perehdytyksen kokeneiden työntekijöiden rinnalla. Perehdytystä jatketaan aina niin kauan, kunnes tunnet olosi täysin varmaksi, ennen ensimmäistä itsenäistä työvuoroasi. Palkkaus määräytyy Yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukaisesti. Tervetuloa mukaan avoimeen, rempseään ja mukavaan työporukkaamme.

jobs.title: Transporto specialistas (-ė)
jobs.description:
Užtikrinti techniškai tvarkingą Bendrovės transporto priemonių būklę ir jų saugų eksploatavimą.
Kontroliuoti transporto priemonių ridą, alyvų, filtrų, padangų būklę ir techninės priežiūros periodiškumą.
Organizuoti transporto priemonių techninius aptarnavimus, remontus ir technines apžiūras.
Užtikrinti savalaikį transporto priemonių civilinės atsakomybės ir KASKO draudimų pratęsimą.
Vesti transporto priemonių remonto, techninės priežiūros ir profilaktikos dokumentaciją.
Kontroliuoti racionalų medžiagų ir mechanizmų naudojimą.
Užtikrinti, kad transporto priemones eksploatuojantys darbuotojai laikytųsi saugos ir sveikatos, gaisrinės saugos bei kitų teisės aktų reikalavimų.

jobs.description:
Primary location:
TEUVA

HAE MYYJÄKSI S-market TeuvalleMyyjän työ S-marketin arjessa koostuu monipuolisista kaupan työtehtävistä: hyllytyksestä ja esillepanoista, kassatyöstä, kuorman purusta ja tietysti tärkeimmästä eli asiakaspalvelusta.
Meillä on nyt avoinna määräaikainen sijaisuus 3.1.2027 saakka, jossa työtunteja on 30 h/vko

Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissa töissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia.

Odotamme sinulta:
Myyjän työssä tarvitaan positiivista asiakaspalveluasennetta, hyvät sosiaaliset taidot ja reipasta oma-aloitteisuutta. Etsimme toimeen tarttuvaa tyyppiä, joka ei pelkää ryhtyä töihin ja saa hommat hoidettua. Myyjän työ on tänä päivänä yhä digitaalisempaa, ja siksi odotamme sinulta myös sujuvaa otetta järjestelmiin ja myymälän teknisiin työvälineisiin. Aikaisempi kokemus kaupanalan tehtävistä on plussaa, mutta positiivinen asenne ja aito halu tehdä asiakaspalvelutyötä ovat tehtävässä menestyäksesi kaikkein tärkeintä.

Me perehdytämme sinut käytännönläheisesti tehtäviisi. Teemme työtä tiiminä, joten arvostamme hyvää työkaveruutta ja yhteistyötaitoja ja valmiutta työskennellä myymälän monipuolisissa työtehtävissä. Edellytämme joustavuutta työskennellä vuorotyössä, kaupan aukioloaikoina. Olethan myös täysi-ikäinen, 18-vuotta täyttänyt.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
Erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.
Koko henkilöstöämme koskeva tulospalkkiojärjestelmä
Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan ja hyvinvoinnin Epassi-edut
Poikkeuksellisen paljon mahdollisuuksia! Voit vaihtaa ammattia, toimialaa tai ottaa lisätyötä oman osaamisesi ja toiveidesi mukaan

Innostuitko?
Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 2.8.2026.
Toivomme, että pääset liittymään joukkoomme elokuun aikana.

jobs.title: Pædagog 32 timer til Maria Mikkelsens Børnehus
jobs.description:
Vi søger en pædagog, 32 timer ugentligt.

Hvem søger vi:

Vi søger en uddannet pædagog, som er engageret, har høj pædagogisk faglighed samt har lyst til at arbejde primært med børnehavebørn.

Maria Mikkelsens Børnehus er beliggende i Kolding midtby. Vi er en lille privat institution.

Vi er normeret til 65 børn hvoraf de 17 kan være vuggestuebørn.

Vi er fordelt på to børnehavegrupper og en vuggestuegruppe.

 

Vi glæder os rigtig meget til at møde dig, som:

  • Har et godt overblik i en travl hverdag

  • Er omsorgsfuld, empatisk, nærværende og i øjenhøjde

  • Er nysgerrig på at forstå børnenes opfattelse af verden, og tager udgangspunkt i børneperspektivet

  • Har hjertet på rette sted og brænder for sit arbejde

  • Er rig på initiativer, og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger

  • Tør reflektere over egen praksis og tør give kollegaer feedback

 

Det er desuden vigtigt for os, at du er en stabil, loyal, fleksibel og en omstillingsparat kollega. Du skal være indstillet på at skulle arbejde både i vuggestue og i børnehaven, og at du kan arbejde indenfor Børnehusets åbningstid, som er mellem 6.30 og 16.45

 

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • Et dejligt hus, med en flok skønne børn, og en engageret forældregruppe

  • En flok kollegaer, der brænder for deres arbejde

  • Et unikt hus, hvor vi lægger vægt på gode værdier og traditioner

  • Mulighed for at sætte præg på dagligdagen.

  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår, i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem DLO og BUPL

 

Se mere på vores hjemmeside: www.mariamikkelsen.dk

Hvis du er blevet nysgerrig efter at vide mere om stillingen, kan du ringe på telefon 21375985, og bede om at tale med Leder Lene Hansen, eller souschef Pia Christensen.

Søg i dag på mail leder@mariamikkelsen.dk . Vi afholder løbende samtaler så når vi har fundet den rette, lukker vi for ansøgninger.

 

Ved ansættelse i stillingen, bliver der indhentet børne -og straffeattest.

jobs.title: S-päällikkövalmennettava Eekoolle
jobs.description:

LAPPEENRANTA

Etsimme innostuneita ja tavoitteellisia S-päällikkövalmennettavia Eekoolle!

Haaveiletko tulevaisuudessa marketkaupan tai ravintola-alan päällikkötehtävistä? Haluatko kehittää osaamistasi käytännössä ja ottaa vastuuta? Nyt sinulla on mahdollisuus rakentaa urapolkusi S-päällikkövalmennuksessa!
Mikä on S-päällikkövalmennus?S-päällikkövalmennus on palkallinen, käytännönläheinen, noin vuoden mittainen valmennusohjelma, joka antaa erinomaiset valmiudet toimia tulevaisuuden päällikkötehtävissä. Valmennuksen aikana pääset tutustumaan toimialasi eri yksiköihin ympäri Eekoon aluetta, kartutat johtamisosaamistasi ja verkostoidut muiden S-ryhmän valmennettavien kanssa. Valmennus alkaa marraskuussa 2026.
Valmennuksen jälkeen sinulla on valmiudet työskennellä esimerkiksi vuoro-, ravintola-, apulais- tai marketpäällikön tehtävissä.
Mitä tarjoamme sinulle? Monipuolisen ja käytännönläheisen valmennusohjelman, jossa yhdistyvät työssäoppiminen ja valmennuspäivät
Oman tutorin tueksesi koko valmennuksen ajaksi
Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen, palkka valmennuksen ajalta 2552 €/kk.
Eekoon tutkitusti huippuhyvät työkaverit ja innostavan työyhteisön
Eekoon ja S-ryhmän kattavat henkilöstöedut

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?Olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen, kehittämisestä innostuva ja tavoitteellinen tekijä, jolla on halu kasvaa tulevaisuuden päälliköksi
Toivomme sinulta:
Iloista ja aktiivista palveluasennetta sekä halua luoda asiakkaille elämänmakuisia kohtaamisia
Oma-aloitteisuutta ja rohkeutta tarttua uusiin haasteisiin
Hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä toimia myös kiiretilanteissa
Kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen ja halua johtaa esimerkillä
Intoa oppia uutta sekä kehittää itseäsi ja työyhteisöäsi
Halua rakentaa tulevaisuutesi päällikkönä Eekoon toimialoilla
Mitä odotamme koulutukseltasi ja kokemukseltasi?Valmennus soveltuu sinulle, jos olet suorittanut AMK-tutkinnon tai olet valmistumassa lähiaikoina, tai sinulla on ammatillinen tutkinto sekä jo vähän alan työkokemusta.
Aikaisempi kokemus marketkaupan tai ravintola-alan työtehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.
Edellytämme lisäksi valmiutta työskennellä vuorotyössä sekä liikkua Eekoon eri toimipaikkojen välillä valmennuksen aikana.

jobs.title: Southeast Asian Cuisine Chef
jobs.description:
Nordic Unique Travels is one of the main travel companies located in Rovaniemi, Finland. We specialize in tours in Lapland - in Finland, North Norway, and Sweden. At the moment we have more than 100 tours and holiday packages in the Arctic Circle. Lapland is a great winter destination offering unforgettable experiences. Because of its nature, northern lights, winter activities, unique cuisine and accommodation and of course Santa Claus, it is very popular among customers from all around the world.

Aito Igloo & Spa Resort is a haven nestled amidst the breathtaking beauty of Palojärvi Lake in Rovaniemi. Located next to the lake in the forest, Aito offers customers not only a beautiful location and diverse accommodations but also access to a spa, sauna, and various activities. Combining the warmth of Finnish hospitality with modern amenities and a touch of wilderness, Aito is poised to become the ultimate destination for relaxation and adventure in this enchanting Arctic region. At Aito, we believe in creating a harmonious blend of comfort, nature, and culture.

We are looking for chefs with deep knowledge of Southeast Asian cuisines and flavors to expand our dining menus and enrich our customers experiences.

Part time/Full time position

\- 2 people

\*Requirements:

\-Preparing and assembling ingredients for menu items.

\-Preparing high-quality meals and food items according to company recipes.

\-Storing excess food at the correct temperature in order to avoid spoilage.

\-Ensuring that food portions and food presentation meet company standards.

\-Monitoring supplies and re-ordering stock as needed.

\-Ensuring that cooking utensils are clean before each use.

\-Cleaning and sterilizing food preparation areas.

\-Assisting other cooks to ensure that food orders are completed in a timely manner.

\-Efficiently resolving problems with customers orders.

\-Ensuring that food health and safety regulations are followed.

\- Hygiene Passport is a must;

\*Basic Duties and Responsibilities:

\-ServSafe food handling certification is preferred.

\-Sound knowledge of cooking methods and techniques.

\-The ability to follow recipes.

\-The ability to work in a team.

\-Extensive/native knowledge of Southeast Asian cuisines and ingredients.

If you believe you are enthusiastic and have the expected skills, send your cover letter and CV in PDF file to us at jobs@nordictravels.eu.

jobs.title: Junior CNC Machinist / CNC Operator
jobs.description:
Start your CNC career with a modern manufacturing company.

 

EasyPartz is looking for a motivated Junior CNC Machinist / CNC Operator who wants to build a long-term career in precision manufacturing.

You will become part of an experienced machining team and develop your skills through daily hands-on work, practical shop-floor learning, and mentorship from experienced CNC machinists. We are looking for people who enjoy practical work, take pride in producing high-quality components, and are eager to continuously develop their technical skills.

International candidates are welcome. For qualified applicants, EasyPartz can support the Danish work permit and visa application process where applicable.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate CNC milling and turning machines under the guidance of experienced machinists.

  • Assist with machine setup, tooling, and workholding.

  • Read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing instructions.

  • Perform in-process and final measurements using inspection equipment.

  • Monitor machining operations and report deviations.

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and well-organized workplace in accordance with 5S principles.

  • Follow company procedures for quality, safety, and production reporting.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and efficient workshop operations.

 

Requirements

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Vocational education or practical experience in CNC machining, machining technology, metalworking, or a related mechanical field.

  • Basic understanding of CNC machining principles and manufacturing processes.

  • Ability to read technical drawings and use standard measuring equipment, or the willingness to develop these skills quickly.

  • Good mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.

  • A responsible attitude towards quality, safety, and teamwork.

  • English communication skills sufficient to work effectively in an international production environment.

  • Motivation to relocate to Denmark and build a long-term career with EasyPartz.

Experience with CNC milling, CNC turning, Fusion 360, Fanuc, Haas, or robotic machine tending is considered an advantage but is not required.

 

What We Offer

  • Permanent full-time employment.

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

  • Pension and private health insurance.

  • Mentorship from experienced CNC machinists.

  • Modern CNC machines and manufacturing technologies.

  • A clean, well-organized, and safety-focused production environment.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression within the company.

  • Support with relocation and Danish work permit processes for qualified international candidates.

 

About EasyPartz

EasyPartz is a growing Danish precision machining company located in Søborg, just outside Copenhagen. We specialize in CNC milling and turning, producing high-quality precision components for customers across Europe in industries where quality, precision, and reliability are essential.

We are building a digitally driven manufacturing environment, continuously investing in CNC technology, automation, robotics, and digital production systems. By combining skilled craftsmanship with modern manufacturing technologies and Lean principles, we are creating a workplace focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Whether you are starting your career or expanding your experience, you will work alongside skilled professionals in a collaborative environment where learning, responsibility, and continuous development are part of everyday work.

 

Apply

Please send us:

  • Your CV

  • A short introduction about yourself

  • Information about your education and machining experience

Applications are reviewed continuously, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found.

jobs.title: Professor / Associate Professor in Biomedical Innovation
jobs.description:
The Department of Biomedicine at Faculty of Health Sciences at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Professor / Associate Professor per 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a full-time permanent position.

This initiative is a direct extension of Aarhus University’s Strategy 2030, in which research-based innovation and entrepreneurship are central strategic priorities. To strengthen the university’s capacity to translate research into innovation, the university leadership has established a number of new research and innovation positions across Aarhus University. These positions are intended to foster an innovation mindset throughout the university while generating tangible societal impact through research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and collaboration.

The primary focus for this position is research-based innovation. We are looking for scientists with medical research background who sees opportunities in collaboration with the strong existing research groups at Aarhus University and Aarhus University Hospital and leading international institutions.

About the Department
The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. The department employs approx. 600 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory, core and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation and entrepreneurship. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities as Professor / Associate Professor
We offer an attractive career opportunity for researchers with a strong track record in medical research and innovation. The successful candidate is expected to:

  • strengthen the department’s research, innovation, and research-based teaching, and contribute to the academic development of Aarhus University and its national and international profile.

  • conduct original, internationally recognized research and demonstrate scientific excellence at the highest international level.

  • have experience with commercialization of research and technology including protection of intellectual property (IP) rights.

  • contribute to the Faculty of Health Sciences’ strategic priorities in innovation and collaboration by supporting the commercialization of research, building innovation capacity, and developing collaborations with external partners.

  • actively engage in Aarhus University’s innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem and contribute to translating research into societal impact through innovation, entrepreneurship, spinouts, and collaborations with industry.

  • contribute to academic citizenship by actively engaging in the department's academic community and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and respectful working environment.


An attractive start package can be negotiated.

You will report to the Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen.

Your competences as Professor / Associate Professor
You are ready to take co-responsibility for the development of the department's activites and for ensuring that we maintain a good work environment. You naturally involve yourself in interdisciplinary collaboration at departmental, faculty and university level as well as nationally and internationally. As a leader, you inspire others and build strong relationships with students, colleagues and partners.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish.

In the assessment of the candidates, consideration will be given to:

  • the ability to promote and utilize research results

  • experience with innovation activities

  • the ability to contribute to the development of internal and external cooperation

  • track record in attracting funding

  • visions within the research and innovation area

  • track record for commercialisation of research results, including protection of intellectual property

  • track record for fostering collaboration with industry

  • business development

  • experience and insight to the Danish life science industry

  • patenting, licensing and technology transfers

  • visions within the innovation area


In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

If you wish to apply for both positions, please submit two separate applications.

Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen tel.: (+45) 2778 2805.

Your place of work will be the Department of Biomedicine, Høegh-Guldbergs Gade 10, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

We expect to conduct interviews in the beginning of November 2026.

Terms of employment - professor

  • In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

  • Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime professor is DKK 866.461,38 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed professor supplement and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Professors have the authority to negotiate pay on their own behalf.



Terms of employment – associate professor

  • Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.

  • The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.



Other terms of employment

  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).

  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.

  • Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.

  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.



Application - professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



Application – associate professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - associate professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The five publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - associate professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - associate professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)


We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: Liikuntakoutsi
jobs.description:
Kuhmo on Suomen metsäkeskeisin kaupunki, joka on tunnettu korkeatasoisesta musiikki- ja kirjallisuuskulttuurista, erityisesti kamarimusiikista ja Kalevalasta sekä yhteisöllisestä elämäntavasta, jossa arvostetaan hyvän jakamista, osaamista ja laatua. Kuhmo - täyttä elämää metsän ja kulttuurin valtakunnassa!

Kuhmon kaupungin kasvun ja oppimisen palvelualueella on haettavana määräaikainen liikuntakoutsin työtehtävä Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulussa ajalla 10.8.2026 - 30.6.2027. Työ voi alkaa sopimuksen mukaan myös myöhemmin.

Haluatko olla mukana lisäämässä lasten ja nuorten liikettä, hyvinvointia ja osallisuutta? Etsimme innostavaa ja kehittämismyönteistä liikuntakoutsia vahvistamaan Kuhmon perusopetuksen liikunnallista toimintakulttuuria sekä tukemaan lasten ja nuorten aktiivista elämäntapaa. Tehtävässä pääset kehittämään uusia toimintamalleja ja rakentamaan pysyviä käytäntöjä lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi yhdessä koulun oppilaiden, aikuisten ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa.

Liikuntakoutsin työtehtävät pitävät sisällään esim.
liikunnallisen toimintakulttuurin kehittäminen yhdessä Liikkuva koulu -tiimin ja koulun henkilökunnan kanssa
välituntitoiminnan organisoimista, välkkäritoimintaa sekä muita oppilaiden osallisuutta vahvistavien toimintamallien kehittämistä
liikunnallisten tapahtumien ja kampanjoiden järjestäminen yhdessä muiden toimijoiden kanssa
liikuntatietoisiin opetus- ja toimintatapoihin ohjaamista ja kannustamista
oppituntien taukojumppaa
vähän liikkuville lapsille ja nuorille suunnattujen liikunta- ja hyvinvointitoimien suunnittelua ja toteuttamista
Move!-prosessin kehittämiseen osallistuminen
Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulun liikunnallisen vuosikellon ideointi yhdessä koulun oppilaiden, aikuisten ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa
osallistuminen hankkeen seurantaan, arviointiin ja raportointiin.

Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, kuten liikunta-, kasvatus-, terveys- tai hyvinvointialan ammatillinen tai korkeakoulututkinto tai muu soveltuva koulutus. Työaika on 38,25h/vko ja palkkaus on KVTES:n mukainen tasopalkka 2 612,32 € kuukaudessa. Työsuhteen koeaika on pituudeltaan puolet palvelussuhteen kestosta.

Tehtävään valitun on toimitettava nähtäväksi hyväksytty lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan sekä lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote 30 päivän kuluessa valintapäätöksen tiedoksisaannista.

Odotamme sinulta kokemusta lasten ja nuorten liikunnan, kasvatuksen tai ohjaustoiminnan parista. Arvostamme intoa ja halua kehittää uutta, oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä organisointitaitoja. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja kyky toimia yhteistyössä eri-ikäisten lasten, nuorten ja aikuisten kanssa on työssä onnistumisen kannalta tärkeää. Toivomme sinulta myös innostunutta ja kannustavaa asennetta liikunnallisen elämäntavan edistämiseen ja kykyä kohdata lempeästi ja kannustavasti erilaiset liikkujat. Perusosaaminen tietojärjestelmien (mm. MS Office, Teams, Wilma, Webropol) käytöstä auttaa tehtävän hoitamisessa.

Tuupalan yhtenäiskoulussa opiskelee lukuvuonna 2026-27 n. 450 oppilasta vuosiluokilla 1-9. Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn kuhmolaisten lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi. Saat mahdollisuuden kehittää uusia toimintamalleja ja vaikuttaa koko koulun liikunnalliseen toimintakulttuuriin. Saat työssäsi mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omaa asiantuntemustasi ja kehittää ammattitaitoasi. Työyhteisön tuki ja yhteistyöverkostot auttavat sinua tehtävän menestyksellisessä hoitamisessa.

Mielenkiintoisen työn lisäksi Kuhmo tarjoaa monipuoliset harrastusmahdollisuudet, upean luonnon ja rauhoittavan elämänrytmin. Kaikki palvelut ovat kävelymatkan päässä toisistaan. Henkilöstöetuna tarjoamme mm. E-passin.

Tervetuloa mukaan rakentamaan liikkuvampaa, aktiivisempaa, osallistavampaa ja yhdenvertaisempaa arkea kuhmolaisille lapsille ja nuorille!

Servisní mechanik manipulační techniky
Do našeho týmu hledáme šikovného kolegu (popř. mechanika), kterého baví technika, má šikovné ruce, umí si poradit a má chuť dělat práci, za kterou je vidět výsledek.

Nepožadujeme konkrétní vzděláním, důležitější jsou pro nás zkušenosti, zájem, spolehlivost a férovost. Pokud máte zkušenosti s opravami techniky, automobilů, strojů … a servis Vás baví, rádi s Vámi poznáme.
Náplň práce:
- servis a opravy vysokozdvižných vozíků a manipulační techniky
- servis u zákazníků i v zázemí našeho servisu
- různorodá práce
Co od Vás očekáváme:
- zkušenosti v našem nebo příbuzném oboru (auta, stroje apod.)
- technické myšlení
- schopnost samostatné práce
- zodpovědný přístup a slušné jednání
- řidičský průkaz skupiny B (skupina C výhodou)
- znalost práce s PC a diagnostickými nástroji
- zájem
Co nabízíme:
- stabilní práci
- férový přístup a přátelskou atmosférou
- jednosměnný provoz (Po-Pá 6:30-15:00)
- možnost hlavního pracovního poměru, zkráceného úvazku, spolupráce na ŽL nebo DPP
- služební telefon a notebook
- vlastní servisní vozidlo

- různorodou práci, kde člověk nesedí celý den na jednom místě

jobs.title: Ingénieur DevOps (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums.
L'entreprise CS GROUP recherche actuellement des profils :

Description de l'entreprise

CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l'intégration et l'exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l'énergie, l'industrie, le transport, l'aéronautique et la cybersécurité.

Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d'innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d'affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites.

En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante.***Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance.
* Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain.
* Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l'innovation.

Explorer, observer, sécuriser l'espace de demain.

Avec 50 ans d'expertise, notre Business Unit Espace est un partenaire de confiance des agences spatiales, maîtres d'œuvre et opérateurs de satellites à travers l'Europe.

Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l'innovation de l'écosystème spatial.

Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l'Espace. Portées par l'IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens.

Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c'est façonner le futur de l'espace aux côtés d'experts passionnés.

Description du poste

Nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur(e) DevOps pour rejoindre notre Business unit Espace au sein de notre agence Space Processing & Intelligence spécialisée dans le traitement et l'hybridation des données spatiales .

Vos missions

Vous rejoignez l'équipe DEVOPS, en charge de l'administration des environnements de développement et la mise en place des plateformes d'intégration continue pour les différents projets de la BU Espace.***Auditer des besoins projet, définir la stratégie
* Mettre en place des outils
* Réaliser des pipelines CI/CD
* Assister et expertiser pour les évolutions des besoins

L'environnement technique***GitLab, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Helm, ArgoCD, Ansible, Terraform
* Cloud (providers européens essentiellement) / Openstack
* OpenSource
* Langages variés (Python, Node, Java, C/C++, Golang, Rust)
Qualifications

KPMG is where you will find the right opportunities to advance your career. Take advantage of the widest available range of possibilities so you can grow professionally. If you are passionate about working on what really matters – and want to have fun along the way – we would love to meet you.

jobs.title: Vice President - Tax Compliance (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Vice President - Tax Compliance (f/m/d)

Part-time | unlimited

Ready to make a real impact in the financial industry? At Deutsche Börse Group, we'll empower you to grow your career in a supportive and inclusive environment. With our unique business model, driven by 15,000 colleagues around the globe, we actively shape the future of financial markets. Join our One Global Team!

Your area of work:

As an International Tax Expert, you will be part of our global tax team based in Eschborn, focusing primarily on indirect tax matters across multiple jurisdictions. A general understanding of corporate income tax will complement your role. You will play a key role in ensuring compliance with international regulations, supporting cross-border business operations, and contributing to strategic initiatives. This role offers exposure to a wide range of international tax topics and collaboration with stakeholders across Europe and beyond.

Your responsibilities:

• International VAT/GST Compliance: Ensure timely and accurate filing of indirect tax returns across multiple jurisdictions, including coordination with local advisors and authorities.
• Cross-border Advisory: Provide guidance on indirect tax implications of international transactions, supply chains, and service models, assist in decision-making processes.
• ERP Integration & Process Design: Lead VAT-relevant process design and classification in SAP S/4HANA(Sales & Distribution, Material Management), including tax determination implementation and testing.
• Tax Risk Management: Identify and mitigate indirect tax risks in international operations; support internal audits and control reviews.
• Tax Strategy & Optimization: Contribute to global tax planning initiatives, including VAT efficiency and recovery strategies.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a key contact for internal departments (e.g., Finance, Legal, Procurement)and external advisors on indirect tax matters.
• Regulatory Monitoring: Stay abreast of international VAT/GST developments and assess their impact on the Group's operations.

Your profile:

• University degree in economics, law, or a related field; advanced tax qualifications (e.g., Steuerberater, CTA,ADIT) are a plus.
• Several years of experience in indirect and corporate income tax, ideally in a multinational corporation or international advisory firm.
• Strong expertise in international VAT/GST regulations, especially in European jurisdictions but also beyond.
• Experience in corporate income taxes and other relevant reporting obligations is an asset
• Experience with ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA preferred), including tax-relevant process design and implementation.
• Business fluent in English and German; other languages are an asset.
• Excellent analytical and communication skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
• Ability to work independently in a global organization and manage multiple international stakeholders andpriorities.

Deutsche Börse Group embraces an international climate, whereby diversity is universal. This is evident across the board, be it through our diverse workforce, routine responsibilities or other areas of activities and scope of application. We are looking for employees who enjoy working in a dynamic and flexible environment and are willing to put forward innovative ideas for the company. An open mindset, a proactive approach and self-motivationare prerequisites. We offer our employees an attractive remuneration package. Benefits include a high level of trust and autonomy in modern, centrally located workplaces where corporate culture and values are exercised regularly.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity.

Have we piqued your interest? Then we encourage you to apply now!

jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The AI Readiness and Assessment (AIRA) research group at LIST is seeking a highly motivated professional to lead the development of Luxembourg AI Factory services into mature offerings meeting market needs. Operating at the intersection of applied AI, service/product design, and go-to-market strategy, this position focuses on taking services in the Luxembourg AI Factory and turning them into coherent, valuable assets for the ecosystem's target users: startups, SMEs and large corporations. The ideal candidate is a practical strategist, comfortable moving between technical product content, human-centered design, and communication.
• Service Design and Management: You will manage Luxembourg AI Factory's services and take them to the next level of maturity and market readiness.  
• User Feedback: You will conduct user studies, gather input from service users, and continuously refine the product design, product backlogs, and implementation roadmaps, with a particular focus on AI Assessment and Sandboxing Services.
• Communication and Marketing Strategy: You will define the positioning, messaging and channel strategy for each productized asset, ensuring consistent branding and tone across the AI Factory's public-facing outputs and stakeholder communications.
• Build Go-to-Market Assets: You will create the supporting materials that make each service easy to understand, adopt and promote across the ecosystem.
• Support Ecosystem Engagement: You will engage with project partners and the wider ecosystem — including the open-source community, contributors and community governance — to formulate recommendations that guide them through a coherent journey across services.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• Master's degree in Service Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, Innovation Management, or a closely related discipline
• Ph.D. in those disciplines is considered an asset

Experience
• Experience in service design and/or service management
• Experience with digital product design and communication
• Experience conducting user research or user studies (interviews, surveys, focus groups, usability testing, etc.) is an asset
• Any hands-on experience with AI-related projects or tools is a plus
Hard skills
• Advanced expertise in Digital Product and Service Design: Service design methods (service blueprint, journey mapping), UX/UI design tools (Figma or equivalent), experience in conducting user research (interviews, usability testing)
• Value proposition & Business design: positioning of services, value proposition frameworks, experience translating technical capabilities into user benefits
• Communication & Marketing: familiarity with marketing and communication strategies and product branding
• AI literacy: familiarity with AI concepts and the AI policy landscape
Soft skills
• Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to scientific rigor and interpretability
• Notions of explainability and trustworthiness in AI
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts to non-specialists
• Intellectual curiosity and motivation to work on applied, impact-driven research
• Ability to work independently while contributing constructively to a collaborative project environment

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits
• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
jobs.description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: 0.5 - 1.0

jobs.description:

Jobbeskrivelse:
Arbejdet består i at modtage stykgods (fersk og frossen fisk). På lageret sorteres/ompakkes godset før det læsses på bilerne til videre distribution ud i vores rutenet.  

Du vil indgå i et team på 2 øvrige medarbejdere – som arbejder i en turnus om at dække vagterne. Den daglige arbejdstid i turnussen er fra kl. cirka 17.00 – til cirka 00.00. Herudover vagt hver anden søndag af cirka 8 timers varighed.

Den ideelle kandidat:

- Besidder relevant brancheerfaring

- Har praktisk erfaring med lastning og losning af pallegods

- Er fleksibel og møder til tiden

- Er engageret og villig til at yde en ekstra indsats

- Arbejder selvstændigt og med høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen

- Kan fremvise en straffeattest ved ansættelse

Vi vil gerne have stabile og langvarige ansættelsesforhold.

Vi tilbyder

- Ordnede arbejdsforhold med fokus på sikkerhed og kvalitet

- Et positivt og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger

- Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst

- Fleksible arbejdsforhold med ansvar og struktur

- Turnusordning

Fiskelogistik Gruppen A/S (FLG) er en af Danmarks førende transportvirksomheder indenfor fiskerierhvervet med fokus på indenrigsmarkedet dk-dk

Vi er en familiejet virksomhed med en stærk holdånd, et tæt fællesskab og vi sætter altid mennesket i centrum.

Fiskelogistik Gruppen er en niche virksomhed. Som national transportør er vi bevidst om vores ansvar over for vores kunder, der er afhængige af vores ydelser. Det handler om levering til tiden i den rette temperatur og fra dag til dag.

Vi har en resultatorienteret og handlingsorienteret kultur med fokus på nytænkning. Vi forventer, at alle bidrager til kulturen uafhængigt af stilling i virksomheden. Kundens rolle er central i Fiskelogistik Gruppen med fokus på kvalitet, service og fleksibilitet. Medarbejderne er den vigtigste ressource, hvilket stiller krav til medarbejderne, men giver også muligheder for udvikling og ansvar i jobbet.

Generelt hos os:

  • Frihed under ansvar i et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med meget brede rammer til at udvikle forretningen og med en kort beslutningsproces

  • Engagerede og kompetente kolleger der brænder for at gøre en forskel

  • Gode ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst, herunder pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring og personaleforening, m.m.

Generelt får du en stilling i en dynamisk virksomhed med gode kolleger og med en uformel omgangstone samt humor.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Researcher in the field of materials for Li-ion Batteries
jobs.description:
About the position

Position as Researcher available at the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN), University of Oslo.

The position is for a period of 15,7 months.

Preferred starting date 01.01.2026.

Place of work is Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology at Gaustad, Oslo. 


Project description

We are searching for a skilled, creative and ambitious researcher to join our scientific activities within the field of battery materials. The candidate will work in a dynamic team of approximately 10 PhD/MS students and researchers and, therefore, should be skilled to work in team as well as independently.

The successful candidate will be involved in two activities involving synthesis, electrode design and advanced characterization of the materials for Li-ion and Na-ion bat-teries under two projects funded by the Norwegian Research Council.

The candidate will focus on:

  • Synthesis of materials
  • Electrode development
  • Optimization of materials, electrochemical evaluation and operando characterization, including 
    • data acquisition
    • development of electrochemical cells for X-ray based operando tech-niques
    • data treatment   
  •  Experiments using synchrotron facilities are foreseen, depending on access and travel regulations.

The candidate will work closely with all group members, who are involved in similar research activities and should have knowledge and understanding of the electrochemical characterization of battery materials in addition to the advanced knowledge in X-ray based characterization techniques.

The position will be part of the Battery research group within the Nanostructures and Functional Materials (NAFUMA) section. The Battery research group consists of approximately 20 members focused on multiple battery chemistries. The group also performs research on understanding of reaction mechanisms in batteries using operando characterisation.

The NAFUMA section is part of Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN). Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology is an interdisciplinary centre, a collaboration between four research groups in physics and chemistry, and it spearheads the MN Faculty's efforts for sustainable energy solutions. The Centre embodies UiO’s focus on renewable energy, materials science, and nanotechnology.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Chemistry, Materials Science or a closely related field. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense will be eligible for the final appointment
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Documented experience within the field of battery materials (Na-ion and Li-ion) – from synthesis of materials to fabrication of batteries
  • Documented experience with X-ray-based characterization (XRD, PDF and X-ray spectroscopy)
  • Knowledge of electrochemical characterization of battery materials
  • Demonstrated experience with using large scale facilities (ESRF, Diamond, etc) for operando characterization

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience in handling large data sets
  • Experience in synchrotron-based measurements in multimodality mode
  • Experience with solid-state NMR for characterization of battery materials

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to conduct high-quality independent research within a broad collaboration
  • Self-motivation, creativity, genuine curiosity about the subject, work discipline, professional ethics, and ambition
  • Good social, communication and collaboration skills and ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary scientific environment
  • Interpersonal communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team
  • We are looking for a candidate who is willing and able to quickly learn and apply new methods and teach the other members of the group

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 600 000 - to 730 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Separate letter of motivation
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN) is an interdisciplinary focus field for material and energy research at the University of Oslo. SMN has focused on basic research in renewable energy and environmentally friendly use of fossil energy sources. The center consists of research groups from the Department of Physics and the Department of Chemistry, has about 100 employees from around the world and manages more than 80 projects funded by EU, RCN and others.

jobs.title: Raskaan kaluston maalari
jobs.description:
Etsimme raskaan kaluston maalaria Turkuun! Työsuhteen arvioitu keston on alkuun 1-3kk, mutta viihtymällä ja menestymällä tehtävässä sinulla on mahdollisuus työllistyä pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Asiakasyrityksemme on ollut toiminnassa jo yli 30-vuotta ja heidät tunnetaankin laadusta, asiakaslähtöisyydestä sekä luotettavuudesta.

Pääasiallisena tehtävänäsi on toimia raskaan kaluston maalaustehtävissä, mutta toivomme sinulta halukkuutta osallistua monipuolisesti muihinkin tehtäviin kuten asennustehtäviin. Päivittäisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu mm. pohjustustyöt, suojaustyöt, pohjamaalaus, pintamaalaus esim. ruiskuttamalla ja muut mahdolliset viimeistelytehtävät kuten teippaukset. Töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimitiloissa halliolosuhteissa ma-pe ja 37,5h/viikko. Kuuntelemme palkkatoiveita, mutta viime kädessä työehtosopimus määrittää tehtävän palkkauksen.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- C-ajoluokan ajokorttia.

\- Aikaisempaa työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä. Asiakasyrityksemme perehdyttää sinut tehtävään, mutta toivomme sinulta kyvykkyyttä oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita nopeasti sekä omatoimisuutta.

\- Arvostamme myös kädentaitoja, tarkkuutta, kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti, joustavuutta, luotettavuutta ja reipasta työskentelyotetta.

\- Oman ajoneuvon käyttömahdollisuus helpottaa huomattavasti kulkemista oman kodin ja työpaikan välillä.

Työt on mahdollista aloittaa heti ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Täytä hakemuksesi ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi.
