jobs.title: Outdoor Activity Guide, Pyhätunturi, Lapland, Finland
jobs.description:
**Join our Activities Team in Finnish Lapland!**

We're looking for **Outdoor Activity Guides** to join our team for the upcoming winter season in **Pyhä-Luosto National Park**, Finnish Lapland.

At **Sunday Morning Collection**, we create unforgettable outdoor experiences in one of Finland's most beautiful national parks. Operating according to the principles of sustainable tourism, our activities combine Arctic nature, safety and authentic Lapland experiences.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys spending time outdoors, meeting people from around the world and sharing the stories, nature and traditions of Lapland. If you thrive in the snow and want to help create lifelong memories for our guests, we'd love to hear from you.

**Depending on your experience and skills, your role may include:**

- Guiding nature-based experiences and outdoor activities, primarily in English

- Leading electric snowmobile tours, Northern Lights excursions, ice fishing trips, snowshoe adventures, farm visits and other outdoor experiences

- Ensuring guest safety while delivering exceptional customer experiences

- Airport transfers, activity transportation and other private transfers

- Preparing, maintaining and servicing activity equipment, including electric snowmobiles, skis, snowshoes and other outdoor gear

- Heating and maintaining our lakeside saunas

- General maintenance and support duties around the resort area

- Assisting guests and coordinating practical arrangements before and during activities


**We're looking for someone who has**

- A genuine interest in nature, outdoor activities and adventure tourism

- Previous experience in activity guiding, tourism, outdoor recreation or wilderness guiding (enthusiastic applicants at the beginning of their careers are also encouraged to apply)

- An excellent customer service attitude and strong communication skills

- Good physical fitness and the ability to work comfortably in changing winter conditions

- A responsible, proactive and positive approach to work

- **Fluent English**, as all guiding is conducted primarily in English. **Finnish is a significant advantage**, as we also welcome many domestic guests. Additional languages are highly appreciated.

- A valid Category B driving licence (Category D1 or D licence is considered an advantage)

- A valid First Aid (EA1) certificate is an advantage, although training can be provided if needed

- A willingness to learn, develop and grow within the activity and adventure tourism industry


**What we offer**

- A varied role where no two days are ever the same

- The opportunity to work in the spectacular surroundings of **Pyhä-Luosto National Park**

- A rewarding position where you'll develop your skills in activity guiding, outdoor tourism and customer service

- A friendly, professional and supportive team

- Comprehensive onboarding and training before the winter season begins

- Affordable staff accommodation, if required

- Comprehensive occupational healthcare and employee benefits

- 2 shared company ski passes for Pyhä Ski Resort, available for employees who enjoy skiing.

- The opportunity to work for a company certified with the **Sustainable Travel Finland** label

- An excellent workplace location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services

- Salary according to the Finnish **Activity Services Collective Agreement** (Programme Services sector), **Job Requirement Groups A-B**, with the final salary determined by your experience and qualifications


**Employment details**

- **Employment starts:** Late November / early December 2026

- **Duration:** Until the end of the 2027 winter season (late March / early April)

- **Position:** Full-time seasonal employment


**About us**

Sunday Morning Collection offers premium outdoor activities and authentic Arctic experiences in **Pyhä-Luosto National Park**, Finnish Lapland.

During the winter season we organise electric snowmobile safaris, Northern Lights experiences, snowshoe adventures, ice fishing excursions, farm visits and a variety of other guided outdoor activities.

Sunday Morning Collection also includes **Sunday Morning Resort**, **Parkside Pyhä Apartments** and **Restaurant Aihki**. Together, we create authentic, sustainable and high-quality Lapland experiences for guests from around the world.

**Interested?**

Send your application with the subject: "**Outdoor Activity Guide / Your Name"**

**Please include:**

- Your CV

- Your salary expectation


Feel free to tell us about your previous experience, what inspires you about working in outdoor tourism and what you hope to achieve during the upcoming winter season.

We review applications as they arrive, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

**Applications & enquiries**

- rekry@sundaymorning.fi

- www.sundaymorning.fi

Join one of Denmark’s leading private fertility clinics

Sellmer Fertility Clinic is an established and highly specialised private fertility clinic located in the heart of Aarhus, Denmark. They provide evidence-based fertility treatment in a modern, patient-centred environment, helping individuals and couples realise their dream of becoming parents.

Due to continued growth and an increasing patient demand, they are looking for an experienced Fertility Specialist to join our clinical team.

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary team where quality of care, collaboration and professional development are central to everything we do.

jobs.description:
Vi tilbyder længere vikariater i en velrenommeret virksomhed, hvor der er fokus på din trivsel!

Kan du sige ja til at du er mødestabil og klar på nye udfordringer? Så læs mere her!

Om jobbet:

VKAREN.DK søger altid nye engagerede produktionsmedarbejdere til Dan-Foam i Aarup. Der er tale om længerevarende vikariater med opstart løbende og med gode muligheder for forlængelse og fastansættelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært foregå i madrasafdelingen, hvor du skal montere betræk på madrasserne. Her står du sammen med en kollega, hvor I sammen monterer betrækket ved hjælp af en maskine. Arbejdet kræver, at du er i fysisk god form, da det kan være tungt og med gentagende bevægelser, og størstedelen af arbejdet foregår stående.

Du er i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger hele tiden, og det gode samarbejde er altafgørende for, at I lykkes. Du får en høj grad af frihed under ansvar, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger i teamet skal sikre, at alle opgaver løses på bedste vis.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har truckcertifikat, så du kan hjælpe med at flytte paller, hente materialer eller løse andre forefaldende opgaver – det er dog ikke et krav til stillingerne.

Vi søger løbende medarbejdere til både dag- og nathold.

Arbejdstider dag:

·         1. uge: onsdag-torsdag 07-19.

·         2. uge: mandag-tirsdag og fredag-lørdag 07-19.

Arbejdstider nat:

·         Søndag-tirsdag 19-07.

·         Onsdag-fredag 19-07.

Vi forventer:

Det er ikke afgørende, at du har relevant erhvervserfaring, da der er en grundig oplæring. Vi forventer dog, at:

·         Du trives med fysisk arbejde i højt tempo.

·         Du har en høj arbejdsmoral og går til opgaverne med engagement.

·         Du er fortrolig med IT og er ikke bange for at benytte det i din hverdag.

·         Du taler, læser og skriver dansk.

·         Det er en fordel med truckcertifikat, men det er ikke et krav.

Din profil:

Som kollega møder du ind med en positiv indstilling og en arbejdsgejst, der smitter af på dine kollegaer. Du er god til at holde hovedet koldt, selv når det går stærkt, og dine kolleger kan altid regne med dig. Du er mødestabil, kvalitetsbevidst og pligtopfyldende samt en holdspiller, der gerne strækker sig lidt ekstra for at hjælpe en kollega. Den samme indstilling vil du opleve fra dine kolleger, og det er dét, der gør jer til et godt team.

Vi tilbyder:

Vi tilbyder en spændende mulighed i en velrenommeret virksomhed, hvor der er en sund kultur, og hvor godt kollegaskab vægtes højt. Du bliver en del af en global, succesfuld virksomhed med en førende position og stærke kvalitetsbrands. Koncernen er ambitiøs og kontinuerligt i udvikling, og du bliver en del af en veletableret og professionel kvalitet set up med engagerede og fagligt kompetente kolleger.

Når du starter, vil der være et nøje planlagt oplæringsforløb, og du vil blive taget imod med åbne arme på din første dag. Der er mulighed for køb af mad i kantinen, og du har desuden muligheden for at benytte dig af virksomhedens motionsrum.

Din løn og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår er efter gældende overenskomst.

Om virksomheden:

Dan-Foam er Tempur Sealys centrale produktionsenhed til det internationale marked. Virksomheden udvikler, producerer og håndterer et enestående, men også komplekst produktprogram bestående af puder, madrasser, sengesystemer og accessoires, som sælges i mere end 90 lande.

Ansøgning:

Er du interesseret i stillingen, så tøv ikke med at sende dit cv og en ansøgning til jobfyn@vkaren.dk, mrk. ”Produktionsmedarbejder – Dan-Foam”.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte os på tlf. 70152010 alle hverdage mellem kl. 09.00 og 16.00.

jobs.title: Senior FP&A & Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Your Mission 

As a Senior FP&A & Data Analyst, you will join Mercell's Group FP&A team and report to the Director of FP&A. You will play a central role in shaping how Finance supports decision-making across a leading European SaaS business.

This is a hybrid role that combines commercial FP&A, business partnering and modern data analytics. You will help drive forecasting, budgeting and strategic planning while leveraging data, automation and AI to improve how Finance operates and delivers insight to the business.

Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Operations and Finance, you will translate operational drivers into financial outcomes, build scalable reporting and planning solutions, and help transform data into actionable commercial insights.

Beyond supporting the business, you will challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement, and contribute to building a modern, data-driven Finance function equipped for the future.

We see the following qualities as important to thrive and evolve in this role:

To thrive in this role, you combine strong commercial acumen with analytical accuracy and exceptional execution capabilities. You are naturally curious about how businesses create value and enjoy translating complex data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making.

You can balance strategic thinking with attention to detail, maintaining a holistic perspective while ensuring accuracy and quality in your work. You take ownership of outcomes, hold yourself to high professional standards, and are motivated by delivering meaningful impact rather than simply completing tasks.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys operating in a dynamic, fast-moving environment where priorities can shift quickly and where collaboration with senior stakeholders is a natural part of everyday work. You are comfortable working with ambitious goals, challenging deadlines and a high level of accountability, recognising that these are characteristics of a performance-driven, private equity-backed technology company.

Success in this role requires resilience, adaptability and a proactive mindset. You build strong relationships across the organisation, communicate with clarity and confidence, and are equally comfortable leading discussions with senior management as working independently to solve complex problems.


Core Responsibilities  

  • Own and continuously develop forecasting, budgeting and long-range planning models across ARR, revenue, billing, cash flow and operating expenses, ensuring robust decision support for executive management.

  • Design and develop scalable reporting solutions, dashboards and data models using BI and other analytical tools to improve transparency, support decision-making and reduce manual work.

  • Drive automation and digitalisation of Finance processes by leveraging modern analytics, AI-powered tools and workflow automation to improve efficiency, forecast accuracy and data quality.

  • Act as a bridge between Finance, Operations and Data teams, helping to improve data governance, process alignment and the quality of business-critical information.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and modernise planning and reporting processes through technologies such as Power Automate, AI agents and other emerging tools.

  • Prepare insightful materials for Executive Leadership Team, Board and investor reporting, transforming complex financial and operational data into clear recommendations.

  • Continuously challenge existing processes, tools and ways of working, driving a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement across the Finance function.

Required Qualifications  

  • Strong hands-on experience (ideally 3+ years) in FP&A, business controlling or commercial finance within a SaaS or subscription-based business

  • Master's degree (or equivalent) in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics or another quantitative discipline.

  • Proven experience building financial models and translating business drivers into forecasting and planning models.

  • Experience working with modern analytics and reporting platforms to deliver scalable business insight.

  • Comfortable working with large and complex datasets and partnering with data or engineering teams.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex analyses to non-finance stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Curious and technology-oriented with a passion for automation, AI and continuous improvement.

  • Experience with one or more modern analytics and automation technologies such as Tableau Power BI, SQL, Python, Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric or similar platforms is an advantage.

  • Structured, proactive and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working in a PE-backed or high-growth technology company is an advantage.

 

Start date: As soon as possible
Duration: Full time, Permanent

jobs.title: Vil du bygge karriere innen økonomi i en bransje som aldri står stille? Autosalg søker ny regnskapsfører!
jobs.description:
Har du noen års erfaring fra økonomi og regnskap, og ønsker du en bredere rolle i bilbransjen?

Vi søker en erfaren økonomimedarbeider som vil bli en del av vårt team og ta neste steg i karrieren hos Autosalg.

Hos Autosalg får du en unik mulighet til å jobbe tett på både økonomi, drift og forretningsutvikling i et selskap i vekst. Du blir en del av et engasjert team der du får ta ansvar for økonomisk kontroll og effektive rutiner i en dynamisk og variert hverdag.

Vi ser etter en strukturert og selvstendig økonomiprofil med solid erfaring fra regnskap og/eller revisjon, som trives med ansvar og ønsker å videreutvikle sin faglige kompetanse i et selskap som satser videre. Hos oss får du jobbe tett med dyktige kolleger på tvers av salg, verksted og ettermarked, og du vil raskt få en sentral rolle i den daglige driften.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi at du vil lese videre!

Dine arbeidsoppgaver

Som økonomimedarbeider hos oss vil du jobbe tett med daglig leder, salgsteam og ettermarkedsleder. Du får selvstendig ansvar for varierte og viktige oppgaver innen daglig regnskapsdrift, og bidrar til at både kunder og leverandører følger gjeldende regelverk og beste praksis innen økonomi og regnskap. Dette er en fin mulighet til å bygge videre på din erfaring, i et selskap med stor variasjon i arbeidsoppgaver som:

  • Regnskap fra A–Å
  • Lønn fra A–Å, inkludert kjøring og avstemming i Altinn
  • MVA-oppgaver, avstemming og innlevering
  • Avstemming av bank, kunde- og leverandørreskontro
  • Behandling av inngående faktura i dokumentsenter
  • Lageravstemming
  • Budsjettering og økonomisk rapportering
  • Løpende kundeoppfølging og rådgivning
  • Daglige administrative oppgaver
  • Bidra i økonomisk oppfølging og kontroll sammen med ledelse og avdelinger
  • Ønskelig: Utarbeidelse av årsregnskap og skattemelding
Hva kan vi tilby deg?

Hos Autosalg blir du del av et team som verdsetter faglig utvikling og gir deg reelt ansvar. Vi tror på å gi erfarne medarbeidere mulighet til å påvirke og forme rutiner og prosesser videre.

Hos oss vil du blant annet få:

  • Faglig utvikling i en spennende og voksende bilbransje
  • Et sosialt og uformelt arbeidsmiljø
  • Gode kollegaer med bred erfaring fra salg, verksted, delelager, karosseri og lakk
  • Varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • En rolle med reell påvirkning og ansvar
Hvem ser vi etter?

For å lykkes i denne rollen tror vi du har solid faglig grunnlag og praktisk erfaring fra økonomi og regnskap, en god porsjon nysgjerrighet og evnen til å ta eierskap til egne arbeidsoppgaver. Du trives i en hverdag med variasjon, og du liker å samarbeide tett med andre. Andre egenskaper og kvalifikasjoner vi ser etter er:

  • Bachelor- eller mastergrad innen økonomi og administrasjon, eller økonomi og regnskap
  • Noen års relevant erfaring fra regnskap, revisjon eller lignende
  • Interesse for revisjon og rådgivning
  • Gode analytiske og kommunikative evner, både på norsk og engelsk
  • Selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst arbeidsstil
  • Evne til å samarbeide godt i team
Om Autosalg

Autosalg er en familiebedrift med røtter helt tilbake til 1947, og i over 75 år har vi behandlet både kunder og medarbeidere som en del av Autosalg-familien. Vi holder til sentralt i Storetveitveien i Bergen, og her finner du alt under ett tak: nybilavdeling, bruktbilbutikk og eget autorisert MECA-verksted.

Vi er autorisert forhandler av Honda og BYD, og tilbyr service og reparasjoner på alle personbilmerker gjennom vårt MECA-verksted. Til daglig er vi 23 engasjerte medarbeidere med bred kompetanse innen salg, verksted, delelager, karosseri og lakk.

Hos oss får du bli del av et selskap med lang historie, sterk fagkultur og en varm, uformell arbeidsplass, der du merker ganske raskt at her er folk glad i det de driver med.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're redefining how software is built and who gets to build it. Our mission is to achieve Autonomy for All: making programming accessible, collaborative, and powered by AI. Realizing that vision requires a platform that legitimate users can trust and adversarial actors cannot exploit.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to help build Replit's Trust & Safety and Anti-Abuse program from the ground up. You'll turn noisy behavioral, identity, payment, infrastructure, and content signals into the measurement systems, detections, and decisions that protect Replit's users, platform, and economics. You'll work closely with Engineering, Support, Legal, Security, Infrastructure, Money, and Growth to make abuse economically unviable while keeping friction low for legitimate users.



Replit sits at the frontier of AI-native abuse. Our platform is a target for phishing and scam hosting, cryptomining, LLM token farming, card and coupon fraud, referral abuse, and increasingly, abuse driven by AI agents themselves. You'll help define how we identify, measure, and respond to these threats without compromising the experience of good users.



WHO YOU ARE

You're a data scientist who moves fast, goes deep, and thinks adversarially. You can spin up an analysis in hours that would take others days, not by cutting corners, but because you've built the intuition and technical toolkit to get to the right answer quickly. You dig past the top-line abuse rate to understand selection effects, missing labels, policy changes, attacker adaptation, and the false positives hidden inside an aggregate metric.

You understand that Trust & Safety data is imperfect and outcomes are high stakes. Ground truth is delayed, biased, and often incomplete; attackers react to defenses; and an apparently effective rule can quietly harm legitimate users. You pressure-test your own work, quantify uncertainty, and distinguish correlation from evidence strong enough to justify enforcement.

You use AI agents and tools aggressively to multiply your output: writing code, exploring data, generating hypotheses, and prototyping investigations. But you treat every AI-assisted output as a draft, not a deliverable. You know what good analysis looks like and won't ship anything that doesn't meet that bar.



YOU WILL

 - Own the analytical foundation for Trust & Safety, including abuse prevalence, fraud loss, false-positive and false-negative rates, time to detect, time to mitigate, appeal and reversal rates, and verification step-up conversion.

 - Build reliable datasets and dbt models that connect product events, account and identity signals, payment activity, infrastructure usage, content classifications, enforcement actions, appeals, and support outcomes.

 - Develop and evaluate risk models, rules, and anomaly-detection systems for threats such as phishing, scam hosting, cryptomining, token farming, payment fraud, promotional abuse, and AI-agent exploitation.

 - Design rigorous offline evaluations, shadow-mode tests, holdouts, and controlled experiments to measure detection quality and the user impact of new policies, enforcement actions, and progressive verification.

 - Define thresholds and decision frameworks that balance abuse reduction, economic loss, customer friction, and false positives across free, paid, and enterprise users.

 - Investigate emerging abuse patterns, quantify their impact, identify coordinated behavior, and turn ambiguous signals into clear recommendations for product and engineering teams.

 - Develop predictive models that estimate account, device, transaction, workspace, or deployment risk and embed those signals into detection, review, and escalation workflows.

 - Partner with Support and Legal to improve case review, appeals, reason-code quality, and feedback loops so human decisions become useful model and policy signals.

 - Build monitoring that detects model drift, attacker adaptation, data-quality failures, and unexpected harm to legitimate users.

 - Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical partners, including the tradeoffs, uncertainty, and evidence behind high-impact decisions.



EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU COULD DO

 - Build a measurement framework for Replit's abuse surface, reconcile incomplete labels across automated detections, human review, appeals, chargebacks, and support cases, and establish a trustworthy baseline for the first time.

 - Design and evaluate a risk-scoring model for suspicious account clusters using identity, device, payment, graph, and product-behavior signals, then define thresholds that materially reduce fraud while protecting legitimate users.

 - Analyze a phishing detection rule that appears highly precise, uncover that it disproportionately bans paying users with legitimate brand references, and redesign its evaluation and review path to reduce false positives.

 - Measure a progressive verification "ladder of trust," determining when to step users up to additional verification and quantifying the tradeoff between abuse prevented and legitimate-user conversion lost.

 - Detect coordinated token-farming or promotional-abuse networks by combining account-linkage graphs, referral behavior, payment patterns, and infrastructure usage, then partner with Engineering to operationalize the findings.

 - Evaluate a new enforcement policy in shadow mode, estimate its counterfactual impact, and recommend whether to launch, revise, or reject it before any users are affected.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, fraud, risk, trust and safety, or a related field.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience working with large behavioral datasets and building reliable data models or pipelines.

 - Experience developing and evaluating predictive models, experiments, or decision systems, with sound judgment around uncertainty and tradeoffs.

 - Ability to turn ambiguous data into clear recommendations and communicate them effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

 - Comfort working with imperfect labels, biased samples, and high-impact decisions where false positives matter.

 - You use AI tools extensively to increase your effectiveness while maintaining a high bar for analytical quality.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or evaluating anti-abuse, fraud, identity, security, spam, integrity, or content-safety systems at scale.

 - Built, shipped, and maintained ML models in production (classification, anomaly detection, or risk scoring), including feature engineering on behavioral and transaction data, threshold selection against precision/recall economics, and post-launch monitoring

 - Experience with graph analysis, entity resolution, coordinated-behavior detection, reputation systems, anomaly detection, or risk scoring.

 - Experience measuring false positives and enforcement harm, designing human-review workflows, or using appeals and case outcomes as model feedback.

 - Familiarity with progressive verification, KYC, account trust, or identity providers such as Prove, Persona, Socure, or Stripe Identity.

 - Experience with causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score methods, synthetic control, or uplift modeling.

 - Experience with a modern data stack such as dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Fivetran, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Segment.

 - Experience at a consumer platform, developer tool, cloud provider, marketplace, fintech company, or other product with a meaningful adversarial surface.



BONUS POINTS

 - You've built AI-powered analytical tools, investigation systems, automated detections, or novel measurement approaches.

 - You have experience with AI-native abuse such as prompt injection, LLM token farming, model extraction, or agent-driven abuse.

 - You understand freemium, usage-based, or promotional pricing models and the abuse incentives they create.

 - You've worked directly with operational review teams and can translate analytical signals into practical playbooks, queues, and escalation paths.

jobs.title: Drive Naval growth as Director Strategic Accounts – Norwegian Navy
jobs.description:
Kongsberg Maritime is experiencing significant growth within the maritime defence segment. To strengthen our position as a strategic partner and provider of integrated maritime solutions to the Royal Norwegian Navy, we are now establishing a clearer and more holistic approach to customer engagement within Naval Systems.

We are looking for a Director Strategic Accounts, Norwegian Navy, who will hold overall commercial and strategic responsibility for the relationship between Kongsberg Maritime and the Royal Norwegian Navy and Coast Guard, ensuring a coordinated, long-term and customer-oriented approach across the organisation.

For many years, Kongsberg Maritime has delivered advanced products, systems and services to navies and coastguards worldwide. In Norway, we play a particularly important role in supporting the Royal Norwegian Navy’s operational capability through technology, deliveries and long-term collaboration.

Looking ahead, increased activity is expected within new vessel programmes, modernisation of existing capabilities, digital solutions, unmanned and autonomous systems, as well as integrated bridge, automation, energy and control systems. This places high demands on strategic customer understanding, clear prioritisation and coordinated follow-up across sales, technology, projects and aftermarket services.

In this role, you will be Kongsberg Maritime’s key point of contact towards the Royal Norwegian Navy, responsible for developing the relationship, identifying new opportunities and ensuring that KM acts in a unified, relevant and proactive manner in its engagement with one of our most important defence customers.

Periods of extensive travel must be expected

Responsibilities:

  • Hold overall commercial and strategic responsibility for the relationship between Kongsberg Maritime and the Royal Norwegian Navy, including the Navy and Coast Guard, acting as KM’s single point of contact towards the Royal Norwegian Navy
  • Lead and coordinate activities across sales, projects, technology and aftermarket services to ensure holistic and consistent customer engagement
  • Develop and execute long-term customer strategies in line with KM’s growth ambitions within Naval Systems
  • Drive active business development, including identifying new opportunities, positioning offers and securing order intake
  • Establish and further develop strong relationships with key decision-makers at both strategic and operational levels within the Royal Norwegian Navy
  • Ensure high customer satisfaction through proactive follow-up, effective case handling and continuous improvement of customer satisfaction

Desired qualifications:

  • Technical or commercial education at master’s level and/or military officer education
  • Extensive relevant experience from the Royal Norwegian Navy, preferably from senior positions on board vessels or in operational staffs, the maritime sector or the defence industry, with a strong understanding of operational needs and/or delivery of advanced maritime systems is an advantage
  • Experience from operational positions, programme/project work or customer-facing roles, preferably at the intersection of technology, operations and commercial deliveries
  • Good insight into the operation of naval vessels and maritime systems, as well as an understanding of how technology supports operational capability
  • Good understanding of military operations and frameworks, nationally and in a NATO/allied context, or equivalent experience from the defence industry
  • Excellent Norwegian and English language skills, both written and spoken

This employment will require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. In addition, a security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority will be required. The successful candidate may start to work with limited access whilst the clearance is being processed. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment

As a person you have/are:

  • Ability to build relationships and trust with demanding internal and external stakeholders, as well as a relevant network within the Royal Norwegian Navy, the Norwegian Armed Forces and the defence industry, with the ability to open doors and build relationships across all levels
  • Ability to translate user needs and operational experience into strategic priorities, business opportunities and holistic customer solutions
  • Good business understanding with an analytical and commercial approach, solid technology understanding and knowledge of the defence industry and its framework conditions
  • Independent, proactive and structured, with the ability to work effectively both independently and in cross-functional teams
  • Strong execution skills, a good relationship builder and confident in dialogue with both industry and authorities

We offer:

  • An important role in a growing company
  • An exciting and varied area of responsibility where you can influence your own working day
  • A positive working environment with extensive experience and expertise
  • Good career and development opportunities in an international company
  • Competitive terms with good pension and insurance schemes, benefit programs, access to company cabins, fitness centre and much more

Work location:
One of Kongsberg Maritime’s offices in Norway.

Would you like to know more? Please contact:
 Lars Klemmetsby, Director Business Development and System Sales, Naval Systems.

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business.

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges.

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: SSA eller sygeplejerske søges til ny spædbarnsordning på Thyholm (Struer kommune)
jobs.description:
Social- og sundhedsassistenter og sygeplejersker søges til helt særlig spædbarnsordning på Thyholm

Vi søger enten 1 til 32 timer 
eller 2 til 16 evt. timer hver. 

Vil du være med til at skabe tryghed, udvikling og livskvalitet for et spædbarn med komplekse sundhedsfaglige behov?

Vi søger engagerede og omsorgsfulde social- og sundhedsassistenter samt sygeplejersker til en nyopstartet døgnordning på Thyholm, med grundig oplæring på OUH forinden start i eget hjem.

Dette er ikke en traditionel stilling.

Det er en mulighed for at blive en del af et lille, fast team omkring et for tidlig født spædbarn og familien i deres eget hjem, hvor relationer, faglighed og kontinuitet er afgørende. Du bliver en vigtig del af hverdagen og får mulighed for at følge barnet tæt i en af livets mest sårbare og betydningsfulde perioder.

Om opgaven

Der er tale om et for tidlig født spædbarn med komplekse sundhedsfaglige behov, som har behov for kontinuerlig overvågning og støtte døgnet rundt.

Arbejdet foregår i barnets hjem i tæt samarbejde med familien, Olivia Danmark, kommunen og den behandlingsansvarlige hospitalsafdeling.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Observation af barnets almene tilstand
  • Overvågning af behandling og udstyr
  • Håndtering af CVK og TPN-behandling efter oplæring og delegation
  • Reaktion på alarmer og ændringer i barnets tilstand
  • Dokumentation af relevante observationer
  • Samarbejde med familien og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

Da der er tale om et spædbarn, vil du også indgå i almindelige omsorgs- og plejeopgaver der naturligt knytter sig til pasning af et lille barn

Hvem søger vi?
Vi søger fastansættelser af flere SSA og sygeplejersker – medindflydelse på timetal. 

Det er et krav, at du:

  • Har autorisation som social- og sundhedsassistent eller sygeplejerske
  • Har erfaring med spædbørn eller mindre børn
  • Trives med at arbejde tæt sammen med familier i deres eget hjem
  • Arbejder roligt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner
  • Kan bevare overblikket i komplekse situationer

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring med:

  • TPN-behandling
  • CVK-håndtering
  • Pædiatri
  • Hjemmesygepleje


Grundig oplæring inden opstart: 

Du forventes ikke at kunne opgaven fra dag ét.

Krav: Alle medarbejdere gennemgår et grundigt oplæringsforløb på OUH inden opstart i hjemmet;
Oplæringsforløb er d. 17.-19. august på OUH. Der betales for hotelovernatning samt kørsel til oplæringsforløbet. 

Oplæringen varetages af hospitalets fagpersoner og omfatter de konkrete procedurer, observationer og handleanvisninger, som er nødvendige for at kunne varetage opgaven forsvarligt.

Først når oplæringen er gennemført, og de nødvendige instrukser og delegationer er på plads, starter arbejdet i hjemmet.

Arbejdstid

Ordningen er døgnbemandet 365 dage om året.

Der arbejdes primært i 12-timers vagter, og der vil være både dag-, nat- og weekendarbejde.

Du ansættes som udgangspunkt til ét fast vagtlag, men da vi er et fælles team omkring barnet, forventes det, at alle medarbejdere kan hjælpe med at dække ind ved eksempelvis sygdom, ferie eller orlov.

For at sikre, at alle medarbejdere bevarer kendskabet til opgaver og rutiner på tværs af døgnet, vil der i det faste rul forekomme enkelte vagter på det modsatte vagtlag.

Vi arbejder med faste vagtrul og ønsker at skabe så stor forudsigelighed som muligt. Der vil derfor være mulighed for medindflydelse på vagtplanen, herunder ønsker om faste fridage eller andre tilbagevendende behov, når dette kan forenes med driften.

Vi tilbyder

  • En helt særlig og meningsfuld opgave
  • Et lille og tæt team med høj faglighed
  • Grundig oplæring på OUH
  • Overenskomst med hhv. DSR og FOA
  • Tæt faglig sparring og ledelsesmæssig støtte
  • Løbende supervision og kompetenceudvikling
  • Mulighed for at følge et barns udvikling tæt over tid
  • En arbejdsplads hvor relationer, kvalitet og ordentlighed vægtes højt

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: Thyholm

Opstart: Vagterne i hjemmet vil starte op fra og med uge 35, efter man har været på et oplæringsforløb i Odense. 

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når de(n) rette kandidat(er) er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Michelle Kazmaier-Kasnæs
Områdeleder Sundhed
Olivia Danmark

E-mail: michelle.kasnaes@oliviadanmark.dk
Tlf.: 61 10 38 68

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

At DTU Nanolab we operate at the intersection of academia and industry, creating a unique environment for research, innovation and collaboration. Being Head of Thin Film Processing offers a rare chance to step into a central role within one of Denmark’s most advanced research and technology facilities.

We are looking for an experienced nanofabrication manager who can lead a team of highly experienced process specialists while advancing state-of-the-art technologies and driving the development and optimization of new process flows.

The role demands strong technological insight, solid leadership capabilities, and the ability to navigate a complex and ambitious professional environment. In return, we offer a position with significant influence, where you will help shape the future of nanotechnology.

Job content
As the Head of Thin Film Processing, you will be overall responsible for processes and tools related to plasma etch and deposition of materials. This includes but is not limited to ICP and RIE etchers, PECVD, LPCVD and PVD as well as ALD and relevant in-line characterization equipment (SEM, AFM, XRD, XPS, ellipsometry). You will interact with and advise both academic and industrial users, you will identify needs and participate in the procurement of new equipment and be responsible for processes and material cross-contamination rules related to new and existing tools. In this role, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for a team of highly experienced process specialists, while contributing as an active member of DTU Nanolab’s core management team. We foster a supportive and collaborative working environment with a strong team spirit, and expect you to lead with curiosity, pragmatism, and a solution-oriented mindset.

Furthermore, you will take part in projects that will expand DTU Nanolab’s technological capabilities and expertise in close interaction with research groups and other academic and industrial collaborators. Additionally, you will play a significant part in DTU Nanolab’s ongoing efforts to strengthen collaboration across the Nordic countries and EU, within for example: EuroNanoLab, Nordic Nanolab Network or EU Chips Joint Undertaking efforts.

Qualifications
You must have a Master of Science degree and a Ph.D. degree within a relevant field, such as Micro/Nanofabrication, Physics, Microelectronics, or similar. Industrial experience is a distinct advantage.

We expect you to have:
  • At least 10 years of experience within cleanroom fabrication related to etch and deposition of various materials.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with both academic and commercial users
  • Broad knowledge of nano-fabrication methods such as lithography (UV, DUV, e-beam), wet chemical etching, dry etching, thin film deposition and process characterization, backend and packaging on a wafer level scale.
  • In depth knowledge of plasma processes for deposition and etching of materials (ICP, RIE, PECVD, LPCVD, PEALD and sputter).
  • In depth knowledge of non-plasma processes (anneal, oxidation, diffusion doping, RTP, ALD, thermal and e-beam PVD).
  • Several years of experience with process development including process yield and process windows.
  • A broad understanding of the micro- and nanofabrication industry and an in depth understanding of its requirements, challenges and timelines.
  • Deep knowledge of common semiconductor materials like silicon, various oxides and metals.
  • Experience and understanding regarding cleanroom, chemical and electrical safety.
  • Proven leadership experience, including responsibility for leading highly skilled technical staff.
  • Fluency in English - both spoken l and written, preferably also Danish but at least an interest and ambition to learn Danish.

Furthermore, it is desirable that you:
  • Are communicative, proactive and curious.
  • Are self-driven and team oriented.
  • Have the ability to inspire and engage others.
  • Have a wholehearted enthusiasm for semiconductor fabrication technology.
  • Have several years of relevant industrial experience.

At DTU Nanolab, safety is a top priority, and we are looking for candidates who can thrive in a highly safety-conscious environment and meet the following physical and mental requirements:
  • Is able to work in an environment where it can be necessary to wear specialized safety and protective equipment.
  • Is able to respond quickly and effectively in emergency situations, including evacuation in case of alarms.
  • Is able to perform tasks that require work while standing up and mobility for longer periods.
  • Is mentally able to handle work with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases in accordance with our mandatory safety procedures.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting as early as possible with respect to mutual agreement.

As Head of Thin Film Processing, you will directly report to the Director of DTU Nanolab.

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus, located approximately 10 km north of Copenhagen.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 20 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Jörg Hübner, Director, jhub@dtu.dk or +45 2278 5157.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is a common infrastructure and research facility located at and fully owned by the Technical University of Denmark, DTU. The core facilities consist of a large cleanroom and a state-of-the-art electron microscopy center. The research activities carried out at DTU Nanolab span from nano- and microfabrication with Silicon-based materials, carbon and polymers to the highly sophisticated analysis of nanoscale materials in hard and soft matter.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: Team Leader – Night Shift Operations
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead one of our most critical operational teams?

As our Night Shift Team Leader, you will be responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and operational management of our night shift operation, ensuring that customer deliveries are executed safely, efficiently, and on time.

You will report directly to the Operations Manager and become part of the site's leadership team.

As we operate in a GDP-regulated environment, compliance, quality, traceability, and continuous improvement are fundamental to everything we do.

 

About the Role

The Night Shift operation is responsible for the complete handling of outbound shipments, including picking, packing, and final distribution.

You will lead a team of approximately 10 employees, consisting of both full-time and part-time staff from many different nationalities and cultural backgrounds.

Working closely with the Shift Supervisor, you will ensure that staffing levels, operational flow, capacity planning, and daily priorities support an efficient, compliant, and high-performing operation.

As Team Leader, you are responsible for both people leadership and operational excellence. You will create an engaging working environment while continuously improving processes, quality, productivity, and delivery performance.

 

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Overall responsibility for the daily execution of the night shift operation

  • Leading, coaching, motivating, and developing employees

  • Ownership of operational processes and continuous process improvements

  • Ensuring compliance with GDP requirements, internal procedures, and quality standards

  • Investigating operational deviations, incidents, and quality-related issues

  • Monitoring and improving KPIs and operational performance

  • Planning staffing, capacity, and operational resources

  • Driving productivity, service quality, and delivery reliability

  • Supporting recruitment, onboarding, and employee development together with HR

  • Implementing new processes, systems, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Collaborating closely with day shift management and support functions to ensure an efficient end-to-end operation

  • Promoting a positive safety culture and ensuring compliance with Health & Safety requirements

  • Producing products on scooter with the team

 

Your Profile

We are looking for an experienced and visible leader who enjoys creating results through people and thrives in a fast-paced operational environment.

We expect that you:

  • Have proven people management experience within warehousing, logistics, distribution, manufacturing, or similar operational environments

  • Are a hands-on leader who enjoys working close to the operation and your employees

  • Have experience with KPI management and performance management

  • Can maintain structure and overview in a complex operation with many simultaneous activities

  • Have experience working with shift-based operations and hourly-paid employees

  • Are data-driven and possess some IT skills

  • Communicate clearly and are able to create engagement and commitment across the organisation

  • Remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures

  • Lead by example and are willing to go the extra mile when required

  • Have excellent organisational skills and a strong attention to detail

  • Are fluent in both English (the company's operational language) and Danish, both written and spoken

Experience working within a GDP-regulated or pharmaceutical logistics environment will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

 

What We Offer

We offer an exciting leadership opportunity where you will have a direct impact on one of the company's most critical operational functions.

In return, we offer:

  • A key leadership position with significant responsibility

  • The opportunity to influence and develop our night shift operation

  • A professional and well-structured logistics environment

  • Close collaboration with an experienced leadership team

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Competitive salary, pension scheme, and employee benefits

  • A comprehensive onboarding programme and thorough training

 

Working Hours

This is a permanent full time position of 37 hours per week. The ordinary night shift schedule is distributed across six working days according to a fixed roster. The precise daily working hours, including paid working time and breaks, are stated in the employment contract.

You will work six days per week according to a fixed roster.

Scheduled working hours are between 00:00 AM to 07:00 AM.

Flexibility is expected during periods of high operational demand, employee absences, vacations, or other business requirements.

Salary
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

The guaranteed salary, including eligible fixed salary components and pension contributions, will meet the applicable minimum salary requirement under the Danish Supplementary Pay Limit Scheme

Location

Nordsjælland, Denmark

Interested?

If you would like to become part of a professional organisation where quality, compliance, and operational excellence are at the heart of everything we do, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once the right candidate has been identified.

jobs.title: Drift og renholdsansvarlig
jobs.description:
Bli med på en spennende vekstreise hos Four FM 🚀

Four FM er en nordisk leverandør av Facility Management-tjenester med sterke entreprenørielle røtter, fornøyde kunder og engasjerte medarbeidere. Vi vokser videre i Norge og søker nå en Drift- og renholdsansvarlig som ønsker å være med og påvirke både sin egen rolle og hvordan vi jobber i fremtiden.

Dette er en unik mulighet for deg som trives med ansvar, liker å være tett på den daglige driften og ønsker friheten til å forme din egen arbeidshverdag.

Hos oss får du muligheten til å drive entreprenørskap i et allerede etablert selskap. Vi ønsker deg som ser forbedringsmuligheter, utfordrer eksisterende arbeidsmåter og vil være med på å videreutvikle vår virksomhet.

Om rollen 🌏

Som Drift- og renholdsansvarlig vil du ha det overordnede ansvaret for renholdsleveransen til flere kunder i Oslo-området. Rollen er operativ og hands-on, og du vil være en viktig støtte både for kunder og medarbeidere i den daglige driften.

Du vil lede og følge opp et team av renholdere, hvor deler av arbeidet utføres på ettermiddag og kveld. Du vil jobbe tett med våre kunder, følge opp kvaliteten i leveransen, støtte medarbeiderne dine og sikre at driften fungerer effektivt hver dag. Du får stor frihet til å forme rollen og arbeidsmetodene dine. Vi søker deg som motiveres av å ta eierskap, ser forbedringsmuligheter og ønsker å bidra til vår videre vekst. Stillingen rapporterer til Nordic Cleaning Manager.

Ansvarsområder 📊

• Sikre høy kvalitet i leveransene og høy kundetilfredshet.

• Følge opp den daglige driften ute hos kunder.

• Lede, motivere og utvikle renholdsteamene.

• Rekruttere, onboarde, utvikle og følge opp medarbeidere gjennom hele ansettelsesforholdet.

• Ansvar for opplæring og videreutvikling av ansatte.

• Håndtere og følge opp medarbeidernes tidsrapportering.

• Sørge for at rutiner, instrukser og arbeidsmetoder er oppdaterte og implementerte.

• Utarbeide bemanningsplaner og koordinere ressurser ved fravær og ferie.

• Identifisere forbedringsmuligheter og bidra til kontinuerlig utvikling av arbeidsprosesser.

• Følge opp HMS-rutiner og sikre etterlevelse av lover, krav og interne prosedyrer.

• Bygge gode relasjoner med kunder og fungere som en naturlig kontaktperson.

Hvem er du? ✨

Du er en person som liker å ta ansvar og få ting gjort. Du trives med å være tett på driften og motiveres av å skape struktur, kvalitet og gode resultater sammen med andre.

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

• Er en synlig og tilstedeværende leder.

• Trives i en operativ rolle med stor variasjon.

• Er selvstendig og løsningsorientert.

• Har en sterk gjennomføringsevne.

• Liker å utvikle mennesker og bygge team.

• Motiveres av å være med på en vekstreise.

• Ser muligheter der andre ser utfordringer.

Kvalifikasjoner ✔

• Erfaring med personalledelse.

• Erfaring fra renholdsbransjen.

• Erfaring med onboarding og oppfølging av medarbeidere.

• God forståelse for drift og bemanningsplanlegging.

• Erfaring med Microsoft 365.

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

• Førerkort klasse B.

Ekstra fordeler

• Erfaring fra Facility Management-bransjen.

• Erfaring fra andre servicebransjer.

• Erfaring med arbeid i kundeleveranser og kontraktsbaserte tjenester.

Hva tilbyr vi? 🌟

• En nøkkelrolle i et selskap i vekst.

• Stor grad av frihet under ansvar.

• Muligheten til å forme rollen og påvirke hvordan vi arbeider.

• Korte beslutningsveier og entreprenøriell kultur.

• Et inkluderende og engasjert arbeidsmiljø.

Arbeidstid og Varighet 🕒🕑🕐

Fast stilling med en innledende prøveperiode. Arbeidstiden er fleksibel og tilpasses driften og kundenes behov. Rollen innebærer både administrativt arbeid og operativ oppfølging ute i leveransen. Ettersom deler av renholdsarbeidet utføres på ettermiddag og kveld, må det påregnes arbeid utenfor ordinær kontortid ved behov.

Som en del av rollen forventes det også at du deltar i den daglige driften og bidrar i renholdsarbeid ved behov, for eksempel ved fravær eller andre bemanningsutfordringer.

Startdato

Så snart som mulig, eller etter avtale.

Arbeidssted

Oslo.

Søknadsprosess

Søknadsfristen er 17. august 2026.

Intervjuer vil bli gjennomført fortløpende. På grunn av ferieavvikling kan responstiden være noe lengre enn normalt i løpet av sommeren.

Vi oppfordrer deg derfor til å sende inn søknaden så snart som mulig.

Four FM's visjon: "We Take C.A.R.E." ❤

Våre verdier er vårt moralske kompass. "We Take C.A.R.E." Hvis du brenner for å gjøre en forskjell, trives i et støttende arbeidsmiljø og tror på kraften av Compassion (omsorg), Attention (oppmerksomhet), Respect (respekt) og Excellence (kvalitet), vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Hos oss kan du vokse og utvikle deg i rollen din eller ta på deg nye utfordringer i organisasjonen. Første steg er å søke!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Four FM is a Nordic facility management company providing tailored services to businesses and property owners. 

We work with companies that care about their brand, their people, and the environments they operate in. As a partner, not just a supplier, we deliver flexible solutions with a strong service mindset — guided by our philosophy, We Take C.A.R.E.

Som byggforvalter i Bergen kommune blir du byggeiers representant og får ansvar for en egen portefølje av eiendommer. Du vil samarbeide tett med brukere, fagmiljøer og samarbeidspartnere, og bidra til at kommunens eiendommer forvaltes på en langsiktig, effektiv og miljøbevisst måte. 

Om stillingen 
Du blir en del av en kompetent og allsidig faggruppe bestående av 15 byggforvaltere, med ansvar fra alt av historiske bygg til moderne, høyteknologiske anlegg. Sammen arbeider dere med å sikre god drift, vedlikehold og utvikling av kommunens eiendommer. 
Byggteknisk avdeling har ansvar for planlegging av vedlikehold og utvikling av eiendomsmassen. I større prosjekter vil du opptre som byggeiers representant.  
Bergen kommune er i gang med å videreutvikle sin eiendomsstrategi. Som byggforvalter vil det være viktig å arbeide i tråd med strategien gjennom ansvarlig og miljøbevisst utvikling av eiendommene, planlegge langsiktig og ha en tydelig samfunnsorientering.

  • Relevant arbeidserfaring er en fordel, men nyutdannede oppfordres også til å søke

Etat for bygg og eiendom er en av Norges største eiendomsforvaltere, med ca. 850 ansatte og ansvar for over 1000 bygg med til sammen rundt 1,3 millioner m² bygningsmasse. Vi forvalter blant annet skoler, barnehager, sykehjem, administrasjonsbygg, idrettsanlegg og uteområder.

jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer/Technician  - Testingeniør/tekniker – Assembly & Test, Carpus
jobs.description:
English:

Kongsberg Maritime AS and its Automation & Control business unit deliver world-leading automation solutions for i.a. process control and safety systems to offshore vessels and oil & gas installations worldwide. We are in an exciting growth period and are looking for a dedicated hardware Test Engineer to strengthen our dedicated team and who wants to be part of our journey ahead.

As a HW Test Engineer with us, you will be part of our dynamic team composed of different experience, expertise and age. We emphasize sharing knowledge and cultivating a work culture that not only facilitates the best possible well-being, but also promotes an efficient working day.

Your tasks will be related to assembly and connection, testing, and troubleshooting of new and upgrades deliveries of Kongsberg Maritime's equipment. You will also be involved in other tasks in the department such as training apprentices and new employees, developing and maintaining the department's internal documentation such as work instructions and checklists, as well as the department's process and improvement work.

Our products are mainly positioning management, thruster control and automation control systems.

We are looking for a person who is motivated to take responsibility for quality and efficiency in project implementation, focuses on good cooperation, competence sharing and clear communication.

 

Does this sound exciting? Do not hesitate to apply – we assess candidates on an ongoing basis.

 

Responsibilities

  • Assembly and installation of HW project deliveries.
  • Distribution of networks and network tests in customer projects.
  • Testing and debugging of HW and SW on our systems.
  • Some electromechanical work.
  • Close collaboration and communication with project management.
  • Further development of test documentation.
  • Continuous improvement work.

 

Qualifications and experience

  • Certificate in relevant subject areas such as electrical, automation and computer/electronics.
  • Practical experience with technical installations.
  • Experience with electromechanical work is an advantage.
  • Fluent in Norwegian and English, both oral and written.
  • General computer knowledge.
  • Good workmanship.

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

  • Communicates in a clear, precise and structured manner.
  • Collaborates well with others, enjoys sharing knowledge and experience, and supports others in achieving the team's goals.
  • Actively contributes to a positive work environment.
  • It is important that you maintain a high level of orderliness and organization, even during busy periods, follow internal procedures, and can handle hectic days without becoming stressed.

jobs.title: Vi søker renholdere til våre Airbnbs! Fleksibel jobb med god lønn.
jobs.description:
Vi søker renholdere. Her har du en fleksibel jobb med konkurransedyktig lønn.

Hva vi ser etter

Hvem ser vi etter?

Pålitelig og nøye: Vi er superhost på Airbnb, og denne statusen er utrolig viktig for oss at bevare. Vi trenger derfor noen som er nøye med detaljene og pålitelig i arbeidet. Det er utrolig viktig at man kommer til avtalt vask.

God kommunikasjon: Du må være god til å kommunisere for at vi skal kunne samarbeide godt i den daglige driften. Ærlighet er også veldig viktig for oss.

Ønsker en enkel og fleksibel jobb: Denne jobben passer perfekt for deg som ønsker en fleksibel jobb.

Optimalt sett, så ønsker vi en som kan jobbe fast deltid-fleksibelt i noen få måneder (des-april/mai), for å sen overgå i fast 100% mot våren (ca april-mai).

I søknaden til denne stillingen, vill det være svært verdifullt om du kan inkludere en kort tekst som bekrefter din forståelse av viktigheten av lojalitet til å komme til avtalt vakt, samt utførelse av arbeidet på en måte som sikrer gjestenes tilfredshet.

Fortell gjerne om dine planer og ønskninger for 2026.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Nordisk Standard er en nyetablert bedrift med flere leiligheter sentralt i Oslo. Vi har høye ambisjoner om å vokse antallet leiligheter og streber etter å opprettholde høy standard og utmerket service for våre gjester. For å lykkes med dette, er det avgjørende å ha utmerket renhold.

Arbeidsoppgaver :

  • Vasking av sengetøy i leilighetene/fellesvaskeri i bygget.

  • Rengjøring av overflater, støvsuging, vaske gulv, bytte sengetøy, vaske toaletter, tømme søppel og ta oppvasken.

  • Fylle på med nødvendigheter som toalettpapir, såpe, sjampo, balsam og oppvaskmiddel.

Vi har selv håndtert dette i to år, og vår erfaring er at gjestene er flinke til å etterlate leilighetene i god stand.


Vi tilbyr

Hva tilbyr vi?

Godt betalt: For riktig, pålitelig kandidat, så ønsker vi å gi høyere enn vanlig tarifflønn.

Fleksibilitet: Vi prøver å være så fleksible som mulig med gjestene i forhold til innsjekk. Dette gir oss mulighet for å være fleksibel med våre ansatte ift hvordan de ønsker å forme sin dag. Hvis noen boliger har sen innsjekk, så kan man være fleksibel med når boligen rengjøres.

God arbeidsmiljø: Vi er en bedrift som sørger for god service, både for gjestene og for våre ansatte. Vi ønsker at du skal trives godt og sørger for å være oppmerksom på dine behov å ønsker at du skal føle deg verdsatt i jobben din.

jobs.title: Build the industrial cooperation function driving Kongsberg Maritime’s growth in the naval defence market
jobs.description:
Kongsberg Maritime has clear ambitions for significant growth within the maritime defence segment. Over many years, the company has successfully developed, sold and delivered advanced solutions, including propulsion systems and stabilisers, to navies and coast guards worldwide.

Our activities within the maritime defence market are expected to grow further through a broader offering of products, solutions and services. The most important growth will come from increased focus on automation and control, energy, and digital services, including maritime simulators.

Industrial cooperation is a central part of international defence trade and represents an important strategic tool for winning contracts, both in Norway and internationally. Offset and industrial cooperation are therefore defined as strategic core elements in Kongsberg Maritime’s continued development within the Naval market. As a result of this strategic focus and increasing activity level, a dedicated central function for industrial cooperation is now being established. In this context, we are seeking a Director Industrial Cooperation who will play a leading role in building and further developing this function. The position reports to the Director Operations, Naval Systems.

High travel activity should be expected during certain periods

Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop and build the Industrial Cooperation function in Kongsberg Maritime
  • Participate in international sales campaigns as the responsible lead for industrial cooperation, and contribute to the execution and follow-up of agreed industrial cooperation agreements
  • Negotiate cooperation agreements with international partners and suppliers to secure Norwegian participation in programmes, technology development and international market access
  • Follow up, manage and report on industrial cooperation agreements in accordance with governmental requirements and internal objectives
  • Maintain and further develop relationships with authorities in Norway and internationally
  • Contribute to further developing industrial cooperation as a strategic tool for winning Norwegian and international contracts

Desired qualifications and personal qualities:

  • Technical or commercial education at master’s level, and/or education from a military academy
  • Strong business understanding with an analytical and commercial approach, solid technological insight and knowledge of the defence industry and its framework conditions
  • Experience from business development, including experience with international negotiations and cooperation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Norwegian and English

As a person you are:

  • Independent, proactive and structured, with the ability to work effectively both independently and in cross-functional teams
  • Have strong execution skills, excellent relationship-building abilities and confidence in dialogue with both industry and authorities

We offer:

  • An important role in a growing company
  • We offer competitive pay based on objective criteria to ensure fairness and internal equity along with pension contributions, health- and employee insurance
  • An exciting and varied area of responsibility where you can influence your own working day

jobs.title: Netkiosken på Kastetvej søger en butiksassistent og potentielt Souschef.
jobs.description:
Butiksassistent til Netkiosken Kastetvej/ Potentielt Souschef.

Netkiosken Kastetvej i Aalborg søger en butiksmedhjælper til faste vagter ca 20-25 timer ugentligt, primært i dagtimerne, men med en ugentlig aftenvagt. Til en person med de rette evner vil der med tiden være mulighed for at glide over i en stilling som Souschef med flere timer og højere løn.

Der vil være mulighed for flere timer om aftenen og i weekenden hvis man er klar på at hjælpe sine kolleger når de vil have byttet vagter eller ved sygdom. Fra midt november til midt januar forventer vi at du kan arbejde fuld tid, da denne periode er vores absolut travleste, idet ”Black Friday” er over os. Oplæringen forventes opstartet i begyndelsen af august.

Vi er en større kiosk i Aalborg, som har fokus på at tilfredsstille vore mange kunder. Vi tilbyder et stort udvalg af spilmuligheder, Danske spil, og Cashpoint samt mange spilleautomater. Ligeledes har vi et udvalg af kioskvarer og er pakkeshop for GLS, DAO, Post Nord, Bring, UPS og DHL. 

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bestå af kundeekspedition, vareopfyldning og diverse forefaldne opgaver. Med tiden vil flere ansvarsområder pålægges den ansatte hvis man har de rette evner. I sådanne tilfælde vil lønnen øges i forhold til det nedenstående. Ender man med at komme over i stillingen som Souschef, betyder det også, at man har telefonvagten hver anden uge og har ansvaret for at hjælpe personalet når de ringer om spørgsmål og møder op når det ikke kan løses via telefonen.

Arbejdstiderne er typisk hverdage i tidsrummet 8.00-17.00 Desuden ser vi gerne at du hjælper dine nye kollegaer en gang imellem med deres vagter samt lejlighedsvis hjælper ved sygdom hverdag, aftner og weekender. I ferieperioder vil der være mulighed for en del ekstra vagter.

Du skal være indstillet på at man periodevis arbejder alene og have autoritet samt god kundekontakt. Ligeledes skal du have overblik til at holde butikken pæn og ryddelig.

Stillingen er ideel for en der afholder et sabbatår, og erfaring fra tankstation eller supermarked vil være et plus. Hvis man ønsker at blive Souschef vil det være ønskeligt, at man har erfaring med at have personaleansvar fra tidligere stillinger.

Timelønnen er i prøvetiden, de første 3 måneder, 120 kr. Derefter 135kr. indtil første år og efter første år 145 kr. I tilfælde af at man bliver Souschef er lønnen selvfølgelig en anden og efter evner.

You will contribute to the implementation of HR priorities in line with the people strategy, support leaders across the employee lifecycle and take over project work and diverse HR assignments in a dynamic international environment.

Act as strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders across Technology (R&D), Service and selected Corporate Functions.

Serve as a member of the Technology Division Management Team and contribute HR perspectives to business decisions, organizational development and people topics.

Advise and support managers on HR practices, processes and policies, including employee relations, performance management, change management and leadership effectiveness.

Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, succession planning and capability development.

Support the implementation of annual HR processes, including performance management, salary review, talent review and employee engagement activities.

Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on recruitment activities for selected roles and support effective job marketing and communication.

Use workforce and people data to identify trends, derive insights and recommend pragmatic actions that support business objectives.

Lead or contribute to HR projects, process improvements and diverse local or global assignments.

Foster an inclusive, engaging and high-performance culture aligned with Accelleron’s values.

Ensure compliant and consistent HR solutions in line with Swiss employment legislation, internal policies and governance requirements.

Your background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Law or a related field.

5+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager or equivalent HR generalist role in a complex business environment, preferably experience with HR work in management teams.

Experience partnering technical, engineering, R&D, industrial, service or manufacturing populations is highly desirable.

Strong understanding of talent management, organizational development, employee relations and Swiss employment legislation.

Experience with Workday or a similar HR system is preferred.

Proven ability to advise, challenge and influence leaders at different organizational levels.

Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational excellence.

Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international matrix environment.

Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

jobs.title: Technical Field Sales Representative (m/f/d) Denmark (Außendienstmitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
egeplast is a highly innovative manufacturer of plastic pipe systems for underground utility infrastructure – ensuring a reliable supply of clean drinking water, heat and electricity, as well as access to high-speed internet. We are an internationally operating family-owned company with production sites in Germany, Sweden and England. egeplast has received several awards, most recently in 2025 as “Factory of the Year” for “Outstanding Digitalization & Automation” and in 2025 with the MX Award in the categories “Best SME” and “Customer Orientation”.

To support our team, we are looking for you as

Technical Field Sales Representative (m/f/d) Denmark

Your tasks:

- You are the main contact person for our customers actively supporting and visiting them throughout the entire sales process.
- As a Technical Field Sales Representative, you will be responsible for selling our innovative piping systems in Denmark – from the initial planning stage through to the realisation of pipeline projects.
- You will maintain strong relationships with existing customers and actively acquire new customers.
- You will advise pipe network operators, planners and construction companies on system and product selection, joining technologies and installation methods.
- You will work closely with pipeline construction companies, for example when renting out welding machines and accessories or supporting the installation of our products on site.
- You will organise and carry out product demonstrations and technical training sessions and represent egeplast at relevant industry and trade events.
- Through active market observation and networking, you will identify projects at an early stage and provide planners with expert advice.
- You will pass on relevant market and customer information to the back office to support the preparation of quotations and contribute customer needs, feedback and trends to product development.
- You will prepare reference reports on successful projects and share your experience with customers and colleagues.

You fit in with us:

- You have completed a technical degree or a master craftsman qualification, for example in pipeline construction, plant engineering or HVAC.
- You have gained practical professional experience, for example as a site manager, project manager in a planning office or sales representative for piping components or similar products.
- Good knowledge of the relevant target groups and an existing network within the market are desirable.
- You are highly self-motivated and work in a structured and independent manner.
- You have strong communication and negotiation skills and are confident in dealing with different customer groups.
- You are able to understand individual customer requirements and develop tailored solutions.
- You describe yourself as a motivated, customer-oriented team player who enjoys taking on responsibility.
- You are able to convince others of innovative and sustainable product solutions.

We are looking forward to getting to know you!
